Bava Batra 144a:5-9: Veim amra: "reu ma shehinniach li bali, hareni osa veochelet" – hishbicha leatzmah. peshita! mahu detema: kevan dishvicha la milleta, deamri: ka tarcha kamme yatme – achole achala; ka mashma lan.
Amar rabbi chanina: hammassi ishsha livno gadol babbayit – kenao. vedavka gadol, vedavka betula, vedavka ishto rishona, vedavka shehissio rishon.
Peshita, yiched lo aviv bayit vaaliyyay – bayit kana, aliyyay lo kana. bayit veachsadra, mahu? shene vattim ze lifnim mizze, mahu? teku.

Metivi: yiched lo aviv bayit uchele vayit – kele vayit kana, bayit lo kana! amar rabbi yirmeya: kegon shehaya otzaro shel aviv munnach sham. nehardae amri: afillu shovacha deyone. rav yehuda verav pappe amri: afillu atzitza deharsana. mar zutera anseveh livreh, utela leh sandala. rav ashe anseveh livreh, utela leh ashisha demishcha.

Amar mar zutera, hane telat mille shavvinhu rabbanan kehilcheta bela tama: chada – ha, iddach – deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hakkotev kol nechasav leishto – lo asaah ella appotroppa. iddach – deamar rav: mane li beyadcha, tenehu lifloni; bemaamad shelashtan – kana.
Berakhot 26b:4-11: Ittemar, rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar: tefillot avot tikkenum. rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: tefillot keneged temidin tikkenum.

Tanya kevoteh derabbi yose berabbi chanina, vetanya kevoteh derabbi yehoshua ben levi. tanya kevoteh derabbi yose berabbi chanina: avraham tikken tefillat shacharit, shenneemar: "vayyashkem avraham babboker el hammakom asher amad sham", veen "amida" ella tefilla, shenneemar: "vayyaamod pinchas vayfallel".
Yitzchak tikken tefillat mincha, shenneemar "vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade lifnot arev", veen "sicha" ella tefilla, shenneemar "tefilla leani chi yaatof velifne Adonai yishpoch sicho".

Yaakov tikken tefillat arvit, shenneemar: "vayyifga bammakom vayyalen sham", veen "pegia" ella tefilla, shenneemar: "veatta al titpallel bead haam hazze veal tissa vaadam rinna utefilla veal tifga bi"

Vetanya kevoteh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: mippene ma amru tefillat hashshachar ad chatzot — shehare tamid shel shachar karev veholech ad chatzot. verabbi yehuda omer: ad arba shaot shehare tamid shel shachar karev veholech ad arba shaot.

Umippene ma amru tefillat hammincha ad haerev — shehare, tamid shel ben haarbayim karev veholech ad haerev. rabbi yehuda omer: ad pelag hammincha, shehare tamid shel ben haarbayim karev veholech ad pelag hammincha.
Umippene ma amru tefillat haerev en lah keva — shehare evarim ufedarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev, kerevim veholchim kol hallayla.
Umippene ma amru shel musafin kol hayyom — shehare korban shel musafin karev kol hayyom. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheva shaot, shehare korban musaf karev veholech ad sheva shaot.
Chullin 44b:5-45a:1: "Hinne nafshi lo metummaa" – shello hirharti bayyom lavo lide tumea ballayla, "unevela uterefa lo achalti" – shello achalti besar "kos kos" meolam, "velo va befi besar piggul" – shello achalti mibbehema shehora bah chacham. mishshum rabbi natan amru: shello achalti mibbehema shello huremu mattenoteha.
Hane mille – milleta detalya bisvara, rabba bar bar chana aggemareh semach.

Vetippok leh mishshum chashada, detanya: dan et haddin, zikka vechayyayv, timme vetiher, asar vehittir, vechen haedim sheheidu – kullan rashshain likkach, aval amru chachamim: harechek min hakkiur umin haddome lo.
Hane mille midde dimzabben mishshuma, hacha matkela mochach, ki ha derabba shera terefta uzevan minna bisra, amara leh bat rav chisda: abba share buchera vela zaven minneh bisra.
Amar la: hane mille buchera deashshuma mizdevan, hacha matkela mochach, may ikka – mishshum umetza meallayyta? kol yoma umetza meallayyta zabbinu li.
Amar rav chisda: ezehu talmid chacham? ze haroe terefa leatzmo. veamar rav chisda: ezehu "sone mattanot yichye"? ze haroe terefa leatzmo.

Daresh mar zutera mishshemeh derav chisda: kol mi shekkore veshone, veroe terefa leatzmo, veshimmesh talmide chachamim – alav hakkatuv omer: "yegia kappecha ki tochel ashrecha vetov lach". rav zevid amar: zoche venochel shene olamot, haolam hazze vehaolam habba, "ashrecha" – beolam hazze, "vetov lach" – laolam habba.

Rabbi elazar, ki havo meshadderi leh mibbe nesia midde, la shakel, vechi havo mezammeni leh, la azel. amar: la ka bae mar deeche? dichtiv: "vesone mattanot yichye". rabbi zera, ki meshadderi leh, la shakel, ki havo mazmenin leh, azel. amar:
Eruvin 53b:25-54a:25: Berureya ashkachteh lehahu talmida dahava ka gares bilchisha.

Betasha beh, amara leh: lo kach katuv "arucha vakkol ushemura", im arucha birmach evarim shellecha — mishtammeret, veim lav — enah mishtammeret. tana: talmid echad haya lerabbi eliezer shehaya shone belachash, leachar shalosh shanim shachach talmudo.
Tana, talmid echad haya lo lerabbi eliezer shennitchayyev bisrefa lammakom. amru: hannichu lo adam gadol shimmesh.

Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, petach pummaych keri, petach pummaych teni, ki hechi detitkayyaym baych vetorich chayye, shenneemar: "ki chayyim hem lemotzehem ulechol besaro marpe", al tikre "lemotzehem" ella "lemotziehem bappe".
Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, chatof veechol chatof veishti, dealma deazlinan minneh kehillula dame.

Amar leh rav lerav hamenuna: beni im yesh lach — hetev lach, sheen bashsheol taanug, veen lammavet hitmahmeah. veim tomar anniach levanay — chok bashsheol mi yaggid lach: bene haadam domim leisve hassade hallalu notztzin vehallalu novlin.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hamehallech badderech veen immo levayay — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "ki livyat chen hem".

Chash berosho — yaasok betora, shenneemar: "ki livyat chen hem leroshecha". chash bigrono — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "vaanakim legargerotecha". chash bemeav — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "rifut tehi lesharecha". chash beatzmotav — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "veshikkuy leatzmotecha". chash bechol gufo — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "ulechol besaro marpe".

Amar rav yehuda berabbi chiyyay: bo uree, shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam. middat basar vadam: adam noten sam lachavero — laze yafe, velaze kashe. aval hakkadosh baruch hu eno ken: natan tora leyisrael — sam chayyim lechol gufo, shenneemar: "ulechol besaro marpe".

Amar rav amme: may dichtiv "ki naim ki tishmerem bevitnecha yikkonu yachdav al sefatecha", ematay divre tora neimim — bizman shettishmerem bevitnecha, veematay tishmerem bevitnecha — bizman sheyyikkonu yachdav al sefatecha.

Rabbi zera amar mehacha: "simcha laish bemaane fiv vedavar beitto ma tov", ematay simcha laish — bizman shemmaane befiv. lashon acher: ematay simcha laish bemaane fiv — bizman sheddavar beitto ma tov.
Rabbi yitzchak amar mehacha: "ki karov elecha haddavar meod beficha uvilvavcha laasoto", ematay karov elecha — bizman shebbeficha uvilvavcha laasoto.
Rava amar mehacha: "taavat libbo natatta lo vaareshet sefatav bal manata sela", ematay taavat libbo natatta lo — bizman sheareshet sefatav bal manata sela.
Rava rame: ketiv "taavat libbo natatta lo". uchetiv "vaareshet sefatav bal manata sela". zacha — taavat libbo natatta lo. lo zacha — vaareshet sefatav bal manata sela.
Tana deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: kol makom shenneemar "netzach" "sela" "vaed" — en lo hefsek olamit. netzach, dichtiv: "ki lo leolam ariv velo lanetzach ekketzof".
Sela, dichtiv: "kaasher shamanu ken rainu beir Adonai tzevaot beir elohenu elohim yechonneha ad olam sela". vaed, dichtiv: "Adonai yimloch leolam vaed".

(Siman: "anakim" "lechayav" "luchot" "charut"). amar rabbi (eliezer): may dichtiv "vaanakim legargerotecha", im mesim adam atzmo kaanak ze sheraf al hatztzavvar venire veeno nire — talmudo mitkayyem beyado. veim lav — en talmudo mitkayyem beyado.

Veamar rabbi eliezer: may dichtiv "lechayav kaarugat habbosem", im mesim adam atzmo kaaruga zo shehakkol dashin bah, uchevosem ze shehakkol mitbassemin bah — talmudo mitkayyem, veim lav — en talmudo mitkayyem.
Veamar rabbi (eliezer): may dichtiv "luchot even", im adam mesim atzmo et lechayav keeven zo sheenah nimchet — talmudo mitkayyem beyado, veim lav — en talmudo mitkayyem beyado.
Veamar rabbi (eliezer): may dichtiv "charut al halluchot", ilmale lo nishtabberu luchot harishonot — lo nishtakkecha tora miyyisrael.
Rav acha bar yaakov amar: en kol umma velashon sholetet bahen, shenneemar: "charut" — al tikre "charut", ella cherut.
Amar rav matna: may dichtiv "umimmidbar mattana", im mesim adam atzmo kemidbar ze shehakkol dashin bo — talmudo mitkayyem beyado. veim lav — en talmudo mitkayyem beyado.

Rava bereh derav yosef bar chama hava leh milleta lerav yosef bahadeh, ki meta maale yoma dechippure amar: ezil vaafayyeyseh. azal, ashkecheh leshammaeh deka mazeg leh kasa. amar: hav li veemzegeh ana. yehav leh, mazgeh. kidtameh amar: dame hay meziga limziga derava bereh derav yosef bar chama. amar leh: ana hu.
Amar leh: la tittev akkaraycha ad dimfarshat li hane kerae. may dichtiv: "umimmidbar mattana umimmattana nachaliel uminnachaliel bamot umibbamot haggay"?

Amar leh: im adam mesim atzmo kemidbar ze shehakkol dashin bo — tora nittena lo bemattana. vechevan shennittena lo bemattana — nechalo el, shenneemar: "umimmattana nachaliel". vechevan shennechalo el — ole ligdulla, shenneemar: "uminnachaliel bamot".
Veim meges libbo — hakkadosh baruch hu mashpilo, shenneemar: "umibbamot haggay". veim chozer bo — hakkadosh baruch hu magbiho, shenneemar: "kol ge yinnase".
Ezekiel 22:1-6: Veatta ven-adam hatishpot hatishpot et-ir haddamim vehodatah et kol-toavoteha
Veamarta ko amar adonay Adonai ir shofechet dam betochah lavo ittah veasta gillulim aleha letoma

Hakkerovot veharchokot mimmech yitkallesu-vach temeat hashshem rabbat hammehuma
Hinne nesie yisrael ish lizroo hayu vach lemaan shefoch-dam

Ezekiel 22:7-10: Av vaem hekallu vach lagger asu vaoshek betochech yatom vealmana honu vach
Anshe rachil hayu vach lemaan shefoch-dam veel-heharim achlu vach zimma asu vetochech
Ketubot 110b:5-15: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kulei. may "bodek"? kedishmuel. deamar shemuel: shinnuy veset techillat choli meayim. katuv besefer ben sira: "kol yeme ani raim". vehaikka shabbatot veyamim tovim? kedishmuel. deamar shemuel: shinnuy veset techillat choli meayim.
Ben sira omer: "af lelot, bishfal gaggim gaggo, uvimrom harim karmo, mimmetar gaggim legaggo, umeafar karmo lichramim".
Mishna hakkol maalin leeretz yisrael, veen hakkol motziin. hakkol maalin lirushalayim, veen hakkol motziin. echad haanashim veechad hannashim.

Nasa ishsha beeretz yisrael vegershah beeretz yisrael — noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael. nasa ishsha beeretz yisrael vegershah bekappotkeya — noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael. nasa ishsha bekappotkeya vegershah beeretz yisrael — noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: noten lah mimmeot kappotkeya. nasa ishsha bekappotkeya vegershah bekappotkeya — noten lah mimmeot kappotkeya.
Uleman detane avadim behedya, leetoye may? leetoye minnave hayyafe lenave hara(5).
"Veen hakkol motziin" leetoye may? leetoye eved shebbarach mechutza laaretz laaretz, deamrinan leh: zabbeneh hacha vezil, mishshum yeshivat eretz yisrael.
"Hakkol maalin lirushalayim" leetoye may? leetoye minnave hayyafe lenave hara(5).
"Veen hakkol motziin" leetoye may? leetoye afillu minnave hara(5) lenave hayyafe. veayyeyde ditna resha "en motziin", tena sefa name "en motziin".

Tanu rabbanan: hu omer laalot, vehi omeret shello laalot — kofin otah laalot, veim lav — tetze belo ketubba. hi omeret laalot, vehu omer shello laalot — kofin oto laalot, veim lav — yotzi veyitten ketubba.

Hi omeret latzet, vehu omer shello latzet — kofin otah shello latzet, veim lav — tetze belo ketubba. hu omer latzet, vehi omeret shello latzet — kofin oto shello latzet, veim lav — yotzi veyitten ketubba.
Mishnah Bava Batra 3:8-4:4:
En osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim, borot shichin umearot. rabbi eliezer mattir kede shettehe agala mehallechet uteuna avanim. en motziin zizin ugezuzteraot lirshut harabbim, ella im ratza kones letoch shello umotzi. lakach chatzer uvah zizin ugezuzteraot, hare zo vechezkatah: 
Hammocher et habbayit, lo machar hayyatzia, veaf al pi shehi fetucha letocho, velo et hacheder shellifnim mimmennu, velo et haggag bizman sheyyesh lo maake gavoah asara tefachim. rabbi yehuda omer, im yesh lo tzurat petach, af al pi sheeno gavoah asara tefachim, eno machur: 
Lo et habbor, velo et haddut, af al pi shekkatav lo umka veruma. vetzarich likkach lo derech, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, eno tzarich likkach lo darech. umode rabbi akiva, bizman sheamar lo chutz meellu, sheeno tzarich likkach lo darech. mecharan leacher, rabbi akiva omer, eno tzarich likkach lo derech. vachachamim omrim, tzarich likkach lo darech: 
Hammocher et habbayit, machar et haddelet, aval lo et hammafteach. machar et hammachteshet hakkevua, aval lo et hammittaltelet. machar et haitzterubbal, aval lo et hakkelet, velo et hattannur, velo et hakkirayim. bizman sheamar lo, hu vechol ma shebbetocho, hare chullan mechurin: 
Hammocher et hechatzer, machar battim, borot, shichin, umearot, aval lo et hammittaltelin. bizman sheamar lo, hi vechol ma shebbetochah, hare chullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach, lo machar et hammerchatz, velo et bet habbad shebbetochah. rabbi eliezer omer, hammocher et hechatzer, lo machar ella avirah shel chatzer:
Mishnah Bava Batra 4:5-8:
Hammocher et bet habbad, machar et hayyam veet hammammal veet habbetulot, aval lo machar et haachirin veet haggalgal veet hakkora. bizman sheamar lo, hu vechol ma shebbetocho, hare chullan mechurin. rabbi eliezer omer, hammocher bet habbad, machar et hakkora: 
Hammocher et hammerchatz, lo machar et hannesarim veet hassafsalim veet havvilaot. bizman sheamar lo, hu vechol ma shebbetocho, hare chullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach, lo machar et hammegurot shel mayim velo et haotzarot shel etzim: 
Hammocher et hair, machar battim, borot, shichin, umearot, merchatzaot veshovachot, bet habbaddin uvet hashshelachin, aval lo et hammittaltelin. uvizman sheamar lo, hi vechol ma shebbetochah, afillu hayu vah behema vaavadim, hare chullan mechurin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hammocher et hair, machar et hassanter: 
Hammocher et hassade, machar et haavanim shehem letzarkah, veet hakkanim shebbakkerem shehem letzarko, veet hattevua shehi mechubberet lakkarka, veet mechitztzat hakkanim shehi fechuta mibbet rova, veet hashshomera sheenah asuya vetit, veet hecharuv sheeno murkav, veet betulat hashshikma:
Mishnah Bava Batra 4:9-5:3:
Aval lo machar lo et haavanim sheenan letzarkah, velo et hakkanim shebbakkerem sheenan letzarko, velo et hattevua shehi telusha min hakkarka. bizman sheamar lo, hi vechol ma shebbetochah, hare chullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach, lo machar lo et mechitztzat hakkanim shehi vet rova, velo et hashshomera shehi asuya vetit, velo et hecharuv hammurkav, velo et saddan hashshikma, velo et habbor, velo et haggat, velo et hashshovach, ben charevin ben yeshuvin. vetzarich likkach lo darech, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, eno tzarich. umode rabbi akiva, bizman sheamar lo chutz meellu, sheeno tzarich likkach lo darech. mecharan leacher, rabbi akiva omer, eno tzarich likkach lo darech. vachachamim omrim, tzarich likkach lo darech. bamme devarim amurim, bemocher. aval benoten mattana, noten et kullam. haachin shechalku, zachu vassade, zachu vechullam. hammachazik benichse hagger, hechezik bassade, hechezik bechullam. hammakdish et hassade, hikdish et kullam. rabbi shimon omer, hammakdish et hassade, lo hikdish ella et hecharuv hammurkav veet saddan hashshikma: 
Hammocher et hassefina, machar et hattoren veet hannes veet haogin veet kol hammanhigin otah, aval lo machar lo et haavadim, velo et hammartzufin, velo et haantiki. uvizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah, hare chullan mechurin. machar et hakkaron, lo machar et happeradot. machar et happeradot, lo machar et hakkaron. machar et hatztzemed, lo machar et habbakar. machar et habbakar, lo machar et hatztzemed. rabbi yehuda omer, haddamim modiin. ketzad, amar lo mechor li tzimdecha bematayim zuz, haddavar yadua sheen hatztzemed bematayim zuz. vachachamim omrim, en haddamim reaya: 
Hammocher et hachamor, lo machar kelav. nachum hammadi omer, machar kelav. rabbi yehuda omer, peamim mechurin ufeamim enan mechurin. ketzad, haya chamor lefanav vechelav alav, veamar lo mechor li chamorcha ze, hare chelav mechurin. chamorcha hu, en kelav mechurin: 
Hammocher et hachamor, machar et hasseyach. machar et happara, lo machar et benah. machar ashpa, machar zivlah. machar bor, machar memav. machar kavveret, machar devorim. machar shovach, machar yonim. hallokeach perot shovach mechavero, mafriach berecha rishona. perot kavveret, notel shelosha nechilin umesares. challot devash, manniach shete challot. zetim lakotz, manniach shete gerofiyyot:
Mishnah Bava Batra 5:4-8:
Hakkone shene ilanot betoch sede chavero, hare ze lo kana karka. rabbi meir omer, kana karka. higdilu, lo yeshappe. vehaole min haggeza, shello. umin hashsharashim, shel baal hakkarka. veim metu, en lo karka. kana shelosha, kana karka. higdilu, yeshappe. vehaole min haggeza umin hashsharashin, shello. veim metu, yesh lo karka: 
Hammocher rosh behema gassa, lo machar et haraglayim. machar et haraglayim, lo machar et harosh. machar et hakkane, lo machar et hakkaved. machar et hakkaved, lo machar et hakkane. aval bedakka, machar et harosh, machar et haraglayim. machar et haraglayim, lo machar et harosh. machar et hakkane, machar et hakkaved. machar et hakkaved, lo machar et hakkane: 
Arba middot bammochrin. machar lo chittim yafot venimtzeu raot, hallokeach yachol lachazor bo. raot venimtzeu yafot, mocher yachol lachazor bo. raot venimtzeu raot, yafot venimtzeu yafot, en echad mehem yachol lachazor bo. shechamtit venimtzet levana, levana venimtzet shechamtit, etzim shel zayit venimtzeu shel shikma, shel shikma venimtzeu shel zayit, yayin venimtza chometz, chometz venimtza yayin, shenehem yecholin lachazor bahen: 
Hammocher perot lachavero, mashach velo madad, kana. madad velo mashach, lo kana. im haya fikkeach, socher et mekoman. hallokeach pishtan mechavero, hare ze lo kana ad sheyyetaltelennu mimmakom lemakom. veim haya vimchubbar lakkarka vetalash kol shehu, kana: 
Hammocher yayin vashemen lachavero vehukeru o shehuzelu, im ad shello nitmallea hammidda, lammocher. mishshennitmallea hammidda, lallokeach. veim haya sarsur benehen, nishbera hechavit, nishbera lassarsur. vechayyav lehattif lo shalosh tippin. hirkinah umitztza, hare hu shel mocher. vehachenvani eno chayyav lehattif shalosh tippin. rabbi yehuda omer, erev shabbat im chashecha, patur:
Mishnah Bava Batra 5:9-6:1:
Hashsholeach et beno etzel chenvani ufundeyon beyado, umadad lo beissar shemen venatan lo et haissar, shavar et hatztzelochit veibbed et haissar, chenvani chayyav. rabbi yehuda poter, sheal menat ken shelacho. umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bizman shehatztzelochit beyad hattinok umadad chenvani letochah, chenvani fatur: 
Hassiton mekanneach middotav achat lishloshim yom, uvaal habbayit achat lishnem asar chodesh. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, chilluf haddevarim. chenvani mekanneach middotav paamayim bashshabbat, umemache mishkelotav paam achat bashshabbat, umekanneach moznayim al kol mishkal umishkal: 
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, bamme devarim amurim, ballach. aval bayyavesh, eno tzarich. vechayyav lehacheria lo tefach. haya shokel lo ayin beayin, noten lo gerumav, echad laasara ballach veechad leesrim bayyavesh. mekom shennahagu lamod baddakka, lo yamod baggassa. baggassa, lo yamod baddakka. limchok, lo yigdosh. ligdosh, lo yimchok: 
Hammocher perot lachavero velo tzimmechu, vaafillu zera pishtan, eno chayyav beacharayutan. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, zerone ginna sheenan neechalin, chayyav beacharayutan:
Mishnah Bava Batra 6:2-5:
Hammocher perot lachavero, hare ze mekabbel alav rova tinnofet lisa. teenim, mekabbel alav eser metullaot lemea. martef shel yayin, mekabbel alav eser kossot lemea. kankannim bashsharon, mekabbel alav eser pitasyaot lemea: 
Hammocher yayin lachavero vehechmitz, eno chayyav beacharayuto. veim yadua sheyyeno machmitz, hare ze mikkach taut. veim amar lo yayin mevussam ani mocher lecha, chayyav lehaamid lo ad haatzeret. veyashan, mishshel eshtakad. umeyushshan, mishshel shalosh shanim: 
Hammocher makom lachavero livnot lo vayit, vechen hamekabbel mechavero livnot lo vet chatnut livno uvet almenut levitto, bone arba ammot al shesh, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yishmael omer, refet bakar hu ze. harotze laasot refet bakar, bone arba ammot al shesh. bayit katan, shesh al shemone. gadol, shemone al eser. teraklin, eser al eser. rumo kachatzi arko vechachatzi rachbo. reaya laddavar, hechol. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hakkol kevinyan hechol: 
Mi sheyyesh lo vor lifnim mibbeto shel chavero, nichnas beshaa shedderech bene adam nichnasin veyotze beshaa shedderech bene adam yotzin, veeno machnis behemto umashkah mibboro, ella memalle umashkah mibbachutz, veze ose lo fotachat veze ose lo fotachat:
Mishnah Oholot 11:3-6:
Sagos ave vechofet ave enan meviin et hattuma ad sheyyihyu gevohim min haaretz poteach tefach. kefulim, zo al gabbe zo, enan meviot et hattuma ad shettehe haelyona gevoha min haaretz poteach tefach. haya adam natun sham, bet shammay omrim, eno mevi et hattuma. uvet hillel omrim, adam chalul hu, vehatztzad haelyon mevi et hattuma: 
Haya mashkif bead hachallon veheehil al kovre hammet, bet shammay omrim, eno mevi et hattuma. uvet hillel omrim, mevi et hattuma. umodim, sheim haya lavush bechelav, o shehayu shenayim ze al gabbe ze, shehem meviin et hattuma: 
Haya muttal al haaskuppa veheehilu alav kovre hammet, bet shammay omrim, eno mevi et hattuma. uvet hillel omrim, mevi et hattuma: 
Hattuma vabbayit veheehilu alav tehorin, bet shammay metaharin, uvet hillel metammein:
Mishnah Oholot 11:7-12:1:
Kelev sheachal besar hammet umet hakkelev umuttal al haaskuppa, rabbi meir omer, im yesh betzavvaro poteach tefach, mevi et hattuma. veim lav, eno mevi et hattuma. rabbi yose omer, roin et hattuma, mikkeneged hammashkof velifnim, habbayit tame. mikkeneged hammashkof velachutz, habbayit tahor. rabbi eliezer omer, piv lifnim, habbayit tahor. piv lachutz, habbayit tame, shehattuma yotzet derech shulav. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, ben kach uven kach, habbayit tame. kamma tishhe vemeav. shelosha yamim meet leet. beofot uvedagim, kede shettippol laur vetissaref, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, beofot uvedagim, meet leet: 
Hechadut shebbabbayit umenora vetocho, vehapperach shellah yotze uchefisha netuna alav, sheim tinnatel hammenora uchefisha omedet al pi hechadut, bet shammay omrim, hechadut tahor, umenora temea. bet hillel omrim, af hammenora tehora. umodim, sheim tinnatel hammenora uchefisha nofelet, hakkol tame: 
Kelim shebben sifte chefisha leven sifte hechadut, afillu ad hattehom, tehorim. tuma sham, habbayit tame. tuma vabbayit, kelim shebbechatle hechadut, im yesh bimkoman tefach al tefach al rum tefach, tehorim. veim lav, temeim. im hayu chatle hechadut rechavim mishshel bayit, ben kach uven kach tehorim: 
Neser shehu natun al pi tannur chadash veodef mikkol tzedadav befoteach tefach, tuma tachtav, kelim sheal gabbav tehorim. tuma al gabbav, kelim shettachtav tehorim. uveyashan, tame. rabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher. natun al pi shene tannurim, tuma venehem, hem temeim. rabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher:
Mishnah Oholot 12:2-6:
Sereda shehi netuna al pi hattannur mukkaf tzamid patil, tuma tachtav o al gabbav, hakkol tame. keneged aviro shel tannur, tahor. tuma cheneged aviro shel tannur, kenegdo ad harakia tame: 
Neser shehu natun al pi tannur yashan, yotze mizze umizze tefach aval lo min hatztzedadim, tuma vetzad ze, kelim shebbatztzad hashsheni tehorim. rabbi yose metamme. habbetach eno mevi et hattuma. haya vo ziz, rabbi eliezer omer, eno mevi et hattuma. rabbi yehoshua omer, roim et habbetach keillu eno, vehazziz haelyon mevi et hattuma: 
Sandal shel arisa sheppechato vetoch habbayit, im yesh bo poteach tefach, hakkol tame. veim lav, monin bo chederech shemmonin bemet: 
Korot habbayit vehaaliyya sheen alehen maaziva vehen mechuvvanot, tuma tachat achat mehen, tachteha tame. ben hattachtona laelyona, benehen tame. al gabbe haelyona, kenegdo ad harakia tame. hayu haelyonot keven hattachtonot, tuma tachat achat mehen, tachat kullam tame. al gabbehen, kenegdo ad harakia tame: 
Kora shehi netuna mikkotel lechotel vetuma tachteha, im yesh bah poteach tefach, mevia et hattuma tachat kullah. veim lav, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. kamma yihye vehekkefah vihe vah poteach tefach. bizman shehi agulla, hekkefah shelosha tefachim. bizman shehi merubbaat, arbaa, shehamerubba yater al heagol revia:
Mishnah Oholot 12:7-13:2:
Ammud shehu muttal laavir, im yesh behekkefo esrim vearbaa tefachim, mevi et hattuma tachat dafno. veim lav, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet: 
Kazzayit min hammet mudbak laaskuppa, rabbi eliezer metamme et habbayit. rabbi yehoshua metaher. haya natun tachat haaskuppa, yiddon mechetza lemechetza. mudbak lammashkof, habbayit tame. rabbi yose metaher. haya natun betoch habbayit, hannogea bammashkof, tame. hannogea baaskuppa, rabbi eliezer metamme. rabbi yehoshua omer, mittefach ulemattan, tahor. mittefach ulemalan, tame: 
Haose maor battechilla, shiuro melo makdeach gadol shel lishka. sheyare hammaor, rum etzbaayim al rochav haggudal. ellu hen sheyare hammaor, challon shessetamah velo hispik legamrah. chararuhu mayim o sheratzim o sheachalattu mallachat, shiuro melo egrof. chashav alav letashmish, shiuro foteach tefach. lemaor, shiuro melo makdeach. hasserigot veharfafot mitztarfot kimlo makdeach, kedivre vet shammay. bet hillel omrim, ad sheyyehe vemakom echad melo makdeach. lehavi hattuma ulehotzi hattuma. rabbi shimon omer, lehavi hattuma, aval lehotzi et hattuma befoteach tafach: 
Challon shehi laavir, shiurah melo makdeach. bana vayit chutza lah, shiurah befoteach tefach. natan et hattikra veemtza hachallon, hattachton befoteach tefach, vehaelyon melo makdeach:
Mishnah Oholot 13:3-6:
Hachor shebbaddelet, shiuro melo egrof, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi tarfon omer, befoteach tefach. shiyyer bah hecharash millemattan o milmalan, hegifah velo merkah, o sheppetachattu haruach, shiuro melo egrof: 
Haose makom lekane, uleispati, ulener, shiuro kol shehu, kedivre vet shammay. bet hillel omrim, befoteach tefach. lazun et enav, uledabber im chavero, uletashmish, befoteach tafach: 
Ellu memaatin et hattefach. pachot mikkazzayit basar memaet al yede rova atzamot, ufachot meetzem kasseora memaet al yede chazzayit basar. pachot mikkazzayit min hammet, pachot mikkazzayit min hannevela, pachot mikkaadasha min hashsheretz, pachot mikkabbetza ochalim, hattevua shebbachallon, vechachay sheyyesh bah mammash, venivlat haof hattahor shello chishshav aleha, venivlat of hattame shechishshav aleha velo hichshirah, o hichshirah velo chishshav aleha: 
Ellu sheenan memaatim. en haetzem memaet al yede atzamot, velo vasar al yede vasar, velo chazzayit min hammet, velo chazzayit min hannevela, velo chaadasha min hashsheretz, velo chabbetza ochalim, velo tevua shebbachallonot, velo chachay sheen bah mammash, velo nivlat haof hattahor shechishshav aleha, velo nivlat of hattame shechishshav aleha vehichshirah, velo hashsheti vehaerev hamenuggaim, velo levena mibbet happeras, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hallevena memaetet, mippene sheafarah tahor. ze hakkelal, hattahor memaet, vehattame eno memaet:
Mishnah Oholot 14:1-5:
Hazziz mevi et hattuma kol shehu. haggizra vehaggavlit, befoteach tefach. ezehu hazziz, sheppanav lematta. vehaggizra, sheppaneha lemala. uvamma amru hazziz mevi et hattuma chol shehu, beziz shehu gavoah min happetach shelosha nidbachin, shehem shenem asar tefach. yater mikkan, mevi et hattuma vefoteach tefach. haatarot vehappittuchim meviin et hattuma vefoteach tafach: 
Ziz sheal gabbe happetach, mevi et hattuma vefoteach tefach. sheal gabbe hachallon, rum etzbaayim, sheal gabbe melo makdeach, kol shehu. rabbi yose omer, meloo: 
Kane sheal gabbe happetach, afillu gavoah mea amma, mevi et hattuma chol shehu, divre rabbi yehoshua. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, al yachmor ze min hazziz: 
Ziz shehu sovev et kol habbayit veochel bappetach shalosh etzbaot, tuma vabbayit, kelim shettachtav temeim. tuma tachtav, rabbi eliezer metamme et habbayit, verabbi yehoshua metaher. vechen bechatzer shehi mukkefet achsadra: 
Shene zizin ze al gabbe ze veyesh bahen poteach tefach uvenehen poteach tefach, tuma tachtehen, tachtehen tame. benehem, benehen tame. al gabbehen, kenegdo ad larakia tame. haya haelyon odef al hattachton poteach tefach, tuma tachtehen o venehen, tachtehen uvenehen tame. al gabbehen, kenegdo ad larakia tame. haya haelyon odef al hattachton pachot mittefach, tuma tachtehen, tachtehen uvenehen tame. benehen o tachat hammotar, rabbi eliezer omer, tachtehen uvenehen tame. rabbi yehoshua omer, benehen vetachat hammotar, tame, vetachtehen, tahor:
Mishnah Shabbat 11:6-12:3:
Hazzorek venizkar leachar sheyyatzta miyyado, kelatah acher, kelatah kelev, o shennisrefa, patur. zarak laasot chabbura, ben beadam ben bivhema, venizkar ad shello naasa chabbura, patur. ze hakkelal, kol chayyave chattaot enan chayyavin ad shettehe techillatan vesofan shegaga. techillatan shegaga vesofan zadon, techillatan zadon vesofan shegaga, peturin, ad shettehe techillatan vesofan shegaga: 
Habbone, kamma yivne vihe chayyav, habbone kol shehu, vehamesattet, vehammakke vappattish uvemaatzad, hakkodeach kol shehu, chayyav. ze hakkelal, kol haose melacha umelachto mitkayyemet beshabbat, chayyav. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af hammakke vekurnas al hassaddan bishat melacha, chayyav, mippene shehu chimtakken melacha: 
Hachoresh kol shehu, hamenakkesh vehamekarsem vehamezared kol shehu, chayyav. hamelakket etzim, im letakken, kol shehen, im lehessek, kede levashshel betza kalla. hamelakket asavim, im letakken, kol shehu, im livhema, kimlo fi haggedi: 
Hakkotev shete otiyyot, ben bimino ben bismolo, ben mishshem echad ben mishshene shemot, ben mishshene sammaniyyot, bechol lashon, chayyav. amar rabbi yose, lo chiyyevu shete otiyyot ella mishshum roshem, shekkach hayu chotvin al karshe hammishkan, leda ezo ven zugo. amar rabbi, matzinu shem katan mishshem gadol, shem mishshimon ushemuel, noach minnachor, dan middaniyyel, gad miggaddiel:
Mishnah Shabbat 12:4-13:2:
Hakkotev shete otiyyot behelem echad, chayyav. katav bidyo, besam, besikra, bekomos uvekankantom, uvechol davar shehu roshem, al shene chatle zaviyyot veal shene luche finkas, vehen nehgin ze im ze, chayyav. hakkotev al besaro, chayyav. hamesaret al besaro, rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter: 
Katav bemashkin, beme ferot, baavak derachim, baavak hassofrim, uvechol davar sheeno mitkayyem, patur. leachar yado, beraglo, befiv uvemarpeko, katav ot achat samuch lichtav, uchetav al gabbe chetav, nitkavven lichtov chet vechatav shene zaynin, echad baaretz veechad bakkora, katav al shene chatle habbayit, al shene dappe finkas veen nehgin ze im ze, patur. katav ot achat notarikon, rabbi yehoshua ben betera mechayyev, vachachamim potrin: 
Hakkotev shete otiyyot bishne helemot, achat shacharit veachat ben haarbayim, rabban gamliel mechayyev, vachachamim potrin: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, haoreg shelosha chutin battechilla veachat al haarig, chayyav. vachachamim omrim, ben battechilla ben bassof, shiuro shene chutin: 
Haose shene vatte nirin bannirin, bakkeros, bannafa, bakkevara uvassal, chayyav. vehattofer shete tefirot, vehakkorea al menat litpor shete tefirot:
Mishnah Shabbat 13:3-6:
Hakkorea bachamato veal meto, vechol hamekalkelin, peturin. vehamekalkel al menat letakken, shiuro chamtakken: 
Shiur hamelabben vehamenappetz vehatztzovea vehattove, kimlo rochav hassit kaful. vehaoreg shene chutin, shiuro kimlo hassit: 
Rabbi yehuda omer, hatztzad tzippor lammigdal utzevi labbayit, chayyav. vachachamim omrim, tzippor lammigdal, utzevi labbayit velechatzer velabbevarin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo chol habbevarin shavin. ze hakkelal, mechussar tzida, patur, vesheeno mechussar tzida, chayyav: 
Tzevi shennichnas labbayit venaal echad befanav, chayyav. naalu shenayim, peturin. lo yachol echad linol venaalu shenayim, chayyavin. verabbi shimon poter:
Mishnah Shabbat 13:7-14:3:
Yashav haechad al happetach velo milleahu, yashav hashsheni umilleahu, hashsheni chayyav. yashav harishon al happetach umilleahu, uva hashsheni veyashav betziddo, af al pi sheamad harishon vehalach lo, harishon chayyav vehashsheni patur. ha lema ze dome, lenoel et beto leshamro venimtza tzevi shamur betocho: 
Shemona sheratzim haamurim battora, hatztzadan vehachovel bahen, chayyav. ushear shekatzim uremasim, hachovel bahen patur, hatztzadan letzorech, chayyav, shello letzorech, patur. chayya veof shebbirshuto, hatztzadan patur, vehachovel bahen chayyav: 
En osin hilmi veshabbat, aval ose hu et me hammelach vetovel bahen pitto venoten letoch hattavshil. amar rabbi yose, vahalo hu hilmi, ben merubbe uven muat. veelu hen me melach hammuttarin, noten shemen battechilla letoch hammayim o letoch hammelach: 
En ochlin ezov yon beshabbat, lefi sheeno maachal beriim, aval ochel hu et yoezer veshote abbuv roe. kol hoochalin ochel adam lirfua, vechol hammashkin shote, chutz mimme dekalim vechos ikkarim, mippene shehen layroka. aval shote hu me dekalim litzmao, vesach shemen ikkarin shello lirfua:
Mishnah Shabbat 14:4-16:1:
Hachoshesh beshinnav, lo yigma bahen et hachometz, aval metabbel hu chedarko, veim nitrappe nitrappe. hachoshesh bematnav, lo yasuch yayin vechometz, aval sach hu et hashshemen, velo shemen vered. bene melachim sachin shemen vered al makkotehen, shekken darkam lasuch bachol. rabbi shimon omer, kol yisrael bene melachim hem: 
Ellu kesharim shechayyavin alehen, kesher haggammalin vekesher hassappanin. ucheshem shehu chayyav al kishshuran kach hu chayyav al hetteran. rabbi meir omer, kol kesher shehu yachol lehattiro veachat miyyadav, en chayyavin alav: 
Yesh lecha kesharim sheen chayyavin alehen kekesher haggammalin uchekesher hassappanin. kosheret ishsha miftach chalukah, vechute sevacha veshel pesikya, uretzuot minal vesandal, venodot yayin vashemen, ukedera shel basar. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, koshrin lifne habbehema bishvil shello tetze. koshrin deli bifsikya, aval lo vechevel. rabbi yehuda mattir. kelal amar rabbi yehuda, kol kesher sheeno shel keyama, en chayyavin alav: 
Mekappelin et hakkelim afillu arbaa vachamishsha feamim, umatztziin et hammittot millele shabbat leshabbat, aval lo mishshabbat lemotzae shabbat. rabbi yishmael omer, mekappelin et hakkelim umatztziin et hammittot miyyom hakkippurim leshabbat, vechelve shabbat kerevin beyom hakkippurim. (aval lo shel yom hakkippurim beshabbat). rabbi akiva omer lo shel shabbat kerevin beyom hakkippurim, velo shel yom hakkippurim kerevin beshabbat: 
Kol kitve hakkodesh matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka, ben shekkorin bahen uven sheen korin bahen. veaf al pi shekketuvim bechol lashon, teunim geniza. umippene ma en korin bahen, mippene vittul bet hammidrash. matztzilin tik hassefer im hassefer, vetik hattefillin im hattefillin, veaf al pi sheyyesh betochan maot. ulehechan matztzilin otan, lemavoy sheeno mefullash. ben betera omer, af limfullash:
Mishnah Shabbat 16:2-5:
Matztzilin mezon shalosh seuddot, harauy leadam leadam, harauy livhema livhema. ketzad. nafla deleka velele shabbat, matztzilin mezon shalosh seuddot, beshacharit, matztzilin mezon shete seuddot, bemincha, mezon seudda echat. rabbi yose omer, leolam matztzilin mezon shalosh seuddot: 
Matztzilin sal male chikkarot, veaf al pi sheyyesh bo mea seuddot, veiggul shel devela, vechavit shel yayin. veomer laacherim, bou vehatztzilu lachem. veim hayu fikchin, osin immo cheshbon achar hashshabbat. lehechan matztzilin otan, lechatzer hameorevet. ben betera omer, af lesheenah meoravet: 
Ulesham motzi chol kele tashmisho, velovesh kol ma sheyyachol lilbosh, veotef kol ma sheyyachol laatof. rabbi yose omer, shemona asar kelim. vechozer velovesh umotzi, veomer laacherim, bou vehatztzilu immi: 
Rabbi shimon ben nannas omer, porsin or shel gedi al gabbe shidda teva umigdal sheachaz bahen et haur, mippene shehu mecharech. veosin mechitztza bechol hakkelim, ben meleim ben rekanim, bishvil shello taavor haddeleka. rabbi yose oser bichle cheres chadashim melein mayim, lefi sheen yecholin lekabbel et haur vehen mitbakkein umechabbin et haddeleka:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 22::
Tinoket mibbat shalosh ulematta vetinok ben tesha ulematta muttar lehityached immahen. shello gazru ella al yichud ishsha haruya levia veish harauy levia: 
Anderoginus eno mityached im hannashim. veim nityached en makkin oto mippene shehu safek. aval haish mityached im haanderoginus veim hattumtum: 
Eshet ish shehaya balah bair enah chosheshet leyichud. mippene sheemat balah aleha. veim haya ze gas bah kegon sheggadla immo o shehayta kerovato lo yityached immah veaf al pi shebbalah bair. vechen kol hammityached im ishsha vehaya happetach patuach lirshut harabbim en choshshin mishshum yichud:

Mi sheen lo ishsha lo yelammed tinokot. mippene sheimmot habbanim baot levet hassefer livnehem venimtza mitgare benashim. vechen ishsha lo telammed ketannim mippene avotehen shehen bain biglal benehem venimtzeu mityachadim immah. veen hamelammed tzarich shettihye ishto sheruya immo bevet hassefer ella hi bevetah vehu melammed bimkomo: 
Tikkenu chachamim shettihyena hannashim mesapperot zo im zo bevet hakkisse kede shello yikkanes sham ish mishshum yichud:

En memannin afillu adam neeman vechasher lihyot shomer chatzer sheyyesh sham nashim af al pi shehu omed bachutz sheen appotroppos laarayot. veasur leadam lemannot appotroppos al beto shello yanhig ishto lidvar avera: 
Asur letalmid chacham lishkon bechatzer sheyyesh bah almana af al pi sheeno mityached immah mippene hachashad. ella im ken hayta ishto immo. vechen almana asura legaddel kelev mippene hachashad. velo tikne ishsha avadim zecharim afillu ketannim mippene hachashad:

Vechen en mosrin tinok yisrael lechuti lelammedo sefer ulelammedo ammanut. mippene shekkullan chashudin al mishkav zachur. veen maamidin behema befundakiyyot shel kutim vaafillu zecharim etzel zecharim unekevot etzel nekevot: 
Veen mosrin behema chayya veof leroe kuti afillu zecharim lechutim unekevot lechutit mippene shekkullan chashudin al harebaat behema uchevar bearnu shehen asurin bezachur uvivhema veneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl": 
Umippene ma en mosrin behema nekeva lechutit mippene shekkullan bechezkat noafim uchesheyyavo hannoef lishkav im hakkutit zo efshar shello yimtzaenna veyishkav im habbehema o afillu yimtzaenna yishkav im habbehema:

Lo tityached ishsha achat afillu im anashim harebe ad shettihye ishto shel echad mehem sham. vechen lo yityached ish echad afillu im nashim harebe. nashim harebe im anashim harebe en choshshin leyichud. hayu haanashim mibbachutz vehannashim mibbifnim o haanashim mibbifnim vehannashim mibbachutz ufersha ishsha achat leven haanashim o ish leven hannashim asurin mishshum yichud. afillu ish sheisko umelachto im hannashim asur lo lehityached im hannashim. ketzad yaase. yitassek immahen veishto immo o yifne limlacha acheret: 
Muttar lehityached im shete yevamot. o im shete tzarot. o im ishsha vachamotah. o im ishsha uvat balah. o im ishsha uvat chamotah. mippene shessonot zo et zo veen mechappot zo al zo. vechen muttar lehityached im ishsha sheyyesh immah tinoket ketanna sheyyodaat taam bia veenah moseret atzmah levia. sheenah mezanna befaneha shehare zo megalla et sodah:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 8:1-3:
Hachoresh kol shehu chayyav. hamenakkesh beikkere hailanot vehamekarsem asavim o hamezared et hassarigim kede leyappot et hakkarka hare ze toledet choresh umishsheyyaase kol shehu chayyav. vechen hammashve pene hassade kegon shehishpil hattel veriddedo o mille haggay chayyav mishshum choresh. veshiuro kol shehu. vechen kol hammashve gummot shiuro kol shehu: 
Hazzorea kol shehu chayyav. hazzomer et hailan kede sheyyitzmach hare ze meen zorea. aval hammashke tzemachin veilanot beshabbat hare ze toledet zorea vechayyav bechol shehu. vechen hashshore chittin useorin vechayyotze bahen bammayim hare ze toledet zorea vechayyav bechol shehu: 
Hakkotzer kigrogeret chayyav. vetolesh toledet kotzer hu. vechol haoker davar miggiddulo chayyav mishshum kotzer. lefichach tzeror shealu bo asavim ucheshut sheala bassene vaasavim shetztzamchu al gav hechavit. hattolesh mehen chayyav shezze hu mekom giddulan. aval hattolesh meatzitz sheeno nakuv patur mippene sheen ze mekom giddulo. veatzitz nakuv bichde shoresh katan hare hu keeretz vehattolesh mimmennu chayyav:
Niddah 20a:26-20b:4: Ki atu lekammeh derabba bar avu, amar lehu: bimkomah shaninu. rabbi chanina pale kureta degargishta uvadek beh, layet aleh rabbi yishmael berabbi yose beaskara.
Rabbi chanina hu dechakkim, kulle alma lav chakkimi hachi.

Amar rabbi yochanan: chuchmeta derabbi chanina gerama li dela echze dema, metammena — metahar, metaharna — metamme. amar rabbi elazar: invevtanuta derabbi chanina gerama li dachazay dema, uma rabbi chanina deinvetan hu — machet nafsheh lesafek vechaze, ana la echze?
Amar rabbi zera: tiva devavel gerama li dela chazay dema, deamena: betiva la yadana, bidma yadana?!
Lememra divtiva talya milleta? veha rabba hu deyada betiva, vela yada bidma! kol shekken kaamar: uma rabba deyada betiva — la chaza dema, vaana echze?!
Proverbs 25:16-21: Devash matzata echol dayyekka pen-tisbaennu vahaketo
Hokar raglecha mibbet reecha pen-yisbaacha useneecha
Mefitz vecherev vechetz shanun ish one vereehu ed shaker
Shen roa veregel muadet mivtach boged beyom tzara
Maade-beged ׀ beyom kara chometz al-nater veshar bashshirim al lev-ra {p}
Im-raev sonaacha haachilehu lachem veim-tzame hashekehu mayim
Proverbs 25:22-25: Ki gechalim atta chote al-rosho vaAdonai yeshallem-lach

Rav mecholel-kol vesocher kesil vesocher ovrim

Raita ish chacham beenav tikva lichsil mimmennu
Amar atzel shachal baddarech ari ben harchovot
Zohar, Achrei Mot 33: (Vayikra 16:29) vehayta lachem lechukkat olam bachodesh hashshevii beasor lachodesh teannu et nafshotechem vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Yeshayahu 26:9) nafshi ivviticha balayla af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka vegomer. nafshi ivviticha ballayla. nafshi ballayla mibbae leh, may nafshi ivviticha. af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka, yeshacharecha mibbae leh. ella hachi tana, kudesha berich hu rucha venafsha decholla, veyisrael amre nafshi veruchi annet. begin kach ivviticha leadbeka bach, vaashacharecha leashkecha reutach.

Ribbi yose amar, beshaata debar nash naim bearseh. nafka nafsheh, salka veashidat beh bebar nash, al kol ma daavad bechol yoma. gufa amar lenafsha, nafshi ivviticha ballayla, af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka.

Davar acher nafshi ivviticha, amra keneset yisrael kame kudesha berich hu, nafshi ivviticha ballayla, beod daana begaluta bene amamya, umenia nafshi mikkol bishata (nusach acher varevaynaa nafshi mikkol paysatea) dekutera bene amamya, nafshi ivviticha, begin leatava leatri. af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka, kelomar, af al gav deinnun meshabedin levanay, bechol shibuda, rucha kaddisha la itade minnay, begin lemishchar lach, ulemebad pikkudecha.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, amru yisrael kame kudesha berich hu, beod denafshi bi, ivviticha ballayla. may taama ballayla, ella begin dehay nefesh behay shaata, itzterich lechamda lach. af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka, kad ittear bi rucha kaddisha, ashacharekka beitaruta lemebad reutach. ki kaasher mishpatecha laaretz bezimna demishpat nachit beara, levasma alma, keden tzedek lamdu yoshve tevel. kelomar yachlin lemisbal dina detzedek, vela yishtetze alma minneh. ematay tzedek lamdu yoshve tevel, kaasher mishpatecha laaretz. rabbi chizkiyya amar, nafshi ivviticha ballayla, da keneset yisrael. af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka, da kudesha berich hu.

Ribbi abba hava yativ kameh deribbi shimon, kam ribbi shimon befalgu lelya, lemile beorayyta. kamu ribbi elazar veribbi abba immeh. patach ribbi shimon veamar, (Tehillim 42:2) keayyal taarog al afike mayim ken nafshi taarog elecha elohim. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay, zakkain innun yisrael mikkol ammin, dekudesha berich hu yahav lon orayyta kaddisha, veorit lon nishmatin kaddishin meatar kaddisha, begin lemebad pikkudoy, uleishtaasha beorayyta, dechol man deishtaasha beorayyta, la dachil mikkolla. dichtiv, (Tehillim 119:92) lule toratcha shaashuay az avadti veanyi.

Man innun shaashuay. orayyta. deorayyta shaashuim ikre, dichtiv, (Mishlei 8:30) vaehye shaashuim yom yom. veda hu detanenan, kudesha berich hu ate leishtashea im tzaddikayyay beginta deeden. may leishtashea. begin lemechde behu. detanenan, zakkain innun tzaddikayya, dichtiv behu, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, begin leitannega mehahu shakyu denachala, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 58:11) vehishbia betzachtzachot nafshecha. kivyachol, kudesha berich hu mishtaasha behu, mehahu shakyu denachala, demitannege behu tzaddikayyay. veal da ate leishtashea im tzaddikayyay. vechol man deishtedal beorayyta, zache leishtashea im tzaddikayyay, mehahu shakyu denachala.
Zohar, Achrei Mot 41: Ribbi yehuda patach, (Tehillim 130:1) shir hammaalot mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai. tanenan, beshaata devara kudesha berich hu alma, baa lemivre bar nash, amlich beorayyta, amra kammeh, tive lemivre hay bar nash, zammin hu lemechete kammach, zammin hu leargaza kammach. i taavid leh keovadoy, ha alma la yachil lemekam kammach, kol shekken hahu bar nash. amar leh, vechi lemaggana itkarina, (Shemot 34:6) el rachum vechannun erech appayim.

Vead la bara kudesha berich hu alma, bara teshuva, amar lah litshuva, ana baena lemivre bar nash bealma, al menat dechad yetuvun lach mechovehon, detehevi zemina lemishbak chovehon, ulechappera alayyhu. uvechol shaata veshaata teshuva zemina legabbe bene nasha, vechad bene nasha tayyvin mechovayyhu, hay teshuva tavat legabbe kudesha berich hu, vechipper al kolla, vedinin itkafyayn, umitbasseman kullehu, uvar nash itdache mechoveh.
Ematay itdache bar nash mechoveh beshaata deal behay teshuva kadka chaze. ribbi yitzchak amar, detav kame malka illaa, vetzalle tzelota meumeka delibba, hada hu dichtiv mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai.

Ribbi abba amar, mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai, atar ganiz hu leella, vehu amika (Shemot 63 amud bet) devera, umehay nafkin nachalin umabbuin lechol ivar, vehahu amika daamikta ikre teshuva. uman devae leatava uleitdakkea mechovoy, behay umeka itzterich lemikre lekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai.

Tana, beshaata dehava bar nash chav kame mareh, vekariv karbaneh al madbecha, vechahana mechapper aleh, uvae bauteh aleh, mitarin rachame, vedinin mitbasseman, uteshuva arik birchan, bemabbuin denagdin venafkin, umitbarchin kullehu butzinin kachada, uvar nash itdache mechoveh.

Ta chaze, kudesha berich hu, appik eser kitrin, itrin kaddishin leella, deitattar behu, umitlabbash behu, vehu innun, veinnun hu, keshalhova daachida begumera, velet tamman piruda. lokovel dena, it eser kitrin dela kaddishin letatta, veinnun achidan bezuhama detufera dechad itra kaddisha, deikre chachma. veal da ikrun chachmot.
Zohar, Achrei Mot 49: (Vayikra 18:4) et mishpatay taasu veet chukkotay tishmeru lalechet bahem vegomer, ribbi abba amar, zakkaa chulaka deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu itree behu mikkol ammin ovde avoda zara, uvegin rechimuta dileh alayyhu, yahiv lon nimusin dikshot, nata behu ilana dechayye, ashre shechinta benayyhu. may tama. begin deyisrael reshimin birshima kaddisha bivsarehon. veishtemodan deinhu dileh, (ishtemodan) mibbene hechaleh.

Uvegine kach, kol innun dela reshimin birshimu kaddisha bivsarehon lav innun dileh, veishtemodan dechullehu missitra dimsaavuta atyayn, veasir leitchabbera behu, uleishtae bahadayyhu, bemilloy dekudesha berich hu veasir leodaa lehu mille deorayyta, begin deorayyta kulla shema dekudesha berich hu, vechol at deorayyta, mitkashshera bishma kaddisha. vechol man dela itreshim birshima kaddisha bivsareh, asir leodaa leh milla deorayyta. vekol shekken leishtaddela (nusach acher leistakkela) beh.
Zohar, Achrei Mot 74: Amar ribbi shimon, ketiv (Yeshayahu 66:23) vehaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbat beshabbato, amay shakil da beda. ella kolla bechad darga seliku, da izdevvavg beda. vechedvavta deda beda la ishtechach, ella kad itgele attika kaddisha, ucheden chedvavta decholla. vetanenan, ketiv (Tehillim 92:1) mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat, leyom hashabbat mammash. shevacha deka meshabbach kudesha berich hu. keden chedavavta ishtechach, venishmeta ittosefet. deha attika itgele veziuuga yizdaman.

Uf hachi bechadtute sihara, deha nahir lah shimsha bechedvavta dinhiru deattika leella. begine kach hay karbena hu leella, begin deyitbesam kolla, veyishtekach chedvavta bealma, veal da haviu alay kappara, dayyka milla.

Tana, ketiv (Bamidbar 28:10) olat shabbat beshabbato al olat hattamid, devae lechavvevna libba leella leella, yattir mishshear yomin. veal da al olat hattamid dayyka. tanya, ketiv bechanna (Shmuel 1 1) vattitpallel al Adonai, al dayyka, begin divnin bemazzala kaddisha talyayn, kema deokimna velet lach milla beorayyta, o at zeera beorayyta. dela remiza bechachmeta illaa, vetalyayn minneh tile talin razin dechachmeta illaa, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim Adonai:11) kevutztzotav taltallim, veha ittemar.
Zohar, Mishpatim 3: Rabbi chiyyay verabbi yosi iarau chad lelya bemigdal detzor. itarachu tamman vechaddu da beda. amar rabbi yosi, kamma chaddena dachamena anpe shechinta, dehashta bechol archa da, itztaarna bachada sava, tayyaya, dehava shail li kol archa.

Man hu nechasha, defarach baavira, veazil befiruda, uven kach uven kach, it nayycha lechad nemala, deshachiv ben shinnoy. share bechibbura vesiyyem befiruda. umay ihu nishra, deka mekannena, beilan dela hava. benoy deitgezalu, velav min biryayn. deitberiu baatar dela itberiu. kad sallekin nachtin, kad nachtin sallekin. teren deinnun chad, vechad deinnun telata. mahu ulemta shappirta, velet lah eynin, vegufa temirta veitgalya, ihi nafkat betzafra, veitkassiat bimama. itkashtat bekishshutin dela havo.

Kol da shail bearcha, veitztaarna. vehasheta it li nayycha. deillu havena kachada, itasakna bemille deorayyta, ma dahavenan bemillin acharanin detohu. amar rabbi chiyyay, vehahu sava tayyaya, yadat beh kelum. amar leh, yadana, delet mammashu bemilloy. deillu hava yada, yiftach beorayyta, vela hava archa berekanayyay. amar rabbi chiyyay, vehahu tayyaya it hacha, deha lezimnin beinnun rekanin, yishkach gevar zaggin dedahava. amar leh, ha hacha ihu, veatkin chamareh bemechla.
Karu leh, veata lekamayyhu. amar lon, hasheta teren innun telat, utelat innun kechad. amar rabbi yosi, la amena lach, dechol milloy rekanin, veinnun berekanayyay, yativ kamayyhu.

Amar lon rabbanan, ana tayyaya itavidna, umiyyomin zeirin, deha bekadmita la havena tayyaya, aval bera chad zeira it li, veyahavit leh beve sifra, uvaena deyishtaddal beorayyta. vechad ana ashkachna chad merabbanan deazil bearcha, ana tain avatreh, vehay yoma, chashivna deeshma millin chadtin beorayyta, vela shemana midi.
Amar Rabbi yosi, bechol millin deshamana dekaamart, la tavavhna, ella mechad. o ant bishttuta amart, o millin rekanin innun. amar hahu sava, uman ihi. amar ulemta shappirta vechulei.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Tehillim 118:6-7) Adonai li la ira ma yaase li adam. Adonai li beozray vegomer. tov lachasot baAdonai vegomer. kamma tavin uneimin veyakkirin veillain millin deorayyta, vaana hechi ema kame rabbanan, dela shemana mippumayyhu ad hasheta, afillu milla chada. aval it li lememar, deha let kissufa kelal lememar mille deorayyta kame kolla.

Itattaf hahu sava, patach veamar, (Vayikra 22:12) uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel. hay kera, akra achara samich, (Vayikra 22:13) uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha vezera en lah veshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel vechol zar lo yochal bo. hane kerae kemashmaan. aval millin deorayyta millin setimin innun

Vechamma innun millin dechachmeta distimin bechol milla umilla deorayyta, veishtemodan, innun legabbe chakkimin, deyadin archin deorayyta. deha orayyta lav millin dechelma innun, deka itmasran leman defashar lon, veitmashshechan batar puma, veim kol da itzterichu lemifshar lon lefum archoy. uma i millin dechelma itzterichu lemifshar lon lefum archoy, millin deorayyta deinnun shaashuin demalka kaddisha, al achat kamma vechamma deitzterichu lemehach beorach keshot behu, dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vegomer.

Hasheta it lememar, uvat kohen, da nishmeta illaa, berateh deavraham avinu kadmaa laggiyyorin, veihu mashich, lah lehay nishmeta meatar illaa. ma ben kera deamar uvat ish kohen, uven kera deamar uvat kohen, vela ketiv ish. ella, it kohen deikre ish kohen, velo kohen mammash. veal archa da, hava (ish) kohen, vahava segan, vahava kohen gadol, vahava kohen delav ihu gadol. kohen setam, rav veillaa yattir meish kohen. veal da it nishmeta, veit rucha, veit nefesh.

Uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar, da nishmeta kaddisha, deitmashshechat meatar illaa, vealat lego setimu deilana dechayye. vechad rucha dechahana illaa nashva, veyahiv nishmatin beilana da, parchin mittamman innun nishmatin, vealin beotzar chad.

Vavy lealma, dela yadin bene nasha leistammera, deka mashchin meshichu bahade yetzer hara, deihu ish zar, vehay bat kohen parchat letatta, veashkechat binyayna beish zar. uvegin deihu reuta demara, alat tamman veitkafiat, vela yachilat leshalletaa, vela ishtallimat behay alma. kad nafkat minneh, hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel, kishar kol nishmatin, deishtelimu behay alma.

Tu it behay kera, uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar. aluvata ihi nishmeta kaddisha, ki tihye leish zar, deka itmashshechat, al giyyora deitgeyayr, ufarchat aleh miggan eden beorach satim, al binyayna deitbeni mearla misava, da havat leish zar.

Veda hu raza illaa yetera mikkolla. beammuda dekayyeyma letiklin, go avira denashvat, it tikla chada behay sitra, veit tikla achara behay sitra. behay sitra mozni tzedek. uvehay sitra mozne mirma. vehay tikla, la shachich lealmin, venishmatin sallekin venachtin alin vetavin, veit nishmatin ashikin, kad shalta adam beadam, dichtiv, (Kohelet 8:9) et asher shalat haadam beadam lera lo, lera lo vadday.

Aval hay nishmeta, dahavat lesitra achara, ish zar, veitashshekat minneh, da ihi lera lo. lo: lehahu ish zar, veihi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel, ad deavid bah kudesha berich hu ma deavid, ata kera veamar uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hachi hu.

Hacha it raza, hech mitashshekan nishmatin. ella hay alma itnehag kolla, beilana dedaat tov vara. vechad itnahagan bene alma besitra detov, tikla kayyeyma veachra lesitra detov. vechad itnahagan besitra dera, achra lehahu sitra. vechol nishmatin dahavo behahi shaata betikla, hava ashik lon, venatil lon.

Aval lera lo, deinnun nishmatin kafyayn (sefer acher chafyayn) lechol ma deashkechan missitra bisha, veshaytzan leh. vesimana leda, arona kaddisha, deitashak go pelishtim, ushelitu beh, lera lon. uf hachi. hane nishmatin iteshakin missitra achara lera lon.

Ma itavidu meinnun nishmatin. chamenan besifre kadmae, deminnayyhu havo innun chaside umot haolam. veinnun mamzere talmide chachamim, dekadman lechahana rabba amma deara, vechashuv bealma, af al gav deal lifnay velifnim. bacha hay sava riga chada, tavvhu chavrayyay, vela amru midi.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Shemot 21:8) im raa beene adonyha asher lo yeadah vehefdah leam nachri vegomer. hay parsheta al raza da ittemar, vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama lo tetze ketzet haavadim im raa vegomer. mareh dealma man la yidchal minach, deant shalit al kol malchin dealma, kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 10:7) mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim ki lecha yaata vegomer.

Kamma innun bene nasha bealma, deka mishtabbeshan behay kera, vechullehu amri, aval kera da la ityayshshar befumayyhu. vechi kudesha berich hu melech haggoyim ihu, vahalo melech yisrael ihu, vehachi ikre, deha ketiv, (Devarim 32) behanechel elyon goyim vegomer. uchetiv (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo. veal da ikre melech yisrael. vei tema deihu melech haggoyim ikre, ha shevacha dilhon dekudesha berich hu melech alayyhu, vela kema deamrin deitmasrin leshammashin velimmanan dileh.

Vetu sefa dikra, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 10:7) ki bechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam meen kamocha. kol hay, shevacha ihu lishar ammin, utevavha ihu, hech la mistalleke behay kera lerum rekia. ella, dekudesha berich hu sama enayyhu, vela yade beh kelal, deha ma daanan amre dechullehu ayin, vaefes, vatohu. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:17) kol haggoyim keayin negdo meefes vatohu nechshevu lo, ha ikara illaa rabba veyakkira shave lon kera da.

Amar leh Rabbi chiyyay veha ketiv (Tehillim 47:9) malach elohim al goyim vegomer. amar leh, ana chamena devatar kotlayyhu havit, venafkat behay kera lesayyeya lon, hava li leatava bekadmita, al ma daamena. aval kevan deashkachna lach bearcha, abar lach mittamman, umittamman ehach leabera kolla.

Ta chaze, kol shemahan, vechol kinnuyayn dishmahan, deit leh lekudesha berich hu, kullehu mitpashshetan learchayyhu, vechullehu mitlabbeshin illen beillen, vechullehu mitpalgin learchin ushevilin yedian. bar shema yechidaa, barir dechol shear shemahan, deachasin leamma yechidaa, barir mikkol shear ammin, veihu yod hei vav hei, dichtiv, (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo. uchetiv (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai bishma da mammash, yattir mikkol shear shemahan.

Ushema chad mikkol shear shemahan dileh, hahu deitpeshat veitpelag lechamma archin ushevilin, veikre elohim. veachasin shema da, veitpelag letattae dehay alma, veitpelag shema da, leshammashin velimmanan dimnahage lishar ammin. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 22:20) vayyavo elohim el bilam layla. (Bereshit 20:3) vayyavo elohim el avimelech bachalom hallayla. vechen kol memana umemanna deachasin lon kudesha berich hu lishar ammin, bishma da kelilan. vaafillu avoda zara bishma da ikre. ushema da malach al goyim, vela hahu shema, da hahu demalach al yisrael, deihu yechidaa, leamma yechidaa, leamma deyisrael, amma kaddisha.

Vei tema, al archa da nokim kera dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 10:7) mi la yiraacha melech haggoyim, deda ihu shema deka malach al goyim, elohim deha dechilu beh sharya vedina beh sharya. lav hachi, velav al da ittemar, dei hachi afillu avoda zara bichlala da ihu.

Aval kevan dechotala dahavet samich avatreh, itnesach, kera kaim al kiyyuma, beistakkeluta zeer. mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim, vei tema demelech haggoyim al kudesha berich hu ittemar, lav hachi. ella, man hu melech haggoyim dela yiraacha, dela dachil minach, vela yizdaza minach. mi melech haggoyim dela yiraacha. kegavvna da (Tehillim 113:1) haleluyah halelu avde Adonai halelu et shem Adonai. man dishma leh, la yada may kaamar, kevan deamar haleluyah, uf hachi halelu avde Adonai, dehava leh lemichtav, avde Adonai halelu et shem Adonai. uf hacha. hava leh lemichtav, mi mimmelech haggoyim dela yiraacha. ella kolla al tekkuneh ittemar.

Ki vechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam meen kamocha, mahu milla deitpashshat benayyhu bechachmeta dillehon, meen kamocha vechullehu odan al da, kad chaman bechachmeta dilhon ovadach ugevuretach, itpashat milla da benayyhu, veamre meen kamocha bechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam. meen kamocha amre, veitpashshat benayyhu. chaddu chavrayyay, uvachu vela amru midi. uf hachi bacha ihu kemillekaddemin.

Patach veamar (Bereshit 21:10) vattomer leavraham garesh haama hazzot veet benah vegomer, chavrayyay ittearu, devaat sara lefannaa avoda zara mibbeta, veal da ketiv kol asher tomar elecha sara shema bekolah. hacha ketiv vechi yimkor ish et bitto, da nishmeta begilgule al ovadin bishin dealma. leama: hahu sitra achara begilgula bisha detikla, deahadar, veha itashshekat, leappaka lah mittamman. vadday lo tetze ketzet haavadim, kol innun nishmatin demitashshekan.

Man innun hacha. ihu raza, illen innun nishmatin dinokin zeirin, kad innun yanke miggo tukepa deimmehon. vekudesha berich hu chame, dei yitkayyeymun bealma, yevaashun rechehon, veyachmetzun kechometz da. lakit lon (248 amud bet, 249 amud bet) zeirin, beod deyahave recha.

Ma avid. shavik lon leitashsheka bida dehahi ama, veda ihi lilit dechevan deityeyhivu birshutah, chaddat (nusach acher achada) behahu yenoka, vaashikat leh, veappikat leh mealma, kad ihu yanik betukepa deimmeh.

Vei tema, innun nishmatin deyaavdun tav lealma. lav hachi. dichtiv im raa beene adoneha, deyachamitz hahu gavra bah levatar yomin, i itkayyaym bah. da itashkat, veachara la itashshekat. veal illen ketiv, (Kohelet 4:1) vaere et kol haashukim vegomer vehayeynu im raa beene adoneha.
Asher lo yeadah, lo bealef ketiv. i tema, deha behahu sitra achara, azmin lah kudesha berich hu miyyoma dahavat. la. vehasheta begilgule tikla, lo yeadah beVav. ma dela havat mikkadmat dena.

Vehefdah, may vehefdah. parik lah kudesha berich hu hasheta, desalleka recha, ad la tachamitz, vesalik lah lerume meromim, (113 amud bet) bimtivta dileh, vei tema kevan deitashshekat mehahu sitra achara, yahiv lah, kema deamru lachaside (205 amud bet) shear ammin, uleinnun mamzere ta chaze. ata kera veochach, leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah vadday, bevigdo vah, deashik lah baashiku degilgula detikla, ella leyisrael vadday, vela leachara. vechad nafkat min tikla, lo tetze ketzet haavadim, ella mitattera beitteraha baarama al resheh.

Vei tema, dehay sitra alat lah behahu yannuka. lav hachi. ella natlat lah, vechaddat bahadah, ufarchat min yedaha, vealat behahu atar, veihi pekidat lehahu yenoka, vechaddat beh, vechayyeychat beh, vetaivat (58, 65 amud alef) lehahu basar, ad dilvatar natil kudesha berich hu nishmateh, vehi legufa. ulevatar kolla ihu birshuta dekudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, (Shemot 21:7) lo tetze ketzet haavadim, may hu. ella, beshaata denafkat min tikla vehahu sitra bechedu, rashim lah lekudesha berich hu, vechatim lah bechad gushepanka, ufaris alah levush yekar dileh, uman ihu. shema kaddisha deikre eloah. veda hu bevigdo vah, levusha yakkira demalka paris alah ucheden ihi netira, dela itmasserat leam nachri, ella leyisrael lechud.

Veda ihu dichtiv, (iyyov 29:2) kime eloah yishmereni, veal raza da ketiv hacha, leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah bevigdo vah, beod dilvush yekar demalka bah. kevan (Bereshit 94 amud alef, Shemot 172 amud bet, Vayikra amud bet amud bet) devigdo vah, ketiv leam nachri lo yimsol lemachrah.

Ma reshu it lehahu sitra bah. ta chaze, kol bene alma kullehu, birshuteh demalka kaddisha, vechullehu it lon zimna behay alma, ad deihu bae lesalleka lon min alma, veda let leh zimna, veal da ihi chayychat behu, vechaddat behu.

Tu, azharuta levar nash (behay alma) it behane kerae, vechamma etin tavin illain innun, bechol mile deorayyta, vechullehu keshot, beorach keshot, veishtemodan legabbe chakkimin, deyade veazle beorach keshot. bezimna devaa kudesha berich hu lemivre alma, salik biruta kameh, vetziyyer kol nishmatin deinnun zeminin lemehav bivni nasha levatar, vechullehu ittzeyyayru kameh behahu tziyyura mammash, dizminin lemeheve bivni nasha levatar, vechama kol chad vechad.

Veit minnehon dizminin leavasha archayyhu bealma, uveshaata demata zimnayyhu, kare kudesha berich hu lehahi nishmeta, amar lah, zili uli bedoch pelan. beguf pelan. ativat kameh, mareh dealma, day li bealma da daana yatva beh, vela ehach lealma achara, deyishtabedun bi, veehe meluchelcha benayyhu. amar lah kudesha berich hu, min yoma deitberiat, al da itberiat lemehve behahu alma. kevan dechamat nishmeta kach, beal karchah nachtat vealat tamman.

Orayyta deyahivat eta lechol alma chamat hachi, azhirat livne alma, veamrat, chamu kamma chas kudesha berich hu alayychu, margalita tava dahavat leh, zabbin lechu lemaggana, detishtabedun bah behay alma.

Vechi yimkor ish: da kudesha berich hu. et bitto: da nishmeta kaddisha. leama: lemeheve ama mishtabeda benayychu behay alma. bematu minnayychu, beshaata demate zimna lenafka mehay alma, lo tetze ketzet haavadim, la tippuk mittannefa bechovin, tippuk bat chorin, berira nekiyya, begin deyechede bah marah veyishtabbach bah veyahiv lah agar tav, betzichtzuche deginta deeden. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 58:11) vehishbia betzachtzachot nafshecha, vadday kad tippuk berira nekiyya kedka yeot.

Aval im raa beeni adoneha, kad nafkat meluchelacha betinufe chovin, vela itchaziat kameh kedka yeot, vavy lehahu gufa, deitavid mehahi nishmeta lealmin. begin, dechad nishmatin sallekin beriran, venafkin nekiyyin mehay alma, kol nishmeta venishmeta, alat besifra (338 156 amud bet) deachmata demalka, vechullehu bishmahan, veamar da hi nishmeta diflanya, zeminat tehe lehahu gufa deshavkat, ucheden ketiv, lo yeadah, bev.

Vechad nafkat raa beene adoneha, deka isteava bechovin, uvetinnufa dechattain, keden lo yeadah be. veitavid hahu gufa minah veihi la izdammenat legabbeh bar hahi demarah itree, vetav betiuveta degufa bah, keden ketiv, vehefda. kema deat amer (iyyov log) fada nafsho meavor bashshachat. vehefdah, hay ihu bevar nash, deeta dileh, deyifrok lah, veyetuv betiuveta, velitren sitrin kaamar kudesha berich hu, vehefdah betiuveta. levatar detav betiuveta, pada lah mearcha degehinnam.

Leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah. man am nachri. aluvata ihi nishmeta, dechad nafkat mealma, uvar nash aste archeh bahadah, hi baat lesalleka leella, go mashreyayn kaddishin, begin demashreyayn kaddishin kayymin behahu archa degan eden, umashreyayn nucherain kayymin behahu archa degehinnam.

Zachta nishmeta, vehahu netiru, uferisu dilvusha yakkira alah. kamma mashreyayn kaddishin, ka mitattedan lah, leitchabbera bahadah, ulemeal lah legan eden. lo zachta, kamma mashyyryan nucherain mitattedan lemeal lah bearcha degehinnam. veinnun mashreyayn demalache chabbala zeminin lemebad bah nukemin, ata kera veochach, leam nachri lo yimsol lemachrah, illen malache chabbala. bevigdo vah, ihu netira, dekudesha berich hu avid lah netira, dela yishlot bah am nachri, behahu perisu dintiru alla.

(Shemot 21:9) veim livno yiadenna, ta chaze kamma it leh lebar nash leizdahara dela yiste archoy behay alma, dei zacha bar nash behay alma, venatir lah lenishmeta kedka yeot, hay ihu bar nash dekudesha berich hu itree beh, veishtavach beh bechol yomayya, befamalyay dileh, veamar, chamu bera kaddisha deit li behahu alma, kach vechach avid, kach vechach ovadoy mittakkenan.

Vechad hay nishmeta, nafkat mehay alma, zachyay nekiyyay berira, kudesha berich hu anhir lah bechamma nehorin, bechol yoma kare alah, da hi nishmeta diflanya beri, netira lihavi leh lehahu gufa deshavak.

Veda hu dichtiv, veim livno yiadenna kemishpat habbanot yaase lah, may kemishpat habbanot. hacha it raza lechakkimin, bego tinara takkifa, rekia temira, it hechala chada, deikre hechal ahava. (146 amud alef) vetamman innun ginzin temirin, vechol neshikin dirchimu demalka innun tamman, veinnun nishmatin rechiman demalka alin tamman.

Kevan demalka al behahu hechala demalka, tamman ketiv, (Bereshit 29:11) vayyishshak yaakov lerachel, vekudesha berich hu ashkach tamman lehahi nishmeta kaddisha, kadim miyyad venashik lah, vegafif lah, vesalik lah bahadeh, veishtaasha bah.

Veda hu kemishpat habbanot yaase lah, kedina deabba avid livrateh, deihi chaviva legabbeh, denashik lah, vegafif lah, veyahiv lah matnan. kach kudesha berich hu avid, lenishmeta zakkaa bechol yoma, kema dechtiv kemishpat habbanot yaase lah.

Hayeynu dechtiv (Yeshayahu 64:3) yaase limchakke lo, kema dehay berata, ashlimat asiyyay behay alma. uf hachi kudesha berich hu ashlim lah asiyyay achara bealma deate, dechtiv, ayin la raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo. vehacha ketiv yaase lah. al ken. hahu sava ishtattach, vetzalle tzelota. bacha kemilkaddemin.

Veamar (Shemot 21:10) im acheret yikkach lo vegomer, may im acheret, vechi nishmeta achara zammin kudesha berich hu leatava letzaddikayyay behay alma, velav hay nishmeta deashlimat behay alma reuta demarah, i hachi let avtachuta letzaddikayyay kelal. may im acheret yikkach lo.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Kohelet 12:7) veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay, becharban be makdesha. (vetamman tanenan) veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya. hacha ihu may dechtiv, (Bereshit 12:6) vehakkenaani az baartz, keshehaya vadday. veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah, may veharuach tashuv. da shechinta, deihi ruach kaddisha. kad chamat shechinta, beinun eser massaot deka natla, vela baun yisrael leatava bityuveta kame kudesha berich hu, veshalta sitra achara al ara kaddisha, veukemuha chavrayyay.

Ta chazi, rucha devar nash zakkaa, itattar bediyyukena began eden diltatta, uvechol shabbate umoade vereshe yarche, mitatteran ruche, umitpashshetan, vesallekin leella. kemma deavid kudesha berich hu, behahi nishmeta illaa kaddisha leella, hachi name avid behay rucha, letatta began eden letatta, deka salkat kameh. veamar da ihi rucha diflanya gufa, miyyad meattera lah kudesha berich hu lehay rucha bechamma itrin, veishtaasha bah.
Vei tema, deha begin rucha da, shavik kudesha berich hu ma deavid lenishmeta. lav hachi. ella sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra, illen innun telat shemahan illain, deayin la raata elohim zulatcha.

Vechullehu bealma deate veitmashshechu mittamman. chad minnayyhu sheerah, meshichu dintzitzu unehiru, denahir beorach satim, mezona (lan) dezan kolla, veikre Adonai binkudat elohim. sheerah behippuch atvavn, asher Adonai veda (Bereshit 49:20) measher shemmena lachmo, veda hu sheerah.
Kesutah: perisu demalka. da meshichu achara, denahir venatir lah tadir, ferisu dilvusha demalka, defaris alah eloah. da bevigdo vah tadir, dela itade minnah, vehay ihu kesutah.

Veonatah, man ihu. da meshichu dealma deate, deveh kolla. Adonai tzevaot ihu, veda ihu denahir bechol nehorin setimin illain deilana dechayye, deveh ona temira, demittamman nafkat. vechol da beidduna vechissufa dealma deate.

Telata hane lo yigra lah, kad ihi zakkat kaddeka yeut. vei lav ihi kadka yeut, hane telata garan minah, dela yitavid lah attara afillu mechad minnayyhu, ta chazi, ma ketiv, veim shelash elle lo yaase lah, dela zachat behu, veyatza chinnam en kasef tippuk mikkameh, vedachyayn lah levar. en kasef, let lah kissufa, velet lah idduna kelal.

Ad kan ochichat orayyta, dechol etin bah talyayn, veyahivat eta tava livni nasha. mikkan ulehala nehdar lemillin kadmain, behahu netiru illaa, deka paris alah kudesha berich hu, begin dela tehe leam nachri, deha bigdo vah, unetiru ihu lah tadir.

(Shemot 21:9) veim livno yiadenna kemishpat habbanot yaase lah. amar hahu sava, chavrayyay, kad tahachun legabbe hahu tinara dealma samich aleh, imru leh, deyidkar yoma detalga deizderau polin lechamshin uteren gavvnin, vahadar akrenan hay kera, vehu yema lechon.

Amru bematu minach man deshari milla hu yema. amar lon, vadday deyadana dezakkain attun, veit lerammeza lechun remaza dechakkimin, veal ma daana ema, kad tidkerun leh simana da, hu yashlim al da. hasheta it lomar, man hu deikre ben lekudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze kol hahu dezache (101 amud alef, 113 amud alef) litlesar shenin ulehala, ikre ben likkeneset yisrael. vechol man deihu mibben esrin shenin uleela vezache behu, ikre ben lekudesha berich hu vadday (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem.

Kad mata david litlesar shenin, vezacha behahu yoma deal learbesar, keden ketiv, (Tehillim 2:7) Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha. may tama. deha mikkadmat dena la hava leh bera, vela sharat aleh nishmeta illaa, deha bishne arla hava, uvegin kach, (128 amud bet) ani hayyom yelidticha, hayyom vadday yelidticha. ani, vela sitra achara, kema dehava ad hasheta, ani bilchoday. bar esrin shenin, ma ketiv bishlomo, (Mishlei 4:3) ki ven hayiti leavi, leavi mammash vadday.

Veim livno yiadenna. bar telesar shenin ulehala, deha nafka mershu desitra achara deizdammenat leh, ma ketiv kemishpat habbanot yaase lah. mahu kemishpat habbanot. tanenan, bechol yoma veyoma, chame kudesha berich hu lehahu yenoka dekae birshu dearla, veihu nafik minah, veitmeshach leve sifra, vetabbar lah, veazil leve kenishta, vetabbar lah. ma avid kudesha berich hu lehahi nishmeta. ail lah leiddara dileh, veyahiv lah mattenan, unevizbezan saggiin, vekashit lah bekishshutin illain, ad zimna deail (Bereshit 147 amud bet) lah lachuppa behahu (go hahu) bar, mittelesar shenin uleela.

Im acheret yikkach lo. hacha it raza derazin, lechakkimin itmesare, veit leodaa bekadmita milla chada. ta chaze, beyoma deshabbeta beshaata deitkaddash yome, nafke nishmatin miggo ilani dechayye, umenashshevan innun nishmatin kaddishin letattae, venayychin behu kol yoma deshabbeta. ulevatar denafik shabbeta, sallekin kullehu nishmatin umitatteran beitrin kaddishin leella. (vechad mitatteran behahu tava illen inun bealav dehahu tivu vadday) uf hachi, kudesha berich hu azmin lehahu bar nash, veda hu nishmeta acheret, veaf al gav deda zemina leh, nishmeta dahavat leh bekadmita, sheerah dekadmeta, kesutah veonatah lo yigra, kema deittemar.

Bacha hahu sava kemilkaddemin, veamar ihu lenafsheh, sava sava, kamma yagata leadbeka millin kaddishin illen, vehasheta tema lon beriga chada. i tema detechas alayyhu al innun millin vela tema lon, ha ketiv (Mishlei 3:27) al timna tov mibbealav bihyot leel yadcha laasot.

May al timna tov mibbealav. ella, kudesha berich hu ukkenset yisrael innun hacha. deha bechol atar demillin deorayyta amrin, kudesha berich hu ukkenset yisrael innun taman, vetzayyte lon. ucheden, hahu ilana detov vara, beshaata deazlin mittamman, vetzayytu innun millin, hahu sitra detov itgabbar, veistallak leella, vekudesha berich hu ukkenset yisrael mitatteran behahu tov, veillen innun bealav dehahu tov.

Sava sava, at amart millin illen, vela yadat i kudesha berich hu hacha, vei illen dekayyme hacha zakkain lemillin illen. la tidchal sava, deha havet bechamma keravin degavrin takkifin, vela dachilat, vehasheta ant dachil, ema milach, deha vadday hacha ihu kudesha berich hu ukkenset yisrael, vezakkain innun illen dehacha. vei lav hachi, la aarana behu, vela sharena beillen millin. ema millulach sava, ema bela dechilu.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 104:1) Adonai elohay gadalta meod hod vehadar lavashta. Adonai elohay: (9 amud alef, 216 amud bet) da sheruta dimhemnuta, seliku demachashava, vealma deate, raza chada bela piruda. gadalta: da sheruta, yoma kadmaa, veinnun yomin attikin, sitra dimina. meod: da (68 amud bet) hu sitra dismala.

Hod vehadar lavashta: illen teren badde (vaychi 222) aravot. ad hacha, kevan demata lego ilana dechayye, ittammar, vela istallak (sefer acher velo bae) lemeheve beminyayna, begin hahu meod. may meod. semala, dechol anpin diltatta uvichlala anafa merira chada. veal da ittammar hahu ilana dechayye, vela baa lemehevi beminyayna da, ad deahadar kemillekaddemin, veshabbach begavvna achara.

Veamar, ote or kassalma da sheruta (deor) deyoma kadmaa. note shamayim, hacha itkelil semala, vela amar meod, itkelil semala bimina, lemehve nahir bichlala deshamayim. (Tehillim 104:3) hamekare vammayim aliyyotav, hacha nafik bechedva hahu ilana dechayye, nahar denafik meeden, veishterashu beh bememoy innun tere badde aravot, deinnun gadlin bememoy, hada hu dichtiv (nusach acher hahu ilana dechayye veishterashu beh inun tere badde aravot, deinnun gadlin bememoy vehahu naheraz denafik meeden veda hu) hamekare vammayim aliyyotav. man aliyyotav. illen badde aravot.

Veda hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:8) veal yuval yeshallach sharashav. veda hu raza dichtiv, (Tehillim 46:5) nahar pelagav yesamchu ir elohim. man pelagav. illen innun sharashav. vehachi ikrun, aliyyotav, sharashav, pelagav, kullehu ishterashu beinnun mayin dehahu nahar.

(Tehillim 104:3) hassam avim rechuvo. da michael vegavriel, illen hem avim. hamehallech al kanfe ruach, lemehav asvavta lealma, veda ihu refael. mikkan ulehala ose malachav ruchot vegomer. sava sava, i kol hane yadat, ema vela tidchal, ema milach veyinharun millin defumach. chaddu chavrayyay, vahavu tzayytin bechedva lemilloy kaddishin. amar i sava i sava, bema ayylat garmach, alat beyamma rabba, it lach leshatteta velnafka mittamman.

(Shemot 21:10) im acheret yikkach lo, kamma gilgulin attikin hacha, dela itgallun ad haiddana, vechullehu keshot kedka yeot, delet leastaa meorach keshot, afillu kimlo nima. bekadmita (nusach acher hasheta) it leitteara, (95 amud bet) nishmatin degiyyorin kullehu, parchan miggo ginta deeden beorach satim, kad mistallekan mehay alma, nishmathon deka revavcha miggo ginta deeden, lean atar tayyvin.

Ella tanenan, man denatil veachid benichse giyyorin bekadmita, zache behu. uf hachi kol innun nishmatin kaddishin illain, deka zammin lon kudesha berich hu letatta kidkamran, kullehu nafkin lezimnin yedian. (vesallekin) (Bereshit 35 amud bet) begin leishtashea began eden, (dilella) ufagan beinnun nishmatin degiyyorin, man deachid behu meillen nishmatin, (desallekin) achid behu vezache behu, umitlabbeshan behu, vesallekin. vechullehu kayyme behay levusha venachtu go ginta bilvusha da. begin divginta deeden, la kayyeyman tamman, ella bilvusha, kol innun dekayyme tamman.

I tema, divgin hay levusha, garan innun nishmatin mikkol innuga dehava lon bekadmita. ha ketiv, im acheret yikkach lo sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra. beginta kayyme bilvushe da, dekadman leachada behu vezache behu, vechad sallekin leella, mitpashshetan minneh, deha tamman la kayyman (186 amud bet, 210 amud bet, 229, 50, 58, 67) bilvusha.

Bacha hahu sava kemillekaddemin, veamar lenafsheh, sava sava, bevadday it lach lemivke, bevadday it lach leoshada dimin, al kol milla umilla, aval galle kame kudesha berich hu ushechinteh kaddisha, daana biru delibba, uvefulechana dilhon kamena, begin deinnun bealav dechol milla, umitatteran behu.

Kol innun nishmatin kaddishin, kad nachte lehay alma, begin lemishre kol chad al duchetayyhu, deitchazun behu, livni nasha. kullehu nachte mitlabbeshan beinnun nishmatin deka amaran, vehachi alin vezara kaddisha. uvemalbusha da, kayyme leishtabeda minnayyhu behay alma. vechad ishtaavan innun malbushin mimmillin dehay alma, innun nishmatin kaddishin, itteznan (nusach acher ithanun) merecha deka aricha, miggo levushehon illen.

Kudesha berich hu kol millin setimin deihu avid, al lon beorayyta kaddisha, vecholla ishtechach beorayyta, vehahi milla setima galle lah orayyta, umiyyad itlabbesha bilvusha achara, veittammar tamman, vela itgele. vechakkimin deinnun malyayn ayynin, af al gav dehahi milla astim bilvusha (tamman), chaman lah miggo levusha, uveshaata deitgele hahi milla ad la teul bilvusha, raman bah pekichu deena, veaf al gav demiyyad astim, la itavid meenayyhu. (nusach acher minnayyhu)
Bechamma duchetin azhar kudesha berich hu al giyyora, (begin) dezara kaddisha, yizdaharun beh, ulevatar nafik milla setima minnartikah. vechevan deitgele ahdar lenartikah miyyad, veitlavash tamman.

Kevan deazhar al giyyora bechol innun duchetin, nafak milla minnartikah veitgele, veamar (Shemot 23:9) veattem yedatem et nefesh hager. miyyad alat lenartikah, veahadrat bilvusha veittammerat, dichtiv ki gerim hyitem beeretz mitzrayim, dechashiv kera, divgin deitlebash miyyad, la hava man deashgach bah. behay nefesh hager, yadat nishmeta kaddisha bemillin dehay alma, veithaniat (vaashateabet) minnayyhu.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Shemot 24:18) vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal el hahar vegomer, anan da may hi. ella da hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:13) et kashti natatti beanan. tanenan, dehahu keshet ashlachat levushoy, veyahiv lon lemoshe, (229 amud alef) uvehahu levusha salik moshe letura uminneh chama ma dechama, veithane mikkolla. ad hahu atar, atu innun chavrayyay, veishtetachu kameh dehahu sava, uvachu veamru, ilmale la atena lealma, ella lemishma millin illen mippumach day lan.

Amar hahu sava, (im acheret yikkach lo) chavrayyay, lav begin da bilchodoy sharena milla, deha sava kegini, lav bemilla chada avid kish kish, vela kare, kamma bene alma beirbuveya besachletanu dilhon, vela chaman beorach keshot beorayyta, veorayyta kare bechol yoma binhimu (nusach acher birchimu) legabbayyhu, (divne nasha) vela baan leatava resha.

Veaf al gav daamena, deha orayyta milla nafka minnartikah, veitchaziat zeer, umiyyad ittammarat. hachi hu vadday. uvezimna deitgeliat miggo nartikah veittammerat miyyad, la avdat da, ella leinun deyadin bah, veishtemodan bah.
