(Vayikra 6 amud alef, 22 amud bet) boker hu nahar. uf hachi, etan haezrachi, ezrach, hu avraham. etan, kema deittemar, da hahu nahar denaged venafik meeden.

Hasheta sava, kum kaim al retichach, dehashta tinpol vela tichul lemekam. ha shelomo malka, ate becheloy uretichoy vegavroy ufarashoy, veate lokovlach, kum pok min chakla, dela yishkach lach tamman. ketiv (Melachim 1 8:2) vayyikkahalu el hammelech shelomo kol ish yisrael beyerach haetanim bechag vegomer. yerach deityelidu beh haetanim, uman innun. avahan, veinnun etane olam. vayyarach da, ihu tishre. dealfa beta ahdar lemafrea mittatta leella.

Vetu mimmillach, yeot detippok min chakla, vela tishtechach tamman. ilu ketiv maskil etan haezrachi kidkaamart. hasheta dichtiv maskil leetan haezrachi. let keravach kelum, vetippok min chakla, beal karchach vela titchaze tamman.

I sava anya miskena, hechi teppok. i hachi, yintzechun lach vetaarok min chakla, kol bene alma yirdefun avatrach, velet lach anpin leitchazaa kame bar nash lealmin. hacha omena, dela ippok min chakla, vehacha itchaze anpin beanpin bishlomo malka, vechol ish yisrael, veguverin ufarashin uretichin dileh. kudesha berich hu yesayyea lach sava, deha lae chela ant. kum sava itgabbar bechelach veittakkaf, dead yoma da havet gibbar takkif beguverin.

Patach veamar, maskil leetan haezrachi. ellu ketiv maskil ledavid, kidkaamart, aval maskil leetan, it maskil veit maskil. it maskil leella, veit maskil (Bereshit 16 amud bet) letatta. maskil leetan bezimna dehahu nahar, kam betiuveta kol shayyfin chadan umitchabberan legabbeh, vei hu salik, ad democha illaa itpayyays legabbeh, vechadde lokovleh. ucheden maskil leetan haezrachi, maskil leh, veoda leh al yeda deavraham (sefer acher al yedoy deavraham) rechimoy, kol ma deitzterich, vehahu mocha illaa maskil leetan. vechad david malka, ittakkan betiuveta legabbeh, ihu maskil ledavid. kema dehava mocha illaa, maskil leh. veal da, it maskil, veit maskil. (it maskil).
Beyerach haetanim, deityelidu beha yerach etanim, binyana letatta ihu kegavvna dilella, veityelidu beh harim veetanim. harim setimin. etanim: yarchin takkifin kinchasha, vehahu etan benayyhu.

Kum sava, have mache lechol sitrin, beshaata desalik moshe lekabbela orayyta, masar leh kudesha berich hu shivin maftechan deorayyta. kad mata letisha (veshittin) vechamshin, hava chad maftecha ganiz vesatim, dela hava masar leh, itchannan lekameh. amar leh, moshe, kol maftechan illain vetattain behay maftecha talyayn. amar lekammeh, mareh dealma, ma shemeh. amar leh etan. vechol innun etanim beh talyayn, uveh kayyman levar miggufa detora shebbichtav ihu. oda leh, umaskil leh, ihu ikara umaftecha detora shebbichtav.

Vechad ittaknat tora shebbeal pe legabbeh, ikara dehechala hu maftecha (Bereshit 37 amud bet) dilah, (legabbeh) vadday keden maskil ledavid. umiggo (118 amud bet) deyarta tora shebbeal pe, (legabbeh) atvavn lemafrea. al da ikre tishre 900 ihu, aval begin deihu raza dishma kaddisha chatim beh kudesha berich hu, at dishmeh 10. bammizbeach, chatim beh Adonai, harshet ad chatzi hammizbeach. atat devora, vechatim beh 6, vehayeynu dichtiv, (Shoftim Adonai:1) vattashar devora. uvaatar da, chatimu dishma kaddisha, deachtim beh.

Vehahu maftecha, kad patcha battora shebbeal pe, baenan leishtemoda leh, veda ihu (47 amud bet) tanya, etan moshavecha, barayyta levar miggufa. etanim: innun tannaim. ammudim samchin, levar miggufa. hasheta it leodaa milla, bezimna deillen legabbe tora shebbichtav, ikrun etanim. legabbe tora shebbeal pe, ikrun tannaim. etan, legabbe tora shebbichtav. tanya, legabbe tora shebbeal pe. vecholla kadka yeot.

Chavrayyay, ha ana bechakla. shelomo malka, veguverin takkifin dileh. yeyte veyishkach chad sava, lae bechela, takkif gibbar, natzach keravin. ha yedana deata, vekayyeyma levatar tinra dechakla, vehu ashgach bi, vehech gevureti kayyeyma bechakla, bilchodoy ashgach, deihu ish shalom, mareh dishlama, veazal leh. hasheta sava, gevuretach alach, veant bilchodach bechakla, tuv leatrach. veshari zinach mealach.

(Davar acher keman denafik min chakla) (Micha 6:2) shimu harim et riv Adonai vehaetanim mosde aretz. shimu harim kidkamran. vehaetanim mosde aretz, mosde aretz vadday, deha minnayyhu ittezan, uminnayyhu kabbil kol yoma, veinnun mosde aretz.

(Micha 6:2) ki riv laAdonai im ammo, man hu deyachil lemekam beriv dekudesha berich hu (kol shekken) beyisrael. veal da amar leillen, shimu harim et riv Adonai, da ihu matzuta chada. kum riv et heharim, matzuta tinyayna. denatzach behu kudesha berich hu, kol illen rivot leyisrael, vechol innun tochachot, kullehu keabba deochach livrih, veha ukemuha.

Beyaakov ketiv, beshaata devaa lenatztzecha bahadeh, ma ketiv, (Hoshea 12:3) veriv laAdonai im yehuda velifkod al yaakov. ma riv ihu, kema dichtiv, (Hoshea 12:4) babbeten akav et achiv. al hay milla ata tochacha, vechol innun rivot. vechi lav milla ravreva ihu, babbeten akav et achiv vegomer. hay lav milla zeira ihu, may deavid babbeten. vechi ukeva avid babbeten, in vadday.

Sefer acher (nusach acher veha ittemar) (aval) becholla, dacha yaakov leesav achuy, begin dela yehe leh chulaka kelal. esav la hitraam ella mechad deinnun teren, dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:36) vayyakeveni ze faamayim. faamayim mibbae leh, may ze. ella, chad deakish litren. chad denafak litren. umay nihu. bechorati ithappechu atvavn, vahava birkati. ze faamayim: chad, deittekash litrin.

Vela yada esav ma deavad leh babbeten, aval rav memana dileh yada hava, vekudesha berich hu argish shemayya vcheylayyhu lekala da, deha beracha uvechora la tava memana dileh, vela amar. deha beracha hava leh lemitba, vela tava. achuha ha tava vday, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:7) umibbesarcha lo titallam vela baa yaakov lemehav leh lemechal, ad denatal minne bechorata dileh.

May bechora natal minneh, habbechora dilella vetatta. bechora chaser 6. keden akav et achiv, vday deavad leh ukeva, vearme leh laachora. may achora. akdim leh, deyippuk bekadmita lehay alma. amar yaakov leesav, tol atta hay alma bekadmita, vana levatar.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 25:26) veachare chen yatztza achiv veyado ochezet baakev esav. may baakev esav. vechi salleka datach dehava achid yedeh beragleh, lav hachi. ella, yado ochezet beman dehahu dehava akev, umanno esav. deha esav akev ikre, mishaata deakav leh leachuy, umiyyoma deitbere alma akev kare leh kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:15) hu yeshufecha rosh veatta teshufennu akev. ant deikre akev, teshufennu bekadmita. ulevassof hu deyimche reshach mealach. umanno. samael. deihu resha dechivya, demache behay alma.

Veal da babbeten akav et achiv, shavi aleh lemehevi akev, venatal esav hay alma bekadmita, vda raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 36:31) veelle hammelachim asher malchu beeretz edom lifne melach melech livne yisrael. vda ihu raza deamar shelomo malka, (Mishlei 20:21) nachala mevohelet barishona veacharitah lo tevorach, besof alma.

Veal da (Hoshea 12:4) babbeten akav et achiv uveono sara et elohim. may veono. hachi amru bechela vetukepa dileh yeot, aval lav hachi. beriru demilla, yaakov diyyukena illaa hava, vegufa kaddisha. delet gufa miyyoma dehava adam harishon, kegufa deyaakov, veshufereh deadam harishon, hahu shufereh mammash hava leh leyaakov. vediyyukeneh deyaakov, diyyukena deadam harishon mammash.

Adam harishon, beshaata chivya deata veitpatta al yedoy, yachil chivya leh. may tama. begin dela hava tukepa leadam harishon, vead kean la ityylid man dehava tukepa dileh. umanno tukepa deadam harishon. da shet, dehava bediyyukena deadam harishon mammash, dichtiv, (Bereshit Adonai:3) vayyoled bidmuto ketztzalmo vyyikra et shemo shet. may bidmuto ketztzalmo. dehava mahul. vechad ata memana deesav legabbe deyaakov, kevar ityelid tukepa deyaakov, deihu yosef. vezehu uveono sara et elohim. (ad kan matzati)

Hay kala deitteta, deyachla kala dechivya leachada bah, kechalba bechalbeta, man ihu. ella ta chazi, delet bechol kalin denashin dealma, deyachla kala dechivya leitdabbeka bah, uleitachada bah, uleishtattefa bah. ella terin nashin innun deyachla kala dechivya leitachada behon, chada. hay dela netirat soavut niddutah, vime libbunah, kedka yeot, o deakdimat yoma chada litbol. vachada, hay itteta dimachret levalah ona dilah lemebad tzaara levalah, bar i ihu la chayish, vela ashgach leda.

Illen innun teren nashin, deha kema deakdimu, hachi innun mitacharan, legabbe kala denachash, ad deadbik kala bekala, uchema demitacharan lemebad tzaara levalah (baavoda) beikkuva demitzva, hachi akdim kala denachash, leitdabbeka behahi kala deitteta. veillen innun teren nashin, dekala denachash achid bekala dilhon, kechalba bechalbeta, siuveta batar siuveta, zina batar zineh.

Veim tomar, ma ichpat lan, i achid kala bekala, i lo achid. vavy dehachi mitabbedan bene alma belo data. hay kala deitteta, kad itarav veishtattaf bahade kala denachash, beshaata dechayyayvat umarshaat nafkat miggo efa umeshatteta bealma, i arat behane teren kalin, kala denachash, vekala deitteta, veitteta itchammemat behu, veinnun bah, vechevan (sefer acher dametachemamen rucha azlin bahadah) deitchammemat, mitabbedin rucha, veaglim bahadah, ad dimshatteta, veal bimaha dehay itteta.

Vehay yannoka diylidat, kad atat hahi chayyayvta, pekidat leh lehahu rucha, deihu chibbura bisha, kala denachash, dimkashkesha bah, veihu mechayycha binnoka, ad deatat hahi chayyayvta, keitteta defakidat bera leitteta achara, umefatfetet leh vechayyeychat leh, befitputa ad detete immeh. kach avda hay rucha. uzemanin saggiin, deihu shelicha dehahi chayyayvta, vekatla leh, hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 4:1) umiyyad oshkehem koach. vela kema deattun amrin. ella hahu koach dehahu rucha, veal da, terin zimnin ketiv behay kera, veen lahem menachem. chad millilit chayyayvta, vechad mehahu rucha.
I sava, hasheta it lach rechimin, veat mishtae, keman dela chamit innun maggiche kerava, ha kullehu bishlama immach. hasheta mikkan ulehala, la ade minnay mane kerava bedil leadkera shemi.

Hahu chattat rovetz, kaim al pitcha kechalba. bezimna dekala batrayyta, deyahivat itteta, nafik, ihu dalig meal pitcha veitavar mittamman, veazil avatrah. may tama. begin dekudesha berich hu shadar chad maftecha dileh, vekala parcha, umaftecha atya, vechivya azal batar kala dehu nafik lealma, vead tura devitna azil, umechashkesha, ad iddan deitnekiat, mehahu zuhama, dinshichin dechivya bisha. vekudesha berich hu, mesabbev sivuvin, veavid ovadin kadka yeot.

Vechol da, begin dehahu beten itdachya. ha vadday, itdachya mehahu beten, velet leh chulaka, veitdache mibbeten diltatta, dishar neshin dealma deaf al gav deavid tzaar la ityeyhiv leh reshu leshalletaa beh. uman beten ityeyhiv leh, veihu shalit aleh. hahu beten desota, dichtiv, (Bamidbar Adonai:27) vetzavta vitnah, begin dehay beten, avid beh nukemin liruteh, vehay beten dileh ihu, vekudesha berich hu yahiv leh begin dela itdache mikkolla. hasheta rechimin dili, atzitu. la chamena lechu, umallilna lechu. (Kohelet 1:8) kol haddevarim yegeim, la yachil inish lemallela, afillu millin deorayyta yegeim innun.

Ketiv, (Bereshit lak) vayyivvater yaakov levaddo vayyeavek ish immo, uchetiv vayyar ki lo yachol lo vayyigga bechaf yerecho. vehahu yarech deravavch miyyaakov. vehahu yarech bachalishu dileh (Bereshit nusach acher amud bet, 144 amud alef) ad deata shemuel. may bachalishu dela mashich nevua. kad ata shemuel, natal hahu yarech, vesalkeh mehahu atar, vechataf leh minneh, umehahu zimna itade minneh, vela hava leh chulaka bikdusha kelal.

Kudesha berich hu la kafach, vela dache leh mikkolla, begin denatal shemuel yarech dileh, ella yahiv leh chulaka chada. may ihi. yahiv leh hahu yarech uveten desota, cholaf hahu yarech uveten, deade minneh. veal da tarvavyyhu yahiv leh kudesha berich hu, lemehve atra dekudsha panuy mikkol saavuta.

Velanpil yarech. mahu velanpil, venafla yerechah velatzbot, vetzavta yerechah mibbae leh. ella, keman deashde garma lechalba, veamar leh, tol hay lechulakach. umikkolla la avish kameh, ella degazlu (sefer acher deappiku) minneh yarech, begin deihu yaga velae aleh, veravavch leh veappiku leh minneh. veal da, kudesha berich hu appil leh, garma da desota, veappik leh kidkamran, uveda ihu ravvi vechadde.

Kol innun retichin vesiyyayta dileh, baan tadir yarech, veazle bechisufa avatreh. uvegin da, (112 amud bet) hane barchi derabbanan deshalhe, min da ihu. dechol kissufa dilhon, batar yarech ihu, vechol shekken yarech derabbanan, vechol milla ahdar leatreh, vekudesha berich hu la gara kelum, mikkol ma deitzterich, vela baa deyikrav likdusha, bar immeh veadveh chulakeh veachasanteh. kema deavid kudesha berich hu leella, hachi avde yisrael letatta, vehachi itzterich lemebad, vehachi tanenan, asir leh leyisrael, lemelaf orayyta leovde kochavim umazzalot, dichtiv, (Tehillim 147:20) maggid devarav leyaakov vegomer, lo asa chen lechol goy vegomer.

Veal da dache leh yaakov, vedache leh shemuel, dela yehe leh chulaka bikdusha. uvegin da, kol netiru devavu leyisrael, al da ihu. lechalba dechatif ofa dachya min shoka, veayyte leh, vead la ittevar, ata chad bar nash vechatfa minneh, levatar yahiv leh chad garma gerira bela toalta.

Kacha lesaro shel esav, appiku leh mehahu beten, chatifu minneh hahu yarech. levatar yahavu leh garma chad, hahu beten vehahu yarech desota, vela ochora. ha garma, deka yahavu leh lechulakeh veadveh, vearav leh. ubbegin kach, kol dinin dekudesha berich hu dinin dikshot innun, uveni nasha la yadin, vela mashgichin lekudesha berich hu. vechullehu beorach keshot. hi astiat garmah mibbalah, kema deat amer (Mishlei 2:17) haozevet alluf neureha vegomer, uf hachi itteta, kegavvna dilah beara.

Ta chaze, man deashkach chavra kevavteh, deavid keovadoy bealma, rachim leh, veitdabbak bahadeh, veavid immeh tivu. aval sitra ochora lav hachi, kevan deashkach man deshavak sitra dikdusha dekudesha berich hu, veavid keovadoy, veitdabbak bah, keden baya leshetzaa uleappaka leh mealma. hay itteta, avdat keovadaha, veitdabbekat bah, chazi ma deavdat bah, vetzavta vitnah venafla yerechah. kudesha berich hu lav hachi, man deshavik lesitra ochora, veitdabbak beh bekudesha berich hu, keden rachim leh, veavid leh kol tivu dealma. hasheta sava atkin garmich, deha chivya azil leh, uvaa leitgara bahadach, vela yachil.

Patach veamar (Kohelet 1:3) ma yitron laadam bechol amalo sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh, vechi la ata shelomo ella leolfa milla da. illu amar (sefer acher vechi ma ata shelomo malka leallafa bemilla da vetu ellu amar) baamalo sheyyaamol yeot, deha ishtear amal, deit beh yitron. ella kevan dichtiv bechol amalo, ha kelala decholla, dela ishtear kelum deit beh yitron.

Ella, lav lechol adam amar shelomo milla da, ella adam it bealma, deihu mishtaddel tadir bevish uleavashsha, vela ishtaddal betav afillu riga chada. veal da ketiv amalo, vela ketiv yegio. amalo: kema deat amer, (Tehillim 7:17) yashuv amalo verosho. (Bamidbar 23:21) velo raa amal beyisrael. yegio: kema deat amer (Tehillim 128:2) yegia kappecha ki tochel vegomer. uchetiv (Bereshit 31:42) veet yegia kappay raa elohim. aval amalo, ketiv, (Tehillim 10:14) amal vachaas. ishtaddeluteh hu tadir levish, veal da ihu tachat hashshamesh.

Beshaata dehay adam ishtaddal bevish, al hay ketiv, (iyyov 18:19) lo nin lo velo neched beammo vegomer, deha kudesha berich hu bae, dela yabid toladin, deilmale yabed toladin, hava metashtesha alma. veal da ketiv, ma yitron laadam bechol amalo. uman dela yishtaddal lemebad toladin, itdabbak behay sitra deadam bisha veal techot gadpoy.

Rut amra, (Rut 3:9) ufarasta chenafecha al amatcha, begin leizdavvevga bahadeh detzaddik, lemebad toladin, vekudesha berich hu paris gadpoy al bar nash, begin leappasha bealma. leman dela bae lemebad toladin, begappo yavo, begappo dehahu bish, deihu azil ariri, kechivya da, (95 amud alef) deazil yechiday. begappo yetze, (kema deat amar hasheta) ihu dela ishtaddal lemebad toladin, ha ittemar kol ma deitzterich. (sefer acher ta chaze, deit leahaddera sava, bemillin kadmain)

Riv deavad kudesha berich hu, ha ittemar, riv: dichtiv, (Micha 6:1) kum riv et heharim. may ihu. ella, innun turin diltatta. amay riv da. begin divhu talya, kol chova deavdin yisrael, legabbe avuhon devishmayya. may taama. begin deyisrael havo yadin shimmusha dechol malachin illain devishmayya, vela anis lehu, afillu shema dechad minnayyhu, vechol shimmusha dilhon.

Uvitren sitrin have taan avatrayyhu. chad, dahavo yadin leamshacha chela dilhon, dekochavayya umazzale beara. vechad, dahavo yade leumaa lon, bechol ma deitzterichu. veal da baa kudesha berich hu lemebad behu riv vedina. vechevan dibbehon leheve riv vedina, kol shilshula nafal deha la yeheve beh toalta. uvegin kach, kum riv vegomer. vetishmana haggevaot kolecha. man givot. illen innun immahot, (109 amud bet, 189 amud bet) dargin deikrun (Tehillim 45:15) betulot achareha vegomer, uvegin kach vetishmana haggevaot kolecha. dehachi havo avde yisrael, ad deishtattafu bedargin tattain. ta chaze, deit leahaddera sava, bemillin kadmain,

Dehachi havo avde yisrael, ad deishtattafu bedargin tattain yarech deka amaran, saggi atkifu lon yisrael, behahu yarech. mardechay hava achme lehahu rasha dehaman hahu yarech dileh, veal da hava ragiz, milla deitchaze leh, veihu argiz leh bahadeh. chamu chavrayyay, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 27:15) vattikkach rivka et bigde esav benah haggadol hachamudot vegomer. beillen levushin dileh, gazal dileh, veappik leh mikkol birkan dileh, umibbechiruta.

Uvegin kach, ila deka ashkachu retichin dileh, lerabbanan, ihu dechufeya dilhon lemane derabbanan tadir. (111) leyarchin dilhon. ulemanin dilhon. veillen teren millin distar achara havo, vechol da begin degazlu lon minneh. let lehu ila ella lerabbanan. uvegin kach, hane mani derabbanan deka balu mechufeya dilhon ihu, vehani barchi deshalhe, minnayyhu hu vadday. umiddilhon havo, uminnehon natle ila, umimma dahavo minnayyhu. baan lerabbanan, deinnun kelala dehahu yoshev ohalim, veal da let ila bela ila, veal da let milla, bela dina, vechol milla tav leatreh.

Shelomo amar, (Kohelet 4:1) veshavti ani vaere et kol haashukim asher naasim tachat hashshamesh vehinne dimat haashukim veen lahem menachem umiyyad oshkehem koach veen lahem menachem. hay kera armizna beh, (111 amud bet) veittemar. aval shavti ani, vechi mean atar tav shelomo. i nima, levatar deamar milla da, tav kemilkaddemin, veamar milla ochora, yeot aval shavti vaere (Vayikra 233 amud alef).

Tamman tanenan, bechol yoma hava akdim shelomo betzafra, vahave shavve anpoy listar mizrach, vechame ma dechame, ulevatar tav listar darom, vechame ma dechame vehadar tav listar tzafon, vekaim tamman. maich enoy vezakif resheh.

Behay shaata, ha ammuda deeshsha veammuda daanana, havo atyayn, veal hahu ammuda daanana, hava ate nishra chada. vehahu nishra hu ravreva vetakkif, vechen hava ate, gadpa yemina, al gabbe ammuda deeshsha, vegufa vegadpa semala, al gabbe ammuda daanana. vehahu nishra havi mayyte teren tarfin befumaha, ata ammuda daanana, veammuda deeshsha, vehahu nishra alayyhu, vesagdin lekameh deshlomo malka.

Ata nishra, umaich lekameh, veyahiv leh innun tarfin, natil lon shelomo malka, vahava meriach behu, vahava yada behon siman, veamar da ihu denofel, veda ihu digluy enayim. beshaata ditren tarfin havo, hava yada detarvavyyhu, (balak Rosh Chodesh amud alef) nofel ugeluy enayim baan leodaa leh millin.

Ma avid, chatim kurseyeh begushepanka, dehava chakik beh shema kaddisha. veihu natil izka dechakik aleh shema kaddisha, vesalik leigra, verachiv al hahu nishra, veazil leh. vehahu nishra, hava mistallak, lerum ananin, uvechol atar deihu avar, hava itchashach nehora. chakkime dahavo behahu atar deitchashach nehora, havo yade, vahavu amre, shelomo malka ha azil, veabar hacha, vela yade lean atar hava azil. tippeshin dahavo tamman, havo amre, ananin havo innun, deka azle vechashich alma.

Gava nishra bahadeh, ufarach arba mea parsin, ad demata leture chashoch. vetamman ihu tarmud bammidbar beharim, veihu nachit tamman. zakif resheh, vechame tura chashoch, vahava yada tamman kol ma deitzterich. vahava yada detamman yeul. hava rachiv al nishra kemillekadmin, vetas veal lego turin, ad hahu atar dezeta taman, kara bechela veamar, (Yeshayahu 26:11) Adonai rama yadcha bal yechozayun vegomer.

Al tamman, ad dekariv lehahu atar, shavve izka kamayyhu, vekariv, vetamman hava yada kol ma devae meinnun chachmetan nucherain, devae leminda. kevan dahavo amrin leh kol ma devae, keden hava rachiv al hahu nishra, vetav leatreh. kevan dehava yativ al kuresyeh, ityayshshav bedateh vahava memallel bedateh millin dechachmeta yakkira. behahi shaata hava amar, veshavti ani vaere, shavti vadday mehahu archa, shavti mehahi chachmeta, veityeyshavit belibbay uvedatay. ucheden vaere et kol haashukim. vechi zeirin innun bealma deihu amar et kol haashukim

(Nusach acher salleka datach dechol ashikin dahavo bealma, hava chame shelomo malka.) ella, may ashukim illen dehu amar. innun yenokin demetin betukefa deimmehon, deka ashukim mikkamma sitrin, ashukim baatar illaa dilella, vaashukim letatta. veha chavrayyay ittearu, vehachi hu, aval saggiin innun. kum sava, ittear bechelach. sava ema milach, devadday bela dechilu tema.
Let ashuk keinnun ashukim, dehava ihu ashik bekadmita, o mittelata leochora, kema dichtiv, (Shemot 20:Adonai) poked avon avot al banim veal bene vanim al shilleshim veal ribbeim.

Hecha hava ashik. shelomo malka tzavavch veamar (Mishlei 28:17) adam ashuk bedam nafesh ad bor yanus al yitmechu vo. kevan dehu ashuk, bedam nefesh, hu, o beno, o ben beno, yehon ashukin betikla, dichtiv ad bor yanus al yitmechu vo. ad hahu bor rak yanus meatar kaddisha, veal yitmechu bo behay alma. kevan deihu ashuk bedam nefesh, ihu, o zareh, lehevo ashukim mehahu sitra ochora.

It ashuk, mishshear ashukim, kema deat amer (Vayikra 19:13) lo taashok et reacha. ihu avar veashak, ihu ashuk bivnoy, mehahu sitra ochora. ubbegin kach amar, et kol haashukim. amar shelomo, kaimna bechol innun ashukim, bechol sitrin daashak.
Vaamay innun ashukim. asher naasu tachat hashshamesh. asher naasu, asher garu mibbae leh, may asher naasu. i asiyyay ihi lishvacha, lav asiyyay dilhon ella leella min shimsha.

Aval vadday naasu. hech naasu. ella kevan deashukim meruchehon tamman, amay atyayn lehay alma. ella ruchin vadday naasu, itavidu beruchin uvegufa behay alma, kevan deishtachlal gufa dilhon, veitavid hahu rucha begufa zach venaki bela lichlucha dechovin, behay alma, keden itashak gufa, kema deitashak rucha. vehay ihu gufa, deithane beh yattir mikkolla. vaashukin acharanin it, bechamma zinin meruchin tamman, vela naasu begufin. aval illen, innun ashukim asher naasu.

It acharanin, asher naasu, veatrachu bene nasha lemarehon. uman ihu. man deashik itteta dechavreh bitmiru, o beitgalleyay. vehahu valda deityelid minnayyhu, ashuk ihu, bela reuta demarihon, vela yada balah deitteta, innun ovadin ashukin innun, veatrachu lekudesha berich hu lemebad lon gufa, uletzayyeyra lon tzura, illen ashukim asher naasu. asher naasu vadday gufin dilhon, al karcha. begin kach, shelomo malka amar, (Kohelet 4:1) vaere et kol haashukim, bechol zine ashukim kaimna, innun asher naasu veitavidu baasiyyay.

Kema dehane (davar achar ihu baarla, eno rabbi veavid ulevatar ashkin leh minna hachi) innun ashukin, dechvar naasu bearla rabbe venatil vegadil gufa, veavid leh, ulevatar ashkin lon minneh, venatlin lon, hare ashukim asher naasu, veal kolla kaim shelomo malka veamar, kaimna al kol haashukim asher naasu.

Vehinne dimat haashukim, kolla oshdin dimin, im taana kame kudesha berich hu. hane oshdin dimin, deha arla rabbe lon, vegadil lon, ad 13 shenin, ulevatar ashkin lon mearla, venatil lon kudesha berich hu, ha lach ashukin asher naasu kevar.

Avar avera katlin leh. lon it taana, uzeminin lomar, mare dealma, tinok bar yomeh dechav, dayynin leh dina. ana bar yomeh havena, deha (98 amud bet) mehahu yoma kare leh kudesha berich hu ben, dichtiv (Tehillim 2:7) Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha, mareh dealma, yelid bar yoma, dina avdin leh, hare dimat innun haashukim veen lahem menachem.

Veit ashuk acher, hahu ashuk deikre mamzer, kad nafak mealma, miyyad mafrishin leh mikkehillata deamma kaddisha. hahu mamzer, anya miskena, oshid dimin kame kudesha berich hu, veatin kameh, mareh dealma, i avahatay chavu, ana ma chova avidna, ha ovaday, mittakkenan lekammach havo, vehinne dimat haashukim veen lahem menachem. vechen lechol innun ashukim, it lon taana kame kudesha berich hu, umehahi taana let lon menachem, velet deyativ milla al libbehon.

Uma deamar (et kol haashukim) vehinni dimat haashukim, illen innun demetin betukefa deimmehon, illen avdin leoshada dimin, lechol bene alma, begin delet dimin denafke millibba, kehane dimin, dechol beni alma tavvhin veamrin, dinin dekudesha berich hu keshot innun, veal orach keshot azle. hani miskene yenuke dela chavu, amay mitu. an dina dikshot, deavid mare alma. i bechove avahathon istalleke mealma, amay. vadday en lahem menachem.

Tu, vehinne dimat haashukim, hahu dima dilhon behahu alma, deka meginnin al chayyaya. ditnan atar it mittakna lon behahu alma, deafillu tzaddikim gemurim la yachlin lekayyeyma taman, vekudesha berich hu rachim lon, veitdabbak behu, veatkin behu, (96 amud bet) metivta illaa dileh. vealayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 8:3) mippi ollim veyonkim yissadta oz. umay toalta avdin tamman, vaamay sallekin tamman. dichtiv, (Tehillim 8:3) lemaan tzorrecha lehashebit oyev umitnakkem. vechen it atar ochora levaale tiyyuveta. (tachzor leel daf 106 tanenan let milla)

Tanenan, asara devarim itberiu beerev shabbat kulei. hakketav vehammichtav vehalluchot. dichtiv vehalluchot maase elohim hemma vehammichtav michtav elohim hu. may irya middehachi deerev shabbat hava, vedilma elef shenin levatar, o beshaata dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay. ella, vadday hachi hu deberev shabbat hava. ta chaze, bechol ovada divreshit, la ittemar shem male, ella elohim, elohim, bechol ma deitbere. vechullehu shem elohim, ad dechol ovada ishtachlal beerev shabbat. middeishtachlalu kol ovada, ikre Adonai elohim, shem male.

Veaf al gav divshem elohim itbere kolla, la ishtachlal baasiyya, kol ma deitbere, ad erev shabbat. behahi shaata ishtachlal kolla baasiyya, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) melachto asher asa. mikkol melachto asher asa. vekayyeyma bemaase. veal da ketiv, vehalluchot maase elohim, kad ishtachlal alma, beshem elohim bemaase, vela levatar, dichtiv Adonai elohim uveda ishtachlal alma, vekayyeyma al kiumeh.

Ta chaze, behahi shaata detavar moshe halluchot, dichtiv, (Shemot 32:19) vayshabber otam tachat hahar. tzaf okyaynus meatreh, vesalik leshattefa alma. chama moshe deokyaynus salik legabbayyhu, vahava bae leshattefa alma, miyyad vayyikkach et haegel asher asho vayyisrof oto baesh vegomer, vayyizer al peni hammayim. kam moshe al me okyaynus veamar, mayya mayya ma attun baan. amru vechi itkayyaym alma ella beorayyta deluchot, veal orayyta deshakru bah yisrael (davar acher vaavadu egla dedahava, anan baan leshattefa alma.)

Miyyad amar lon, ha kol ma deavdu bechova deegla, ha masir lechon, vela day kol innun alfin denaflu minnayyhu, miyyad vayyizer al peni hammayim. la havo mishtachche mayya, ad denatil mayya minnayyhu veashke lon, miyyad ishteka okyaynus beatreh.

Deha behahu midbar la havo mayya, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 20:Adonai) lo mekom zera vegomer. umayim ayin lishtot. vei tema, levera demiryam armi leh. chas veshalom, detamman shade moshe duchrana bisha da lemishte levatar. vetu, dead kan la hava lehu bera, ad deatu lemidbar mattana, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 21:18) beer chafaruha sarim vegomer. umimmidbar mattana. mittamman yartu bera. ketiv hacha al pene hammayim, uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 1:2) al peni tehom.

Charut al halluchot, may charut al halluchot. hachi ukemuha, cherut mimmalach hammavet, cherut mishshibud malchiyyot, cherut mikkolla, hachi hu. umay charut. gushepanka dealma deate, deveh hava cherut, bechol mine cherut. veilmale la ittebaru, kol ma deata lealma levatar, la ata, vahavu yisrael diyyukena demalachin illain dilella. veal da achriz kera veamar, vehalluchot maase elohim vegomer, la tema dilvatar dealma ishtachlal, veadkar shem male havo, ella beshaata deishtachlal beshem elohim, ad la yeul shabbat.

Hemma, may hemma. hippuch 50 havo. mitteren sitrin havo. chada beovada, vachada decherut leela, rashim leella lenatra lecholla. veal da 50. vehammichtav michtav elohim hu, eshsha uchama al gabbe eshsha chivvavra. michtav elohim hu, hayeynu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 18:23) veavad hallevi hu. charut kema deittemar, deha yovel kare charut, veavid cherut lechol almin.

Ad kan chavrayyay. mikkan vehala tindeun, deha sitra bisha, la shalta alayychu vaana yeva sava, kaimna kamayychu, leitteara millin illen, kamu innun, keman deittear mishshenateh, veishtetachu kameh, vela havo yachlin lemallela. levatar shaata bachu.

Patach rabbi chiyyay veamar, (Shir hashshirim 8:6) simeni chachotam al libbecha kachotam al zeroecha vegomer, simeni chachotam, beshaata deitdabbeka keneset yisrael bevalah, ihi amrat simeni chachotam, (vaychi 244 amud bet) archa dechotam, kevan deitdabbak behahu atar deitdabbak shavik beh kol diyyukeneh, af al gav dehahu chotam azil hacha vehacha, vela kayyeyma tamman, veha itavar minneh, kol diyyukeneh shavik tamman, vetamman kayyeyma. uf hachi amrat keneset yisrael, kevan deitdabbakna bach, kol diyyukeni lihave chakik bach, deaf al gav deezil hacha o hacha, tishkach diyyukeni chakik bach, vetidkar li.

Vechachotam al zeroecha, kema dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni, uf hachi, tehe diyyukeni chakik tamman. uvechen ehe bach mitdabbeka lealmin, vela itnneshe minach. ki azza chammavt ahava, takkifa kammavet ahava, betukefa takkif, kehahu atar desharya beh mota. ahava, hahu atar deikre ahavat olam.

Kasha chishol kina, uf hachi, deha illen shemahan, mehahu sitra innun. reshafeha rishpe esh, man innun rishpe illen. innun avnin umargelan tavan, deityelidu mehahu esh. shalhevet yah. mehahu shalhova, denafka mealma illaa, veitachada bichneset yisrael, lemeheve kolla chad yichuda, vaanan, ha ahava ureshafin deshalhova delibba avatrach, yehe raava, dediyyukena dilan, tehe chakuka belibbach, kema dediyyukena dilach chakkuk belibban. nashak lon, uvarich lon veazlu.

Kad matu legabbe derabbi shimon, vesachu leh kol ma deira lon, chadde vetavvav, amar, zakkain attun dezachitun lechol hay, uma havetun bahade arya illaa, gibbar takkif, dela havo kamma gibbarin legabbeh kelum, vela yedatun leishtemoda leh miyyad. tavavhna, ech ishtezavtun meonsha dileh, ella kudesha berich hu baa leshezava lechon, kara alayyhu, (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga holech veor ad nechon hayyom. (Mishlei 4:18) belechtecha lo yetzer tzaadecha veim tarutz lo tikkashel. (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzadikim leolam yirshu aretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer. (ad kan min rav yeva sava). <small>amru hamegayhaym matzanu rainu happekudim haelle baheatekavet hannimtzaot immanu hayyom mavetaaym lachen el na ysheytev hameayyneym alenu chattat. veim haatakevat madevaykavet yetakkenu hameavevat vayyasimu haakaveb lemishor vechaet hagehanevam keyad Adonai hattova alenu</small>

rashi: El hammizbeach asher lifne Adonai. ze mizbach hazzahav shehu lifne Adonai — bahechol, uma tal veyatza? lefi shehizza hahazzaot al happarochet veamad min hammizbeach velifnim vehizza, uvemattenot hammizbeach hizkiko latzet min hammizbeach velachutz veyatchil mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit (yoma 58):
Vechipper alav. ma hi chapparato? velakach middam happar umiddam hassair meoravin ze letoch ze (sham 57):
Ervat avicha. zo eshet avicha, o eno ella chemashmao? neemar kan ervat avicha veneemar lehallan ervat aviv gilla, ma lehallan eshet aviv af kan eshet aviv (sanhedrin 54):
Veervat immecha. lehavi immo sheenah eshet aviv (sham):
Asher hem zovchim. asher hem regilim lizboach:
ohc: Zivche shelamim laAdonai vegomer. haya tzarich lomar "vezavchu otam zivche" vechulei, veulay shennitkavven haadon lehareot chibbat hakkodesh asher chibbev ammo, veamar ki zivche shelamim hem karbanot hammishtattefim beshulchan echad yachad banim vaavihem, vehu amro shelamim laAdonai otam, vechozeret tevat "otam" livne yisrael hazzovchim haamurim bitchillat hakkatuv, lo lannizbachim. veal davar ze levad titnattek hannefesh minnartekah vetakum laavodat hael bimsirat nefesh mibbeli hergesh lehafelagat arevut hannirgash bivchinat ahavato yitbarach bannefesh hammargeshet bitimat noam chibbato, vechol ze katan hu lehammitchayyev lanu asot leerech hammukedam mimmennu yitbarach bivchinat shaashua chibbuvenu verommut asher romem am kedosho.

rashi: Bemargema. ferondola belaaz, sheeven shetztzorrin bo lo lehitkayyem hi sham, sheomedet lehizzarek. kach hannoten lichsil kavod eno shel kayyama. verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (chullin 133.) al hammelammed tora letalmid sheeno hagun, shehu kezorek even lemarkulis:
targum: Hech niktza detasa bekila hechna man deavad yekara lesichla:

rashi: Verachatz et besaro vegomer. lemala lamadnu mivrachatz et besharo ulevesham" shekkeshehu meshanne mibbigde zahav levigde lavan taun tevila, — shebbeotah tevila fashat bigde zahav sheavad bahen avodat tamid shel shachar velovesh bigde lavan laavodat hayyom, — vechan lamadnu shekkeshehu meshanne mibbigde lavan levigde zahav taun tevila (sham 32):
Bemakom kadosh. hamekuddash bikdushshat azara; vehi hayta vegag bet happarva, vechen arba tevilot habbaot chova layyom, aval harishona hayta vachol (sham 19):
Velavash et begadav. shemona vegadim shehu oved bahen kol yemot hashshana:
Veyatza. min hahechol el hechatzer shemmizbach haola sham:
Veasa et olato. ayil leola haamur lemala:
Veet olat haam. veayil echad leola haamur lemala "umeet adat bene yishorael" vegomer:

Asher tochal nevela uterefa. benivlat of tahor dibber hakkatuv, sheen lah tuma ella veshaa shennivlaat bevet habbelia, velimmedcha kan shemmetammea vaachilatah (veenah metammea vemagga); uterefa haamura kan lo nichtav ella lidrosh, vechen shaninu: yachol tehe nivlat of tame metammea bevet habbelia, tal terefa — mi sheyyesh bemino terefa, yatza of tame sheen bemino terefa (sifra; zevachim 70):
ohc: Vechol nefesh asher tochal nevela. amar vechol nefesh, lichlol kol hammitrabbim lemala (Vayikra 17:10) shemone haderagot kemo shepperashnu, vehizkir shete haderagot kelaliyyot ezrach veger, vedikdek lomar baezrach uvagger, perush, kol shennichlal baezrach vechol shennichlal bagger:

rashi: Chamsu torati. alehem haya lehochiach ulehorot ulehodia chok umishpat, velo asu, hare ze chamas, shechamasuha min hatztzerichin lilmod:
Vaechal. venitchallalti:
targum: Kahanaha chatfin beorayti umafsin kodashay ben kudesha lechola la afrishu uven mesaava ledachya la hodiu umiome shabbaya dili chevashu enehon vechalat reuti benehon:

rashi: Kol dam. lefi shenneemar "bannefesh yechapper", yachol lo yehe chayyav ella al dam hammukdashim, tal "kol dam":
Venatatti fanay. penay shelli — pone ani mikkol asakay veosek bo (sifra):
ohc: Veish ish vegomer asher yochal vegomer. taam kefel "ish ish", betorat kohanim darshu veze leshonam: "yisrael" – ellu yisrael, "ger" – ellu gerim, "hagger" – lerabbot neshe haggerim, "betocham" – lerabbot nashim vaavadim. im ken lamma neemar "ish ish"? amar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon lehavi velad yisrael min hagger umin haeved, ad kan. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach hakkatuv lefaret kol happeratim, uchederech shehikshu bemassechet sukka (28.) beotah barayta sheamra "haezrach" lerabbot hannashim, veze leshonam: midderabbi yehuda amar rav nafka, deamar rabbi yehuda amar rav: hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashim shebbattora, veteretz sham sheitztericha letosefet innuy vechulei, ad kan. im ken gam bema shellefanenu yesh lehakeshot ken, lamma hutzrach lerabbot hannashim vechulei, ben neshe yisrael ben neshe hagger. od yesh lanu laamod al kavvanat divre hattanna, ma hu havvelad yisrael habba min hagger shehutzrach hakkatuv lerabbot meish ish", im hu hemir kevodo miggerut vehalach lacharafot, hare hu goy, ulemi ba hakkatuv lehodia haissur. veod hattanna omer beferush "velad yisrael" mashma shebbeyahaduto omed, im ken peshita shello gara migger sheamar kera beferush, velamma itzterich "ish ish"?

Veharav baal "karban aharon" katav sheggarsinan babbarayta "min haggoy umin haeved", veyirtze velad bat yisrael habba min haggoy o eved, sheaf al gav sheaviv 136 o eved shello huzharu al haddam vechulei, mechuyyav im achal dam degarir achar immeh vechulei, degoy veeved habba al bat yisrael havvalad kasher, kidamrinan bivamot (yevamot 23.) "bincha habba vechulei karuy bincha" vechulei, ad kan. vekashe li, kevan shehakkatuv kerao laze ben yisrael, im ken yisrael gamur hu, veim medabber hakkatuv beven shello ratza laamod beyahadut immo, im ken paku peliliyya, ulemi ba hakkatuv lehodia torat Adonai? veim lechofo al haddavar, mimma nafshach: im beyad yisrael lechofo, peshita shekkofin oto kedin kol ish yisrael sheover al hattora, veim en beyadenu lechofo hare en birshutenu, veim ken kera lemay ata?

Venire lomar behakedim ladaat taam issur ze, kefi ma sheheiru chachamim et enenu bifnimiyyut hattora, ki kol nafshot am bene yisrael hem mimmadrega sheen lemala mimmenna, besod (Devarim 32:9) "chelek Adonai ammo". gam amru shehagam shehem baolam hattachton urechokim mimmakom gavoah, af al pi chen yeshnam devukim bechut shel chesed ad mekom sharshah, besod amro (sham) "yaakov chevel nachalato". venefesh habbehema hi mimmadrega hattachtona asher yityaches mekomah el kelippat noga. vehinne beechol adam middam behema shehannefesh yotza bo, shealav ba onesh karet, kona nefesh habbahamit mekomah benefesh adam. vehodianu hakkatuv kan ki haochel dam umachnis nefesh happechuta benafsho, yigal oto shoresh haelyon leval yihye od nidbak bo. vehu maamar venatatti fanay bannefesh haochelet et haddam vehichratti otah mikkerev ammah, perush sheyyichrot hachut hakkashur besharsho shehu mekor kelalut nafshot am Adonai, vehu amro mikkerev ammah.

Od yadua hu ki hagam shebbichlalut am yisrael shoresh echad, af al pi chen hem bemadregot zo lemala mizzo, besod (Kohelet 5:7) "ki gavoah meal gavoah" vegomer. vechevan shekken tavo hassevara lomar, letzad shennefesh behema zo lo temea hi, shehare hi behema tehora hanneechelet, laze lo taase nefesh hallazo pegam vedofi ella davka bahaderaga haggedola shebbeyisrael, veonesh sheyyiched Adonai laavera zo eno ella lehaezrachim zecharim velo nekevot, uchesheyyerabbe hakkatuv eze ribbuy en lanu bo ella chiddush haderaga achat ad sheyyerabbe ketzat hammadregot.

Gam kallech lederech acher yesh lomar, sheen happeulla hallaz osa kol kach roshem lehitztarech lechartah ella nefesh shehi kallat haerech, aval nefesh rama efshar shehagam shettaase bo roshem af al pi chen lo taase kol kach peulla bah kede shettitztarech lecharet. asher al ken nitchakkem el nora alila veribba kol haribbuyim veamar ki katon vegadol yeshno behikkaret beachlo dam hannefesh, veamar ribbuyim lechol hahadragot katan vegadol.

Vehinne lefanecha hahadragot zo lemala mizzo: rishon shebbakkedushsha zichre yisrael, 2 neshehem, letzad shehaishsha enah bemadregat haish, 3 ger habba miyyisrael vegiyyoret, 4 ger habba migger veyisreelit, Adonai giyyoret kayyotze bishne hahadragot, 6 ger habba migger vegiyyoret, 7 giyyoret habbaa migger vegiyyoret, 8 ger atzmo. vechol ellu hahadragot bau bakkatuv, rishon shebbakkedushsha yisrael, hizkiram beferush, vehu maamar tanna shel torat kohanim "yisrael" – ellu yisrael. vehizkir haggerim shete peamim, ushene ribbuyim immahem "hagger haggar". vetimtza shebbemassechet sukka (28.) darshu hei shel "haezrach" lerabbot neshehem, nimtzet omer ki hei shel "hagger hagger" ribbuyim hem. hare lefanecha arbaa ribbuyim baggerim vehem keneged shete haderagot shebbaggerim: ha hu hagger shennolad migger vegiyyoret vehav hagger atzmo shennitgayyer, ushene haribbuyim keneged neshehem shebbehadragatam. veulay shellaze dikdek veamar tanna detorat kohanim "hagger ellu haggerim" velo amar "ze ger", shennitkavven lishte haderagot degerim kaamur, veamar "hagger" lerabbot neshe haggerim, perush meribbuy hei nitrabbu neshehem. veamar betocham lerabbot nashim vaavadim kemaamar hattanna, perush nashim ezrachiyyot vaavadim sheddinam shave lenashim. velo takshe lamma hutzrach lerabbotam, vahalo kal vachomer miggerim, veen lomar shehayiti omer ki letzad shehem gedolim meerech ger yitztarech lomar ki gam bahem yafil hakkaret kemo sheamarnu betaam zichron yisrael, ki achar shehuzkeru zichre yisrael mikkol shekken hannashim. hinne im lo haya ribbuy "betocham" sheribba bah kera neshe yisrael lo hayinu merabbim mehe shel "hagger" shete giyyorot kemo sheamarnu. hare lefanenu shishsha ribbuyim, veamar ish ish shene ribbuyim acherim, vedarash otam tanna betorat kohanim veamar lehavi velad yisrael habba min hagger umin haeved, perush velad yisrael sheyyesh bo zera yisrael uva gam ken min hagger, vehu amro "min hagger", vehakkavvana hi sheaviv yisrael veimmo giyyoret o aviv ger veimmo yisreelit, ushene haderagot ellu nidrashim mikkefel ish ish.

Velo takshe lamma hutzrach hakkatuv lerabbot hahadragot ellu achare shekkevar ribba ger gamur kemo sheamarnu, ki im lo haya ribbuy "ish" hayinu mefarshim degerim haamurim bau miyyisrael vegiyyoret o migger veyisreelit. umeatta hikdim hakkatuv haderagot hachashuvim shebbaggerim sheyyesh bahen chelek yisrael veachar kach amar "hagger haggar" shekkullan gerim, hare lefanecha shemona ribbuyim. veim tomar giyyoret habbaa miyyisrael veger minnayin, yesh lomar shelleachar shennitrabba afillu ger atzmo shennitgayyer, peshita sheen lehafechit mimmennu giyyoret habbaa miyyisrael veger hagam shehi nekeva, ulederech ze tithallech bechol makom sheyyerabbe ribbuyim kaellu.
Bannefesh vegomer. betorat kohanim darshu: velo batztzibbur, ad kan. hattaam ki en koach beavon ze lehacherit tzibbur. veayyen bema shepperashti lemala (Vayikra 17:4).

Mikkerev ammah. betorat kohanim darshu: veammah beshalem, ad kan, veen yadua hakkavvana baze. mimma nafshach: im chayyavim middin arev lamma yihyu peturim kan, veim eno medabber bemi shechayyav middin arev, kegon shello yadu o neensu, en tzarich lomar. venire ki yechavven lomar ki keritat heanaf hara mehailan mashbicho kayyadua, velaze amar "mikkerev ammah" perush, kede shello yazzik anaf hara lenetzer mattaav yitbarach yachritehu, veyishshaer ammah beshalem.

rashi: Kashsheleg bakkayitz. beshaa sheshshotchin hatteenim bachamma leyabbeshan velaasot ketziot, kedaamar "hallechem vehakkayitz leechol hannearim" (Shmuel 2 16:2):
targum: Ech talga vekayta vehech mitra bechatzda hechna la yae lesichla yekara:

rashi: Kemaase eretz mitzrayim. maggid shemmaasehem shel mitzriyyim veshel kenaaniyyim mekulkalim mikkol haummot, veoto makom sheyyashvu vo yisrael mekulkal min hakkol:
Asher ani mevi etchem shamma. maggid sheotan amamin shekkibbeshu yishorael mekulkalim mikkullam (sham):

Uvechukkotehem lo telechu. ma hinniach hakkatuv shello amar? ella ellu nimosot shellahen — devarim hachakukin lahem — kegon tartiyyaot veitztadiyyaot, rabbi meir omer, ellu darche haemori shemmanu chachamim (sham):

Ani Adonai elohechem. ani hu sheamarti vesinay anochi Adonai elohecha vekibbaltem alechem malchuti, meatta kabbelu gezerotay; rabbi omer galuy veyadua lefanav shessofan linnatek baarayot bime ezra, lefichach ba alehem bigzera ani Adonai elohechem — deu mi gozer alechem, dayyan lippara veneeman leshallem sachar (80 sifra):
ohc: Dabber veamarta vegomer kemaase vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar dabber veamarta, od ma chiddesh bemaamar ze ani Adonai elohechem, vechi ad atta lo yadu ze? veod ma hi kavvanato bemitzvat "kemaase" vegomer, im en yadua ma hammaase shealav tavo hammitzva, uchemo chen maase eretz kenaan.

Verazal amru (torat kohanim) shehikkish maase mitzrayim lemaase kenaan. uledivrehem zichrono livracha kashe lamma kafal hammitzva, veim lehashemienu ba shemmaase shene harshaim shave, ma tzorech lattora lehodienu davar ze? od tzarich ladaat lamma tziyyen eretz mitzrayim beamro asher yeshavtem bah, vechi yesh eretz mitzrayim acheret? od tziyyen eretz kenaan veamar asher ani mevi vegomer, shennire sheyyesh acheret velo yadanu zulat zo, velu yehi shettihye eretz kenaan acheret, kevan sheenah yedua minnayin yihyu maaseha nodaim letzauot alehem?

Venire ki lefi ma shehismich lemitzva zo mitzvat haarayot, gam mimma sheamar besof happarasha (Vayikra 18:24) "al tittammeu bechol elle vegomer ki vechol elle nitmeu haggoyim", haddevarim mochichim umaggidim ki maase eretz mitzrayim kemaase eretz kenaan hu maase arayot, uvaze navo lefaresh hakkatuv al nachon.

Hinne yadua hu ki chol mitzvot asher tzivva Adonai leam kadsho hem mitzvot sheyyachol haadam laamod bahem veyatte atzmo el haratzon laasotam, zulat mitzvat perishat haarayot hu davar shennafsho shel adam mechammadtan veonasto alehem laasotam, zulat behitatztzemut harechakat shene devarim mehaadam, vehem merchak hergesh reut haayin, umerchak bechinat hachoshev, veim shene ellu lo yaase en adam shallit baruach ze lechallotah mimmennu, ki chol shello tihye lo harechakat hergesh harut baddavar hagam sheyyarchik bechinat hachoshev lo yishlot beatzmo lechallot mimmennu hechreach hacheshek. vetze ulemad (kiddushin 81.) mimmaase shel rabbi amram rabban shel chasidim, shehagam heyoto meshullal mibbechinat hachoshev nitnatztzach mibbechinat harut. gam mimmaase rabbi matya ben charash (yalkut shemauni parashat vaychi) shebbachar lesammot enav lemechush hacheracha asher mehem tavo baddavar hara, hagam shehaya meshullal mibbechinat hachoshev kaasher maasav mochichot. gam im yushlal mibbechinat harut, im lo yarchik bechinat hachoshev, machshevotav yechayyevu levakkesh ulehitlahet achar hammaase. vetze ulemad mimmaase shehuva bashshas (avoda zara 22:) beoto goy shekkana yerech basar vechatat bo kede vechulei uvaal vechulei ad kan. veze yihye toldot hachoshev hichrichatto asot mibbeli bechinat harut. nimtzeta omer shebbeachat mehashshetayim tihye meshullelet mehaadam shelita beatzmo bedavar ze, veen tzarich lomar behitztzamed shene devarim, reut vechoshev, hen haadam chalush keneged taavato, veen tzarich lomar im yishlach yado veachal meat min hara hazze, hinne hu masur beyad taavato. meatta tachbulot haadam lehaarich milchama neged bechina zo hi bishlilat mimmennu shene devarim, uvaze tihye nirkevet baadam techuna leval yitlahet achar ze veyishlot haratzon bachefetz hattivi, vehu taam amram zichronam livracha (berachot lod:) bemakom shebbaale teshuva omdim en tzaddikim gemurin yecholin laamod, ki hatztzaddikim gemurim techunat retzonam notzachat hachefetz mibbeli tzorech hitatztzemut, ma sheen ken baale teshuva.

Uvaze navo el habbeur. hinne haadon Adonai tzevaot nitchakkem betzauoto mitzva zo vedibber neged yetzer hara, sheyyomar ech yachol enosh tivi limshol betaavato asher hi anasatto? davar ze hu meshullal mehaddaat sheyyechayyev Adonai shemirato lakkol behashevaa, ella laanashim asher yecholin laamod veyesh koach birtzonam lishlol hachefetz baze, vehem otam shello bau lide mivchan harut vehachoshev, beellu vechaddome dibber hakkatuv. aval bemi sheavru bechina hannizkar kefi hatteva en adam shallit berucho limnoa meatzmo cheshek hammachricho. veal ze nitkavven Adonai benoam divre elohim chayyim veamar kemaase eretz mitzrayim asher yeshavtem, perush, hagam sheyyeshavtem bemakom sheanasheha bene zenunim velo timmana mikkem bechinat hachoshev letzad yeshivatchem benehem kol hazzeman hahu, keamro asher yeshavtem bah, veen yeshiva ella akkava, veze yesovev tigboret hachefetz bachem, af al pi chen anochi metzavve etchem shettitatztzemu lenatztzeach hacheshek leval taasu kemaasehem.

Veamar od uchemaase eretz kenaan asher ani mevi etchem shamma vegomer, perush, af al pi sheattem baim lemakom asher sham hirgia shedah shel bechinat hara hazze, venimtza bechinat hachoshev mitoreret, af al pi chen mechayyev ani etchem levilti asot kemaasehem.

Uletzad sheyyomar adam ki en matzor berucho bedavar ze, lachen hikdim Adonai bitchilla devaro hattov veamar dabber el bene yisrael veamarta alehem ani Adonai elohechem, ki hen emet bemin enoshi zulat yisrael yeshno betaana zo, ki lo yimmatze bechocho limnoa otzem cheshko mimmennu, ma sheen ken attem bene yisrael letzad heyoti Adonai elohechem, vehi hassaga elohit, bakkoach haelohi yenutztzach koach hattivi gashmi, ki hatztzura tishlot bachomer kesheyyaskim ish yisrael lehitdabbek baAdonai elohav yishlot betivo. vehu kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 114) sheamru: hatztzaddikim libbam masur beyadam veharshaim hem mesurim beyad libbam. hakkavvana baze ki hachefetz vehacheshek yeshno belev haadam, veharatzon hu bemocho, vehem shete madregot shennatan haadon bivne adam, ucheshettizdammen laadam devar erva hallev chomdah, veen gemar bechimmud ze, veyachol haratzon hattaluy bammoach limnoa hachefetz velo yaasennu hagam sheyyachmod. halo timtza bivne adam shemmekabbelim taanit, hagam shehachefetz yitgabber bahem leechol yavo haratzon veyimnaennu, vechen al ze hadderech. vetzaddikim tamid mitnahagim keseder ze velibbam masur beyadam, shehagam sheyyitauu taava belibbam yivchar hassechel shehi hanneshama, veim yeshno beazhara meAdonai o mikkelale hattiuv, yishlol haratzon bo veyimna hachefetz hagam sheyyeshno. aval harshaim hem mesurim beyad libbam, lechol asher yavo hachefetz ballev lo yimnaehu haratzon. veulay ki en lahem neshama, o shekkevar pegamuha venichnaat hi lifne haruach shebballev. velachen amar Adonai ki ani Adonai elohechem, perush leheyot shebbechinat hanneshama bah Adonai mashre or shechinato baadam besod (tehillim 78:60) "ohel shikken baadam", umitztzad ze yesh koach baadam lenatztzeach hachefetz lifne haratzon.

Vehu ma shennitkavven lomar david hammelech alav hashshalom bema sheamar (tehillim 40:9) "laasot retzoncha elohay chafatzti vetoratcha betoch meay", hakkavvana hi shemmerov devekuto baadon haadonim yitbarach shemo laad, ad sheggam hallev nithappech laasot kemaase hanneshama, shebba hachefetz bo vehattaava laasot retzono yitbarach, sheeno mehakkat hachafetzim devarim hammeruchakim mehakkedushsha utzerichim lemanam bishlilat haratzon, ella shemmeatzmo chafetz birtzono yitbarach lisno devarim asher hallev chafetz vechoshek bahem. vehu ma sheddikdek lomar "chafatzti", ki afes chefetz hammargeshet, veze amar bemakom acher (tehillim 109:22) "velibbi chalal bekirbi". veamro "vetoratcha betoch meay", perush, lerov cheshek avodat hakkodesh ad shemmargish belamdo torat Adonai keillu ochel umemalle bene meav mimmazon tivi.

Od ulay shennitkavven lehodia hakedama achat sheshshematiha mishshem harav hakkadosh 255 lureya 233 (sear haggilgulim 19), vehu ki lifamim yithappech haadam veyishtanne mittov lera betivo umizgo, velo yeda meeze sibba, vehu atzmo yitma ech nehpach bedato. veamar ki ze yesubbav letzad shellifamim yochal adam maachol sheyyesh bo chelek mechelke hara o yesh bo nefesh raa mehaggilgulim lesibbat tachaluehem, vechaasher tikkanes hannefesh haraa o nitzotz hara bekirbo tattehu mittov lera vetigbar bo bechinat hara. meatta hashshomer atzmo mimmaachalot haraot yitgabber hachefetz bo baddevarim hannogim lannefesh, vehu amro "laasot retzoncha elohay chafatzti vetoratcha betoch meay".

Ulehaskilcha bemashmaut amro "vetoratcha betoch meay", da ki kol hatztzomeach, ben bidvarim hechrechiyyim lechayyut hannefesh, ben bidvarim hassegulliyyim baolam, ben bidvarim shehem taanuge adam – shoresh hakkol vehiuuyo hu mehattora asher hi em hakkol. ucheshem shebbattora peshat remez derash sod, ken maachalim shel olam hazze. veayyen beferush shir hashshirim (rishon letziyyon al Shir HaShirim 2:4) shechiddashti, ucheshem shebbaasavim yesh devarim segulliyyim vetiviyyim ken yesh battora mitzvot segulliyyot vechulei, vehakedama zo gedola veyikrat haerech. vechatavti rashe perakim lahavincha amro "vetoratcha betoch meay", ki chol haochel asher yeachel yesod chiyyuto shebbah nithavva vegadal hu minikat hakkedushsha shehi hattora. umeet pagam adam harishon venitarev tov vara bechol ochel timtza chelek mehara. velaze tzivva Adonai al arlat hailanot, velaze gadel im hachitta motz veteven vesubbin hannizrakim. vehivdilanu Adonai mikkamma devarim asher shalat bahem chelek hara leval shakketz nefesh hannivcheret. velaze kesheadam ochel davar hammuttar keillu nehena meor haelyon mimmeore or tora, ella shennigsham letzad hatzelachat yesode eretz shetztzerichim mazon kefi hachanatam veharekavatam. veze amro "vetoratcha betoch meay", baze gavar cheftzo uteshukato laasot retzono yitbarach, ki en ra bekirbo hammesir chefetz hearev lannefesh.

Nachzor lainyan shebbanu alav, ki bechinat hachoshev bidvar erva tagbir hachefetz vetashlitennu baratzon, velo yussag hannitztzachon hachefetz ella davka beemtzaut harechakat haddavar middato umachshavto leval reot hakkiur velo yachshov bo, aval im enav yabbitu baddavar hinne hu mistakken, uchemaase david hammelech alav hashshalom keshennisbav haddavar veraa ma sheraa (Shmuel 2 11:2) nitorer libbo shehaya chalal veasa maasav. vaafillu techillat hammachshava bedavar ze tigrom tigboret veholadat tiviyyut hachefetz vetigbarto, velaze nitchakkem chacham hachachamim shelomo hammelech alav hashshalom veamar (Mishlei 1:10): "beni im yefattucha chattaim" – perush bechinat hachet – "al tove" – perush lo tikkanes im pittuyecha betoen venitan, ki arichut haregashat hachoshev afillu livchinat hashsholel tafil hagebarat hachefetz vetahafoch haratzon eleha. umitzvat Adonai bara baa al haddavar bivchinat dibbur vaamira, dibbur – lomar gezerat melech hi devar melech shilton, amira – leshon maane rach uleshon rommut, letzad shehem yeshnam bemadrega zo lemor alehem ani Adonai elohechem leyached shemo yitbarach alehem. gam maala gedola hi leshomer berito, vehi hahadraga sheen lemala mimmenna, laze amar veamarta:

rashi: Yitkallesu vach. uma hi hakkallasut? temeat hashshem. zo hi shettimmet et shemah; shehayu nikraim "am kadosh", "banim" leyotzram (Devarim 14:1-2), vegarmu atzmam lehikkarot "am teme sefatayim" (Yeshayahu 6:5):
targum: Dekarivin vedirchikin minich yitlaavun bich soavat shema desagiin itregushetaha:

rashi: Velo taki haaretz etchem. mashal leven melech sheheechiluhu davar maus, sheen omed bemeav ella mekio, kach eretz yisrael enah mekayyemet ovre avera (sifra sof kedoshim), vetargumo vela teroken, leshon rikkun — merika atzmah mehem:
ohc: Velo taki vegomer kaasher kaa vegomer. lo hispik ma sheamar lemala "vattaki haaretz", lezarez beyoter, al derech ma sheddarash rabbi eliezer ben azarya befarashat achare mot (torat kohanim, achare mot, parasha 9): mashal lechole shennichnas etzlo harofe vechulei, al tochal tzonen vechulei, shello tamut kederech shemmet peloni, ze zerzo yoter vechulei, ad kan. kemo chen bema shellefanenu nitkavven Adonai lezarez yisrael beyoter.

rashi: Asher huva et damam. lahechol velifnay velifnim:
Eshet bincha. lo amarti ella besheyyesh levincha ishut bah, perat laanusa veshifcha venachrit (80 sifra):
El achotah. shetehen keachat (kiddushin 50):
Litzror. leshon tzara — laasot et zo tzara lazo:
Bechayyeha. limmedcha sheim gershah lo yissa et achotah kol zeman shehi vachayyim (yevamot 8):
Damo venafsho hiv. damo hiv lo bimkom hannefesh, shehannefesh teluya vo:
Ki nefesh kol basar damo hiv. hannefesh hi haddam. dam uvasar leshon zachar, nefesh leshon nekeva:
ohc: Damo venafsho. perush – bimkom nafsho. uvaze natan taam lamma tzarich lechassot damo, ki letzad sheddamo hi nafsho, mehammusar linhog bo kavod ze, kederech shetztzivva Adonai likbor adam met mishshum kevodo.

Vetaam shello amar kederech sheamar babbehema "nafsho bedamo", ulay shehabbehema yesh lah nefesh vehi netuna baddam, aval chayya vaof en lahem nefesh kabbehema ella haddam hiv bimkom hannefesh, uvaze enam baim al hammizbeach lechapper kabbehema zulat torim uvene yona, vegam hemma en bedamam hazzaa al hammizbeach ella mitztzuy keshemmolek.

Ki nefesh kol basar vegomer. perush, lo letzad shehaddam mechapper al hammizbeach hiv sheasarti haddam, sheaz techallek ben dam behema ledam chayya vaof, ella taam haissur hiv letzad "ki nefesh kol basar" vegomer, umeatta gam chayya vaof bichlal.

Kol ochlav yikkaret. kevar katavti lemala taam hakkaret. vetaam amro "ochlav" leshon rabbim veyikkaret" leshon yachid, lehaircha al perushenu, shehakkaret hiv sheyyistallek chiyyuniyyut hammeir beshoresh nishmato venichrat hashshoresh hahu, laze amar leshon yachid. veamar "ochlav" leshon rabbim, letzad shehannehenim mehaachila rabbim hemma, ki chiyyuniyyut hannidbak beshoresh elyon yesh tachtav hachanot kede sheyyuchal amod beyachad im hagguf, ki hagguf hiv chomer geshem uvara Adonai bo koach hammenia, vehu hannefesh shettechunatah hi nota al haggeshem veyitav lematammotav, uveraam Adonai baruch hiv bitchuna zo kede sheyyitmazzeg im hagguf, vehu muchan livchinat hannishtavve laruach, veharuach hiv muchan lanneshama, vehanneshama huchena lehasherot shechinato al haruyim, umeatta kesheadam ochel haddam hare lefanecha ochlin merubbim: hagguf, hannefesh, haruach, hanneshama, uvivchinat haonesh shehu hakkaret en nichrat ella chut hanneshama hakkeshura lemala uvaze yavshu kol haanafim, laze amar leshon rabbim.

Od ratza al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha (torat kohanim 17:10) ki hatztzibbur enam nichratim baavon achilat dam, laze amar "ochlav" leshon rabbim veyikkaret" leshon yachid, lomar shehagam sheyyochlu rabbim en karet ella layyachid velo latztzibbur.

Venatatti el libbi ladaat ma taam yetzav Adonai lechassot dam chayya vaof velo dam behema. bishlama dam hannizrak al hammizbeach hod vetiferet lo middam chayya veof, aval dam shechitat chullin asher hiv nofel ugeluy enayim, lamma tiggara behema mechayya? uma gam lema shemmatzinu shebbachar lo yah karban mehabbehema velo mechayya vaof, zulat torim uvene yona.

Vehinne lefi ma shepperashnu shechayya damah hi hannefesh atzmah, ma sheen ken habbehema, ki yesh nefesh millevad haddam vehi murkevet baddam veen damah atzmo nafshah, laze lo tzivva Adonai lechassot haddam ella haddam shehu atzmo nefesh, ma sheen ken habbehema sheen haddam atzmo nefesh kemo shel chayya vaof. vahagam sheggam bedam behema yesh nefesh bo, im kol ze lo haddam atzmo nefesh, veen kissuy ella lammuregash velo lahiyyuli hagam sheyyeshno, vehaven.

Veraiti latet lev maskil mippene ma nishtannet beriyyat chayya mibbehema bivchina zo. venire shehattaam hiv lefi ma shekkadam lanu behitbonnut muskalot hashepaot hakkiyyum vehaamadat kol yesh, ki hael habbore baruch hiv chayyut hakkol vehechin veasa peullot kede shekkol hove yaggiennu hahistappekut min hatztzorech lekiyyumo, vechillek kol beriyyotav learba haderagot, vehem esh ruach mayim afar, vechol achat kelula mehaarbaa. vearbaa ellu techillat havayatah hi neelemet meene kol basar, vehi ruchanit betachlit haruchaniyyut, vehem arba ragle kisse kevodo yitbarach, venishpaim mehem bechayyotze bahem arba beriyyot acherot nose hakkisse, pene adam pene nesher pene arye pene shor, uchenegdam arbaa malachim, gavriel refael michael nuriel, ellu hachana leellu umekabbelin ze mizze, uleummatam yesh lematta mekabbelin bevaale chayyim, adam shor nesher arye: adam min enoshi, shor min behema, arye min chayya, nesher min of, uchenegdam baddommim, afar mayim esh ruach, vechol echad kalul mearbatam. vegam bivchinat hanneshamot shehem beria haelyona shebbaelyonot asher bara Adonai meorot elyonot, chelek Adonai baruch hiv, kemo chen yimmatzun bechinot, vechazar haddin shekkol nose venose kolel kol ze vechol madrega mashpaat venishpaat mimmadregat kisse hakkavod shehi lemala mechayyot hakkodesh ad madregat haddomem.

Umeatta avo lirot hannishpaim hannidmim mehaarba bechinot hanniglim dugematam lemala, vehinne yesh lo bechinat shor behema tehora hannishpaat middemut pene shor, aval chayya vaof lo matzinu bannidmim nishpaim lematta mehammushepaim mehakkedushsha, ki arye chayya temea, nesher of tame, veyesh lachkor zot, lamma nimna hannidme mehitkabbel bechinat hakkedushsha vehattahara kemo shekkibbel hashshor, gam minnayin nimshecha bechinat hattohar lishar chayyot hattehorot asher hittira tora, "ayyal utzevi" vegomer.

Da ki yesh haderagot sheen yecholet bammekabbel lekabbel betigboret hammashpia bivchinatam besod taam oni chachme yisrael, kayyadua leyode daat bahitbonnut hatztzodek besechel hahavchen. velaze, letzad ki arye venesher shellematta bau betigboret, lo yuchelu lisbol shiur hannitkan vehannishar alehem bitchunat echutam. uletzad chesron hitkabbelam hashearat hahistappekut mibbichun hannirzav asher began Adonai, keshiur hatzelachatam mehamekuvve alehem, zo sibba lemerchakam asher tzivva Adonai leish yisrael leval yikrav alehem. ki ish yisrael hutzlach bannikve elav besod amro (Devarim 4:4) "haddevekim baAdonai", veshiur asher higgia bivchinat arye nesher kamohu ucheshiuro nistaef biktzat mehachayyot vehaofot, veasa bahem shiur hahistappekut. vahagam shello ba echutam ella al yede nesher, ki hannishpa rishon ze hiv sod (Iyov 14:4) "mi yitten tahor mittame" vegomer. vechol ze asao yitbarach lesibba hayyedua, sod Adonai lireav. vechevan shekken, en techunat hakkedushsha vehattahara hammishtalshelet divchinat habbehema doma livchinat chayya vaof, ki bechinat shor yesh dome lo lemala bimkor hakkedushsha asher bara habbore vetikken bo hannefesh, ma sheen ken bechinat chayya vaof. letzad shennifsak demut hannidme lammashpia hinne hiv tame lefanenu, dichtiv (Vayikra 11:13) "et hannesher veet vegomer teshakketzu", tash kocho veen bo ella hachiyyuniyyut shehu dam tohar, keamro "damo venafsho", uchemo shepperesh damo bimkom nafsho. zulat torim uvene yona sheyyodea el elyon sheggavar bahem hachiyyuniyyut umemuzzagim hem ben habbehema vehaof, shemmeviim mehem karban ola vechattat davka, veyachid davka velo tzibbur, vetzarich kissuy ki ad geder habbehema lo ba. kol ze katavti im chafetz Adonai, vehammaskil yaskil devar elohim chayyim.

rashi: Lammolech. aza hi sheshshemah molech, vezo hi avodatah, shemmoser beno lakkomrim veosin shete medurot gedolot umaavirin et habben beraglav ben shete medurot haesh (sanhedrin 64):
Lo titten. zo hi mesirato lakkomrim:
Lehaavir lammolech. zo haavarat haesh:
Mittumot bene yisrael. al hannichnasin lammikdash betuma velo noda lahem bassof, shenneemar lechol chattotam, vechattat hi shogeg.
Umippishehem. af hannichnasin mezid betuma (sham 7):
Vechen yaase leohel moed. keshem shehizza mishshenehem bifnim achat lemala vesheva lematta, kach mazze al happarochet mibbachutz mishshenehem achat lemala vesheva lematta (sifra; yoma 56):
Hashshochen ittam betoch tumotam. aappi shehem temeim shechina venehem (sham):
Asher laam. ma shehappar mechapper al hakkohanim mechapper hassair al yisrael, vehu hassair sheala alav haggoral lashshem (shavuot 2):
Kaasher asa ledam happar. achat lemala vesheva lematta:
Lo gushmah beyom zaam. lo nittan geshem harauy lah letaher beyom zaam; uferush haddavar ketargumo: "la itavidu vah ovdin tavin deyignun alah beyom levavt":
targum: Bar adam amar lah at ara deyisrael ara la midachya hi vela itavidu bah ovadin tavin deyignun alah beyom levat:

ohc: Ushemartem attem. taam amro tevat attem velo hispik bema sheddibber lahem lenocheach "ushemartem", nire ki mitzva zo baa lehazehir al hachukkim vehammishpatim shello yihyu mitbattelim mikkol hammitztavvim alehem. vehakkavvana shello yomar adam sheen lo lehakepid ella shello yitbattelu hammitzvot al yado, aval im yitbattelu mehazzulat en lo lachush, laze amar ushemartem et chukkotay vegomer, perush, shello yitbattelu mikkol hammitztavvim alehem. uletzad ki mitzva zo enah ella al haggedolim, laze amar "attem", dibber lenocheach im moshe uvet dino, ki al batte dine yisrael lifkoach ayin leval titbattel mitzva achat mimmitzvot hattora mibbene berit. uvetorat kohanim amru zichronam livracha: "ushemartem attem" – attem naim shomrim otam sheattem petachtem otam, vechen hu (Shir HaShirim 4:12) omer: "gan naul achoti challa gal naul mayan chatum", ad kan. perush, kan kerev Adonai azharat haarayot el teva haragil, veamar lahem ki mitzva zo shel shemirat haarayot eno davar chadash vezar beerech yisrael, shehare hem mitztzad atzmam kodem shennitztauu hayu perushim min haarayot, dichtiv: "gan naul achoti challa", vehu ma sheramaz beamro attem, perush, ma sheattem shemartem kevar meatzmechem.

Haezrach vehagger. razal darshu (torat kohanim): "ezrach" – ze ezrach, "haezrach" – lerabbot neshe ezrachim, "ger" – ze hagger, "hagger" – lerabbot neshe haggerim vechulei, ad kan. taam shehutzrach hakkatuv lefaret kol peratim ellu, leval titu mittevat "attem" vetomar shebba lemaet eze perat mehapperatim harshumim, talmud lomar vechulei.

Od nire ki nitkavven hakkatuv lehodia sheim yisrael vehaggerim yishmeru kol hachukkim vehammishpatim, en koach bemaase haggoyim, hagam sheyyetaavu maasehem, lehaki haaretz yoshveha. vedavka kodem shennichnesu yisrael laaretz hu shekkaa haaretz haggoyim al maase hattiuv, aval achar kenisat yisrael laaretz en haddavar taluy ella beyisrael vehagger, velaze peret otam shemmaasehem yesovvu lemaet haggoyim.

Vetimtza sheamar hakkatuv (Shemot 23:33) "lo yeshvu beartzecha pen yachatiu otcha li", vechatav rambam usemak sheggoy shello kibbel alav sheva mitzvot asur ladur beeretz yisrael mittaam "pen yachatiu" vegomer, ha lamadta sheim lo haya taam "pen yachatiu" hagam shello yekabbel alav sheva mitzvot vitaev maasav, en lachush lahakaat haaretz bishvilam.

rashi: Tov shevet al pinnat gag. al silluk hashshechina neemar (Eicha Rabba Petichta 25):
Meeshet midyanim. keneset yisrael shehirshiu et maasehem vehiknitu lehakkadosh baruch hu:
Uvet chaver. bayit shechibberu bo gillulim lashshechina:
targum: Tav lemitav al karna deigra min dilmemad im itteta tigranita uveta tarka:

rashi: Al haesh. shebbetoch hammachta:
Velo yamut. ha im lo ashaah ketiknah chayyav mita (sifra):

ohc: Al tittammeu bechol elle. amru zichronam livracha (torat kohanim) ben bechullan ben bemiktzatan. perush, afillu bemiktzato, ucheillu amar "al tittammeu beachat mikkol elle". vetzarich ladaat lamma dibber hakkatuv beseder ze, shehaya lo lomar "al tittammeu beachat mikkol elle" kede shello yihye makom litot. od kashe ma sheggamar omer "ki vechol elle nitmeu haggoyim", vehaggoyim en lanu makom lomar shello nitmeu ella beachat, shehashshatuf bezimma yado bakkol. gam mashmaut "bechol elle nitmeu", yaggid shebbechullan nitmeu, umeatta ma taam nishma el haddavar asher yetzavve alav shehakkavvana hi "al tittamu bechullan"?

Venire lefaresh behasekil al devar emet, lamma lo gilla Adonai battora haderagot hammitzvot usegullatam, veadrabba ba shelomo hammelech alav hashshalom veamar (Mishlei 5:6) "orach chayyim pen tefalles", veanu acharav razal (avot 82 41) sheen lanu lomar mitzva zo gedola vezo ketanna sheen atta yodea vechulei, vehochichu (Devarim Rabba 86, yerushalmi pea 81 hei) mimma shekkava Adonai sachar shave laggedola shebbaggedolot im ketanna shebbakketannot, veal kullan ani dan shehassevara notenet sheyyesh mitzvot vadday gedolot beyoter, velamma satam Adonai haddavar?

Venire ki letzad sheyyesh tzorech bammitzvot hakketannot kevaggedolot, shekkol mitzva umitzva segullatah bifne atzmah, uma bechach im secharah meat, kevan shessecharah have davar sheeno bannimtza kischar haggedola, vechol hammitzvot tzerichin letikkune hannefesh, laze tzivva Adonai katan vegadol behaderaga achat kede sheyyaasu yisrael kullam keechad. vehu maamar shelomo (Kohelet 9:10) "kol asher timtza yadcha laasot bechochacha ase".

Od nire taam acher, ki letzad sheyyesh mitzvot shessegullatam lehaarich yamim baolam hazze, veyesh shessegullatam osher, veyesh shessegullatam banim, vechen al ze hadderech, vechash Adonai kesheyyitgalle haddavar kol echad yelech veyishtaddel bema shechafetz uvema shetztzarich velo yishtaddelu bishar mitzvot kammitztarech, laze satam haddevarim. uvaze yishtaddel haadam bechullan kede shettavo leyado gam mitzva shessegullatah davar hatztzarich lo. uvaze yesh taam lema sheanu roim kamma bene adam raim lashshamayim velabberiyyot uvattehem shalom mippachad meleim kol tuv, ki efshar shebba leyadam mitzva shessegullatah hatzelachat olam hazze, veen haaverot sheosim monim segullat hammitzva vehatzelachatah. vechol ze bivchinat mitzvot ase, uvemitzvot lo taase yihye haddavar ken, yesh averot sheppuranutam laolam habba, veyesh sheppuranutam yissurin baarichut hazzeman, veyesh sheppuranutam berachmanut, veyesh kol kach achzariyyut, vahalo timtza kamma reshaim sheavru al hakkeretot velo nichretu hagam sheamdu betokef haresha ad sheavru zeman hakkerita, ella vadday sheyyesh shemmishtallem aleha baolam hazze veyesh shemmishtallem aleha laolam habba. vedavar yadua hu sheyyoter yafil happachad belev bene adam musar hammishtallem baolam hazze leheyoto nigle, meonesh hannistar.

Uchevar kadam lanu ki Adonai baruch hu yakpid afillu al beruav hakkerovim elav leval yedabberu davar sheeno al kav hatztzedek, vaafillu devarim shennirim kesheker, vetze ulemad maamar rabbi akiva lachaverav (chagiga yad:) keshettaggiu leavne shayish tahor al tomru mayim mayim, umikkan nakkish lechesef nivchar leshon tzaddik, hu Adonai elohenu mekor haemet, ki yakpid leval yichtov battora ella devarim hammuvhakim bemiddat emet.

Uvaze navo el habbeur, vehu ki letzad sheonesh ze shel hakaat haaretz yoshveha eno ella al perat echad mehattoevot haamurim bapparasha kaasher avaer besamuch, aval shear hattoevot yesh lahem onesh acher, kaasher shafat el chay temim deim kefi bechinat hattiuv. velaze keshebba letzauot et ammo ratza lehodiam ki yesh battoevot asher hizhiram alehem tiuv echad asher yesovev shettaki otam haaretz, velo ratza Adonai legalloto kede shellefachdo yishmeru atzmam mikkullam yachad kemo shekkatavti sheyyoter yarid onesh hannigle meonesh hannistar, veze shiur haddevarim: al tittammeu bechol elle – perush, beechad mikkol elle, ki vechol elle nitmeu haggoyim asher ani meshalleach mippenechem vattitma haaretz vaefkod avonah – perush, echad hu haggorem veoto pakadti al hair vattaki et yoshveha. ha lamadta sheal avon echad kaa haaretz otam, im ken titchayyev lomar ki maamar al tittammeu bechol elle hu beechad mikkol elle, kevan sheal echad haya haonesh veen atta yodea mi hu.

Veamar od ushemartem vegomer velo taasu mikkol hattoevot vegomer ki et kol vegomer asu. nitkavven hakkatuv baze lehodiam shekkol hattoevot asu anshe haaretz, veen achat bechol hattoevot shello asu otam. vehammechuvvan baze kede sheyyikkansu kullan begeder hammechush, ki chol shello asu otah anshe haaretz en bah pachad hahakaa min haaretz, laze hutzrach lomar "ki kol" vegomer. vedavar ze dome lichli mayim sheheki bo nachash, kol hakkelim sheyyikkansu begeder safek keli ze, adam nirad miggeshet elav, uchemo chen haddavar hazze. vahagam sheheavon haggorem hakaa hu echad vetoevot asher yetzavve rabbim hem, davar ze din kavua yesh lo sheadam hu poshet atzmo lehateiv, vedin lakuach yesh lo velo din poresh, uchemo sheheerachti baze bechibburi al yore dea (peri toar siman 110), vechevan shekken, kol hakkavua kemechtza umechtza. veachar shehifchidam beonesh nigle chazar veamar ki kol asher yaase vegomer, perush, sheggam al kol shear hattoevot yesh onesh chamur lehacheratat hannefesh, ella sheachat mehem goremet onesh hannigle.

rashi: Kevutzat kesef. kaasher yekabbetz hatztzoref et kol hassigim el toch kur:
Lafachat. lenappeach:
Lehanetich. "veyatzakta" (Shemot 25:12) metargem: "vetattich":
targum: Kemachnesh kesaf unechash uvarzela vaavar uveitz lego chura leatkafa alohi nura leamsayuteh ken achnesh berugezi uvechemti veasef veeshetze yatchon:

rashi: Venatan aharon al shene hasseirim goralot. maamid echad leyamin veechad lismol, venoten shete yadav bakkalpi, venotel goral beyamin vachavero bismol venoten alehem, et shekkatuv bo "lashshem" hu lashshem, veet shekkatuv bo "laazazel" mishtalleach laazazel (yoma 39):
Azazel. hu har az vekashe, tzuk gavoah, shenneemar eretz gezera — chatucha:
Vayyaas kaasher tzivva vegomer. keshehiggia yom hakkippurim asha kasseder hazze; ulehaggid shivcho shel aharon, shello haya lovshan ligdullato ella kimkayyem gezerat hammelech (sham):
ohc: Vehayta zot lachem vegomer. mikra ze chozer el hakkohanim lekayyem ledorot mitzva haamura bitchillat happarasha shehi avodat kohen gadol, leval yachshov shello neemra ella leshaa, talmud lomar zot lachem lechukkat olam, lechapper al bene yisrael kan gilla Adonai sodo ki al hakkohanim yedabber ki hem hammechapperim.

Od nitkavven baze, leval yomar adam shello tzivva Adonai leval yikkanes bevigde zahav ella baet hahi paam rishona, sheadayin lo nitkapper roshem avon egel zahav, aval mippaam rishona veelach kevar nimcha venimchak rishshumo uvo yavo aharon bevigde kavod el hakkodesh penima. talmud lomar vehayta zot lachem lechukkat olam belo shinnuy, vegamar omer lechapper al bene yisrael. ulay shennitkavven latet taam al haddavar, lomar shehagam shebbivchinat aharon lo nishar roshem mehaegel, kevan shebbeerech yisrael leshimtza bekamehem lo nimchak roshem haegel kol ikkar, umeatta mitaggel haddavar gam al aharon.

Vayyaas kaasher tzivva Adonai vegomer. razal amru (torat kohanim) ki hakkatuv yechavven lehaggid shivcho shel aharon, shello asa ligdulla ulehitnasse, ella asa hakkol lekayyem mitzvat Adonai. venire ki gam shivcho shel moshe yaggid, shehare Adonai lo dibber im aharon ella im moshe, vehattora meida shello nishtanna haddibbur letzad emtzaiyyut haemtzai, ha lamadta shehaddevarim hanneemarim mippi moshe lo nolad bahem hishtannut afillu bechelek mishshishshim mechut hassaara, veze binyan av letoratenu hakkedosha shekkullah hi motza pi Adonai yechayye haadam chayye olam bahagigo benoam elyon.

rashi: Asher yaale ola. lechayyev al hammaktir evarim bachutz keshochet bachutz, sheim shachat echad veheela chavero shenehem chayyavin (zevachim 106):
ohc: Vaalehem tomar vegomer. bemassechet zevachim (zevachim 107.) tanya rabbi yishmael omer: leeruv parashiyyot, lomar sheaf shechute chutz sheheela bachutz, hagam sheen reuyim lifnim, kegon hashshochet bifnim umaale bachutz, detanya bammishna techillat perek 13 dizvachim. velitten kol haamur shel ze baze, zulat devarim sheribba hakkatuv beechad mehem umiet bachavero. veayyen bedivre Rashi bizvachim.
Ish ish vegomer. ayyen bappasuk shellifne ze.

Mibbet yisrael. hutzrach lomar "mibbet yisrael" velo hispik bemaamar "vaalehem" shemmimmennu muvan shechozer lehaamurim lemala mehainyan. letzad sheamar "ish ish" lomar shenayim sheshshachatu kemo shekkatavti besamuch, vechash hakkatuv sheyyavo haddoresh veyidrosh lerabbot haggoyim, kemo sheddorshim (menachot ag.) beish ish" haamur bindarim unedavot (Vayikra 22:18) shehu lerabbot goyim, laze hutzrach lomar "mibbet" vegomer davka yisrael velo ummot, umimmela nitchayyev lidrosh beish ish" kol ma sheddarshu zichronam livracha. veachar shehutzrach lomar "mibbet yisrael" chash hakkatuv lomar shemmiet hakkatuv haggerim, talmud lomar "umin hagger".

Vehutzrach lerabbot kol haribbuyim, dezulat ze yomar haomer shello ribba ella ma shehizkir bakkatuv. vegam ledaat rabbi yose shessover dibbera tora kilshon bene adam, ulay shello amar ken ella letzad sheyyesh lo meniat hadderasha bo letzad miut hahu. vahagam shehiksha hashshas lerabbi yose dechevan sheeno doresh "ish ish" shebbefarasha sheniyya gam "ish ish" shebbefarasha rishona lo yidrosh, in hache namme im lo haya hashshas motze derashat "dam shafach" haya omer sheddorshah meish ish", shekkol sheen negdiyyut ladderasha lo amrinan dibbera tora vechulei. veayyen bedivre hattosafot bimtzia daf 31 dibur hamatchil dibbera tora kilshon bene adam, sheen sevara lomar delet letanna kamma derashot shennidreshu bakkefel, vahagam shehattosafot pertu hakkushya lerabbi shimon im kol ze yeshnah lakkol. veikkar machloket hattannaim hi bisvara bedavar hammitnagged ladderasha shekkefi hassevara matte lomar dibbera tora kilshon bene adam, vetimtza sheggam rabbi shimon matzinu sheamar (bava metzia lo:) dibbera tora kilshon bene adam umatzinu lo sheddoresh hakkefel.

rashi: Ish itti. hammuchan lechach miyyom etmol:
Shot lassus. hu asuy, veaf shevet nachon legev kesilim. yissurin muchanin larasha (Shemot Rabba 9:8):
targum: Shevata lesusa umagliva lechamra veshuveta legushemehon desachle:

rashi: Vaydabber Adonai el moshe achare mot shene bene aharon vegomer. ma tal? haya rabbi elazar ben azarya moshlo mashal lechole shennichnas etzlo rofe, amar lo al tochal tzonen veal tishkav betachav; ba acher veamar lo al tochal tzonen veal tishkav betachav shello tamut kederech shemmet peloni, ze zerzo yoter min harishon, lechach neemar achare mot shene bene aharon:
ohc: Vaydabber Adonai vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma neemar lo bedibbur ze. 2, leeze inyan yashmienu hakkatuv heyot dibbur ze achare mot, ma li achar ma li kodem. 3, lamma hutzrach lomar bekarvatam vegomer, im lehodia shemmetu bishvil shennitkarvu lifne Adonai, halo kevar hodia haddavar bimkomo (Vayikra 10:1) "vayyakrivu esh zara" vegomer, vesham hu yoter meforash haddavar mimma shekkatuv kan "bekarvatam", sheen yadua ma hu heavon sheasu bikriva zo shealeha metu. 4, amro "vayyamutu" meyutteret achar shehitchil lomar "achare mot bekarvatam" vegomer. Adonai, amro "vayyamutu" betosefet vav.

Venire shekkavvanat hakkatuv hu shebba hakkadosh baruch hu lehazehir et moshe shello yachshov bedato ki letzad shehu yoter karov lemalchut shamayim uvechol beto shel hammakom neeman hu veyachol likkanes el hakkodesh penima, vahagam sheyyetzav Adonai al aharon – lo yitchayyev haddavar sheggam moshe bichlal, ki gadol moshe, dichtiv (Bamidbar 12:6-7) "im yihye neviachem Adonai vegomer lo chen avdi moshe", asher al ken dibber Adonai el moshe, vehu amro vaydabber Adonai el moshe perush, elav ba hammitzva, veamar lo samuch lemitat shene bene aharon dibbur ze bekarvatam lifne Adonai vayyamutu, perush, hagam heyotam bene aharon uvetosefet merubba heyotam kerovim lifne Adonai kemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 12:2) befasuk "bikrovay ekkadesh", af al pi chen lo chamal alehem vayyamutu, ha lamadta shello yoil heyot haadam kol kach karov laAdonai kede sheyyifrotz gader likkanes lakkodesh penima.

Od nire lomar shennitkavven beamro bekarvatam al ze hadderech: bihyotam yoter kerovim laAdonai mikkol, ha lamadta sheen kerovim mehem, sheim haya moshe karov mehem haya haddavar naase bo, kemo sheamar lo Adonai (Vayikra 10:3) "bikrovay ekkadesh". veulay ki kan beer hakkadosh baruch hu devarav el moshe, veal pi haddevarim haelle amar moshe leaharon "hu asher dibber Adonai" vegomer, ki dibbur ze neemar lo samuch likrivatam umitatam. vahagam shekkevar katuv battora mitat shene bene aharon, en mukedam umeuchar battora.

Uvetorat kohanim amru besalka datin detevat "achicha" ba lemaet moshe sheeno baazhara umuttar lavo bechol et, veheelu baamittut hadderasha shettevat "achicha" baa lerabbot habbanim shehem baazhara, ad kan. uchefi ze lo nitmaet moshe meazhara, umeatta en ani yodea ma dino shel moshe im hu baazhara o lo. veharav baal karban aharon katav sheppeshita ki mi hichniso ad sheyyitztarech lehazehiro. ulefi ma shekkatavti hinne baa azharato beyichud befasuk rishon. vedivre baal karban aharon sheamar "mi hichniso" enam nirim. vechavvanat hattanna hi shello ba hakkatuv lemaet moshe mehaazhara, veen lanu mikra lo lemaet velo lerabbot, uvachar hattanna lidrosh beyittur tevat "achicha" lerabbot habbanim millidrosh bah lemaet moshe.

Vechol ze lisvarat haomer (Bereshit Rabba 44:5) "achare" samuch, "achar" muflag, uchemo shehetakti machloktam bimkomot acherim. aval lisvarat haomer "achare" muflag, "achar" samuch, yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech: shebba lehodio shemmitatam hayta al karvatam lifnim bakkodesh, vahagam shehattora amra esh zara, modio Adonai ki taam mitatam hayta al karvatam lifnim, hagam shello hayta esh zara. veamro vayyamutu, nitkavven lehodio shello yachshov ki yatzta machshavtam lappoal shennichnesu lifnim, ella shennidchafu vametu. vehakkavvana behodaa zo lishlol leval yachshov adam lifrotz ulehitkarev hagam sheyyamut, veze yimmatze bihyot laadam bechinat hacheshek lo yachush al atzmo veyitten nafsho, vedavar ze yimmatze bivchinat hachoshek sheyyitten nafsho al haddavar hagam sheyyeda sheyyamut. laze amar lo "vayyamutu", perush uchevar metu velo hissigu machshavtam lehitkarev, vehaven ze.
