Veze ledaat rabbi yose haggelili sheamar betorat kohanim, al hakkeriva metu, vegam lisvarat rabbi avraham ibben ezra sheamar keday keriva leatzmah ucheday hakerava leatzmah, aval ledivre rabbi akiva deamar al hahakrava metu, hinne lisvarat haomer "achare" mufelag yitbaer hakkatuv beofen acher. vehu behakedim lachkor lamma lo tzivva Adonai al mishpat yom hakkippurim haamur befarasha zo ad hen hayyom, velo tzivva beyom tzauoto beinyan kadshe hammishkan, vechaasher amar lo (Vayikra 9:7) "kerav el hammizbeach" sham haya lo lomar lo "lo yavo el hakkodesh penima". haemet shemmeduyyak hu haissur meamro "kerav el hammizbeach vaase et" vegomer, shello haya lo lomar ella "ase et chattatcha" vegomer, velamma hutzrach lomar "kerav" vegomer, verazal (torat kohanim) darshu derashot, uledarkenu nire sheamar elav "kerav el hammizbeach" – en lecha reshut likrav ella lammizbeach velo lifnim, ella sheshsham haya lo letzauot beazhara zo deal yavo vegomer velo yamut".

Achen letzad ma shehodianu hakkatuv shebbaavon haegel metu shene bene aharon, dichtiv (Devarim 9:20) "uveaharon hitannaf Adonai lehashemido vaetpallel" vegomer, ufershu razal (Vayikra Rabba 7:1) "lehashemido" – ze mitat habbanim, vehoila tefillato shel moshe mechtza, ha lamadta ki shene bene aharon baavon haegel metu umizbach kappara hayu hemma laavihem. velo takshe vahalo amru (torat kohanim kan) shemmetu letzad avon hakkeriva leman deamar, uleman deamar al hahakrava – yesh lomar sheim lo haya avon avihem haya Adonai shomer ragle chasidav. gam lo kashe al ma sheamru (zevachim 115.) shemmetu lehitkaddesh shemo yitbarach, ki im lo haya avon haegel haya mitchayyev meelohe hammishpat lehitkaddesh habbayit bezulatam, ki kevar hodaticha shehagam sheyyachpotz Adonai hammavta lachasidav lesibba neelemet leyodea taalumot niflaim veramot, tzarich sheyyihye latztzaddik kol shehu mehaddevarim asher lo tov asot, kede shedderech sham yishlot bahem haddin. uchevar heerachti beanaf ze. tze ulemad (avot derabbi natan perek lach) mimma shemmatza rabbi akiva taam laharigato letzad shessamach libbo bidrashato toch shishshim ribbo kaamur bedivrehem, vekashe, halaze yitchayyev enosh mita meshunna? im ken paka kelila devarde mikkol ose tov velomdim, ella deze hu derech shemmimmennu yishlot bo haddin, uleolam sibbat mitato yakar beene Adonai hammavta laasara haruge malchut lemagen vetzinna ledorot bene yisrael. vetaam ze noten taam lishvach gam bema shellefanenu, ki avon haegel kevar nimchal befarhesya keshehikriv aharon el hammizbeach veyarda shechina al yado venitbasser shennimchal lo avon haegel, im ken batel dina dehashmadat habbanim, shebbehibbatel hassibba yibbatel hamesubbav, ella vadday ki hagam shennimchal – rishshumo nikkar, vehu keshiur chut hassaara mehachet sheyyaspik lehashelatat midda happoelet din baadam, veze garam shello nishmeru ragle chasidav veshaggu bikriva vehakerava, venitkaddesh bahem habbayit.

Veal pi haddevarim haelle nuchal lomar ki lo huchshar aharon lihyot rauy lavo el bet chatzar hammelech penima ella beemtzaut mizbach kappara shel habbanim banav, venimcha roshem chet haegel, aval zulat ze lo huchshar aharon lemaala atzuma laamod bemakom mufla, uvaze yityashshev hakkatuv al nachon: vaydabber Adonai, umodia hakkatuv ki haddibbur hanneemar bainyan bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh lo nichshar aharon lemaala zo ella achare mot shene bene aharon venimcha cheto. vedikdek lomar bene aharon kan romez kapparat avon avihem shebbaze hushlam lihyot rauy lehaamur bainyan kemo shepperashti. uvaze natan hakkatuv taam lamma lo tzivva Adonai et haddavar hazze ad henna, ki mikkodem lo haya muchshar aharon laze, veachar shennachat hakkatuv lehodia sibbat mitatam shehu letzad heyotam bene aharon lechapparat avon avihem, hodia ki lo zot hi sibbatam mittechilla vead sof lemitatam, ella zot hayta sibba rishona shehi garma shello nishmeru raglehem kannizkar veshaggu bikriva o behakerava leman deamar, vehu amro bekarvatam lifne Adonai lomar ki ma garam lahem, heyotam bene aharon sheyyesh beyado avon maase haegel hu karvatam, uvehitztarfut michshol ze metu. uletzad shekkefi haemet shete sibbot hallalu lo hispiku lemitatam, rabbati hu asher dibber Adonai (Vayikra 10:3) "bikrovay ekkadesh", shemmetu lehitkaddesh habbayit bishvilam, kaasher avaer taam hutzrach letaam ze velo hispiku shene hatteamim, laze amar "vayyamutu" betosefet vav, lirmoz inyan tzorech mitatam lehitkaddesh habbayit liro et Adonai hammekuddash, liro mehammikdash kol hakkarev leval yamut gam hu, velaze samach dibbur azharat aharon veal yavo vegomer el hakkodesh.

Nimtzeta omer shelosha devarim garmu mitatam: avon haegel, vehahakrava, vekiddush habbayit. ushelashtam hodia Adonai bemaamar rishon sheamar achare mot shene bene aharon – ze keneged chet aharon, bekarvatam – kemashmao, vayyamutu – bishvil lekaddesh habbayit leval yavo vegomer el hakkodesh katan vegadol. vechol sheloshet hatteamim tzerichin: avon haegel, shezzulato letzad shehayu tzaddikim gemurim haya haddin mechayyev sheyyihyu nishmarim leval yikkashlu bikriva, veze siman lemichshol. vaavon hakkeriva gam ken, shezzulatah lo yumetu al avon avihem ki gedolim hayu. vesibbat kiddush habbayit, shezzulat ze lo haya Adonai mearbev simchato beyom simchat libbo, veyitchayyev haddavar lishmirat raglehem leval yikkashlu, o lo haya Adonai memitam beoto yom vehaya mamtin lahem ad yom acher, ella letzad sheratza Adonai lekaddesh habbayit bo bayyom asa chen. vetaam ze levad lo yaspik lemitatam, sheyyitkaddesh habbayit bezulatam.

Uchefi ze efshar latet taam lemaamaram zichronam livracha sheamru (torat kohanim shemini) sheamar moshe al nadav vaavihu shehem gedolim mimmoshe veaharon, ki mimma sheraa moshe shehutzrach taam avon haegel lemitat bene aharon, im ken lo matza hakkadosh baruch hu nidnud avon lehistabbech bo anaf haddin, velo nichshelu ella letzad ma shekkadam baavon avihem, laze amar shehem gedolim mimmoshe veaharon, ki lo nimtza lahem afillu kechut hassaara mehachet ma sheen ken moshe veaharon.

Uledarkenu ze efshar shellaze nitkavven hakkatuv beamro (Mishlei 22:20): "halo chatavti lecha shalishim bemoetzot vadaat", ki shelosha devarim hayu sibba laddavar: bemoetzot – shetayim, vadaat – shalosh, vehem shelosha devarim haamurim bainyan. keneged ma shello machal Adonai leaharon laavon haegel lo bitfilla velo beharetzaat aharon bekarbenotav umaasav, gam keneged ma shello shamar raglehem millehitkarev lemakom mekuddash amar "bemoetzot", ki nityaetz Adonai letachlit davar. veramaz lishne haddevarim bema sheamar "moetzot" leshon rabbim – shete etzot, veachat mesubbevet mechavertah, shello hechlit mechila leaharon kede shello yishmerem, shebbaze timtza midda hashsholetet kannizkar. ucheneged tachlit haddavar shemmetu lekaddesh shemo yitbarach amar "vadaat", perush, lehodia lakkol ma yakar mekom kedushshato, sheafillu laanashim tzaddikim kaellu sheen kemotam haya ma shehaya veyitkaddesh habbayit.

Od nitkavven beamro achare mot, leheyot sheyyetzavve Adonai leval yikkanes aharon lekadshe kadashim bevigde zahav (rosh hashshana 26.) mittaam "en kategor naase sanegor", chash hakkatuv levaal din sheyyachlok veyomar ki lo hikpid Adonai al hachenasat aharon bevigde zahav ella kol od sheadayin lo nimcha rishshumo shel avon haegel, ma sheen ken achar shemmetu banav veen rishshumo shel egel nikkar lachalutin, nimcha kategoro shel zahav veyachol likkanes bevigde zahav bechavod uvetifaret. laze amar achare mot vegomer, sheggam achare motam tzivva Adonai leval yikkanes bevigde zahav lekodesh hakkodashim ella ketonet bad kodesh vegomer. vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (arachin 16.) shebbigde zahav mechapperim, af al pi chen lo yease kategor sanegor lelabben avonam shel yisrael kashsheleg. veayyen ma shekkatavti bime charpi becheftzi chefetz Adonai bemaamaram zichronam livracha (shabbat 30.) shekkesheamar shelomo "zachra lechasde" vegomer (divrei hayamim 2 6:42).

Ulederech ze amro bekarvatam ba lehasir chashash pegam meal moshe, shehu amar (Devarim 9:20) "vaetpallel gam bead aharon", veyomar haomer shello hoila tefillato shel moshe, umoshe atzmo yachshov machashavot shello hoila tefillato. laze amar bekarvatam lifne Adonai, perush behitztarfut sibba zo metu, aval zulat ze vahalo hayu metim ki hoila tefillato shel moshe al aharon leval yashmido. uchefi ze en anu tzerichin lomar shehoila mechtza, uledivrehem zichrono livracha (Vayikra Rabba 10:5) sheamru shehoila mechtza, perush kevan desof sof metu lo yihye toelet mittefillato shel moshe leaharon ella mechtza, ki eno chashuv toelet ella kefi tachlit. ...

Veamro "vayyamutu", ulay shebba Adonai lomar lemoshe ki haanashim haelle asu avon hakkeriva o hahakrava, vehem kevar hayu chayyave mita meet hitraggez Adonai al aharon lehashemido, velaze lo nimneu miyyad middat haddin. aval im lo haya ma shekkadam shehayu bene mita kannizkar, hagam shehayu nichnasim efshar shehaya Adonai maarich appo lahem vechaddome laze. veshiur hakkatuv al ze hakkatuv bekarvatam lifne Adonai, umakom ze tzarich laasot lahem nes lemalletam miyyad middat haddin, vehem "vayyamutu" kevar, perush nitchayyevu mita kodem, ella bitfillat moshe nimletu.

O yomar al ze hadderech achare mot vegomer, dibber Adonai lemoshe derech mitatan shehayta al ze hadderech – bekarvatam lifne Adonai, perush shennitkarvu lifne or haelyon bechibbat hakkodesh uvaze metu, vehu sod hanneshika shebbah metim hatztzaddikim. vehinne hem shavim lemitat kol hatztzaddikim, ella shehahefresh hu shehatztzaddikim hanneshika mitkarevet lahem veellu hem nitkarvu lah, vehu amro bekarvatam lifne Adonai.

Veamro vayyamutu betosefet vav, ramaz hakkatuv hafelaat chibbat hatztzaddikim, shehagam shehayu margishim bemitatam, lo nimneu mikkerov lidvekut neimut arevut yedidut chavivut chashikut metikut ad kelot nafshotam mehem, vehaven. uvechina zo en makkir echutah, vehi meshullelet hahakkara, lo mippi min haenoshi, velo mippi ketavo, velo tussag behashearot muskal haggeshem, velammassig chelek mehassaga zo tavdil mimmennu hammonea oto mehitkabbel vetakkirehu al yede simaneha ki ze hefkah menaggedet soneha vetifal bo peulla reshuma lishlol mimmennu koach hammono vehamekayyemo, velifamim timasehu hannefesh uterivehu meriva gedola vehu sod hollut hanneviim (Shmuel 1 19:24), velichshettirbe bechina zo bifnimiyyuto tigal hannefesh et habbasar veyatzta meimmah veshava el bet aviha. veodia lammitbonen bifnimiyyut hasekalat hammuskol, shehasekalat hahaskel taskil hahaskalot, uvehaskel behasekalato, yaskil, shemmuskol meshullal hahaskel, uchesheyyaskil behearat atzmo, velo atzmo yaskil, shehammuskol muskol mimmuskol, bilti muskol mehassechel, vehiskilo lammaskilim beyichud, hasekalato besod neshama lenishmato. veaz motarav yihyu itre melachim vechisam. vechi yesh chayyim lachayyim shealehem amar moshe (Devarim 30:19) "uvacharta bachayyim" bet hammodaat, vesholelet chayyim hannishtavim behergesh hakkelali, vivarech baruch elohim chayyim asher siggel segulla zo lisgullato.

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha betorat kohanim vehuvea bemassechet yoma (53.) veze leshonam: tanya rabbi eliezer omer "velo yamut" – onesh, "ki beanan erae" – azhara. yachol kodem mitat bene aharon? talmud lomar "achare mot". yachol shenehem achar mitat vechulei? talmud lomar "erae" vegomer, ha ketzad? azhara kodem, mita achar kach, ad kan leshono. uvemassechet yoma perek Adonai (sham) bae: may mashma? veamar rava dichtiv "erae" vaadayin lo nira, veillu haya achare mot bene aharon kevar nira bo bayyom, shenneemar (Vayikra 9:23) "vayyera chevod Adonai", ad kan. uchefi ze bene aharon metu kodem sheheenish hakkatuv. uchefi ze yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech: amro achare mot ba leval tachshov birotcha ki yetzavve Adonai mitzvat hakketoret veamar "velo yamut", nomar ki hu ze onesh shebbo neenshu bene aharon, dichtiv (Vayikra 10:11): "vayyikchu vene aharon vayyasimu aleha ketoret" vegomer, laze amar achare mot vegomer perush, ki lo tzivva baonesh ella achar shemmetu bene aharon vegomer. im ken lefi ze chala hakkushya lamma metu? laze amar ki lo metu al kav hammishpat, sheacherim im hayu osim davar ze lo hayu metim kevan sheadayin lo nitztauu baonesh, ella hattaam hu bekarvatam lifne Adonai – leheyotam sevivav shel hakkadosh baruch hu dikdek immahem kechut hassaara, vedavar katon yechashev ledavar gadol, vehu ma sheramaz betosefet havvav shel "vayyamutu" lomar hagam shello hayu mechuyyavim mita mittaam sheadayin lo anash, af al pi chen metu.

Uvetorat kohanim amru, veze leshonam: "dabber el aharon" vegomer, en anu yodim ma neemar bedibbur rishon. haya rabbi elazar ben azarya omer mashlu mashal, lema haddavar dome? lechole shennichnas etzlo harofe, amar lo: "al tochal tzonen veal tishkav betachav". ba acher veamar lo: "al tochal tzonen vechulei shello tamut kederech shemmet peloni". ze zerzo yoter min harishon. tzarich ladaat lamma amar beseder ze "haya rabbi elazar ben azarya", shehaya lo lomar "amar rabbi elazar ben azarya" vechulei?

Venire ki rabbi elazar ben azarya lo lekushya zo nitkavven, ella al kushya acheret ba letaretz, vehi ma shehikshenu lamma icher Adonai letzauot mitzva zo leaharon ad atta, vehaya moshlo lerofe vechulei, sheharofe hammezarez harebe hu sheomer kederech shemmet peloni, uchemo chen asa rofe yisrael shehimtin ad shemmetu banav kede lezarzo beyoter. umevi hattanna divre rabbi elazar ben azarya letaretz gam kushyot kefel haddibburim, uvichlale haggemara anu omrim shellifamim mazkir baal hammaamar batterutz velo bakkushya, ella shehattanna mevi devarav letaretz gam ma shehuksha lo ma neemar lo bedibbur rishon, ki neemar lo: habbet uree shehaanashim hanniggashim el Adonai kadeshu vattivar bam esh hakkedushsha, ko tomar leaharon achicha gam hu al yavo" vegomer. ella dekashe lefi ze haya lo lomar "achare mot shene bene aharon achar dibber" vegomer, o achar amro "vaydabber".

Veraiti besof habbarayta derabbi elazar ben azarya sheggamar omer, veze leshono: veze zerzo (yoter) meharishon, lechach neemar "vayyomer vegomer dabber el aharon" sheamarti lecha (Shemot 4:14) "halo aharon achicha hallevi veraacha vesamach belibbo", "veal yavo" vegomer, veim yavo hu met, ad kan leshono. tzarich ladaat minnayin matza lomar sheamar lo Adonai "halo vegomer veraacha" vegomer? vehaya nire shehuksha lo yittur tevat "achicha", velaze darash "achicha" – sheamarti lecha "halo aharon achicha hallevi", vehakkavvana ki yafchido shello yeera lo kemo sheera levanav, vehatztzad shemmimmennu yitchayyev amar lo kol ze hu letzad heyoto achiv achva nechona veneemana. ella shekkashe, ki betorat kohanim darash meamro "achicha" lerabbot bene aharon uchemo shekkatavti lemala, veefshar dedarshinan shenehem, vedochak.

Venire shekkavvanat hammaamar hu mimma sheanu roim she amar lemoshe ma shetztzarich sheyyomar leaharon shello yamut kevanav, umin harauy haya lo lomar ze achar "vayyomer Adonai dabber el aharon" lo mikkodem. laze amar ki leheyotam shene achim hanneimim ohavim ze et ze, keamro "halo aharon achicha hallevi" (Shemot 4:14) veramaz lo (zevachim kav.) sheyyittol kehunna velo hikpid, gam aharon biroto achiv hakkatan yigdal mimmennu veaf al pi chen samach belibbo, asher al ken hu omer lemoshe davar hannogea leaharon. venitkavven Adonai baze lihyot kullam keish echad. veim nomar shamma shedderashat "dabber el aharon" sheamarti lecha "halo aharon" vegomer hu derasha bifne atzmah veenah gemar derasha shellefaneha, nire ki amro "veal yavo" betosefet vav.

Ulefi peshat hakkatuv nire lomar ki beamro "veal yavo" betosefet havvav, velo hispik lo lomar "al yavo", lirmoz shello yosif hu laavor alav ma sheavar al banav, uchefi ze keillu beer hakkatuv shello yamut gam hu kevanav.

Veraiti leharav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi zichrono livracha shepperesh ki ledivre rabbi elazar ben azarya yesh shalosh mine azharot, veheerich leyashshev hakketuvim ledivre rabbi elazar ben azarya. ulefi dati lo nitkavven rabbi elazar ben azarya ella lomar shebbedibbur rishon amar Adonai lemoshe sheyyomar leaharon sheim yaavor yamut kederech shemmetu banav, vehuksha lo leeze inyan yetzavve Adonai kacha velo hispik beamro "velo yamut", laze himshil haddavar lerofe, sheharofe sheomer lachole shello yamut kederech shemmet peloni hu mezarzo beyoter. al ken tzivva Adonai kacha letosefet zeruz, verabbi elazar ben azarya lo himshil haddavar berofe echad ella bishlosha rofim, vechol rofe shier zeruz echad, verofe hammezarez veomer shello yamut kifloni lo hu shezzerez paam rishona usheniyya. uchefi ze seder sheasa Adonai hu kerofe hammezarez yoter mikkullan, ulefi divre haram eno dome lo lerofe rishon velo lashsheni velo lashshelishi, ki rofe rishon vesheni enam omrim kifloni vehashshelishi hu mezarzo befaam achat veomer lo shello yamut kifloni, ma sheen ken hakkadosh baruch hu shello tzivvahu ken ad paam shelishit. uledivre harm tzarich lidchok ulefaresh shehaddimyon hu nose echad lishlosha nosim yachad. vaadayin kashe lidvarav lamma asa rabbi elazar ben azarya haddimyon bishlosha nosim velo benose echad kede sheyyishve elav hannidme, ella vadday shello tzivva ella paam echad uveachat dibber elav hazzeruz shello yamut kevanav. uferush hakketuvim ledivre rabbi elazar ben azarya hem al ze hadderech: "vaydabber vegomer, achare mot" – dibbur echad. "dabber vegomer veal yavo" vegomer – dibbur sheni. bedibbur echad neemar lo emor leaharon shebbanav metu bishvil hahakrava, veemor dibbur sheni sheani metzavvehu leval yikrav gam hu, umimmotza davar muvan ki mezarzo leval yeera lo kederech shemmetu banav, vehu dimyon harofe hashshelishi shezzerzo yoter mikkullan.

rashi: Vattevatztzei reayich baoshek. heeshart et ohavayich baoshek sheashakt min haaniyyim. lashon acher: vattevatztzei – leshon gezel, kemo "uvotzea berech nietz Adonai" (tehillim 10:3); vecho pitrono: vattigzeli lereayich beoshek:
targum: Shochada kabbilu vich bedil lemishpach dam zakkay chibbuleya veribbita nesevt veahanet rechimach beunesa uppulechani shevakt amar Adonai elohim:

rashi: Rav mecholel kol. hakkadosh baruch hu bara et hakkol vedan et hakkol; kakkesil kechacham, en anu tzerichin leshum chachma:

Vesocher kesil. lo kevasar vadam shello yiskor ella poalim bekiim velo yiskor ella haoskim bimlachto, aval hakkadosh baruch hu mecholel kol vesocher hakkesilim vesocher over derachim habbatlanim mikkol melacha. umidrash aggada: vesocher kesil milleshon "vayyissachru mayenot tehom" (Bereshit 8:2), uleshon "ose secher" (Yeshayahu 19:10): hakkadosh baruch hu socher mazzal kesil hameshammesh bimot hachamma mittishre veelach, umeaz hu socher vesoger kol ovre hayyam millelech bo ad happesach. uvedivre rabbi moshe raiti: rav mecholel kol ashir yesh lo peullot harebe, veim socher kesil bimlachto hinne hu kesocher kol ovre derech sheroin bekilkul hammelacha, lehorot ech yittachen veech yesh lo lifol; vedavar rek hu, veeno inyan kan:
targum: Sage chayesh bisreh desachla viravya avar yama:

rashi: Ruach tzafon techolel gashem. tolid vetivra et haggeshem:

Ufanim nizamim techolel leshon sater. lashon hara gorem sheyyihyu pene hakkadosh baruch hu nizamim. vechen dimyon pitron hammikra: ruach tzafon asuya lcholel gashem, vleshon sater asuya lefanim nizamim:
targum: Rucha garvita vatna mitra hechna appe venisata velishana metashya:

rashi: Asher ani ose otach. poel lach kefoolech:
targum: Hayitkaf libbich im yitchasnan yedech leyomaya daana atid lemevad imach ana Adonai gezaret bememri vaakayem:

rashi: Hannefashot haosot. hazzachar vehannekeva vemashma (sifra):
Dam yechashev. keshofech dam haadam shemmitchayyev benafsho:
Dam shafach. lerabbot et hazzorek damim bachutz (sham):
Venichrat. zaro nichrat veyamav nichratin:
Vehizza veetzbao. hazzaa achat bemashma:
Velifne hakkapporet yazze sheva. hare achat lemala vesheva lematta (sham):
Kesher nevieha. niksharim yachad beetza raa:
Nefesh achalu. shehayu notlin shochad umachazikin yede mereim, laharog velishlol velavoz, venibbain lahem shalom:
Chosen. mamon:
targum: Siat safraha begavah kearyevan nahamin lemiktal ketol enasha ketalu oter vikar nesivu armaltaha asgiu begavah:

rashi: Vayhi devar Adonai elay lemor. hatishpot et ir haddamim. yerushalayim:
Vehodatah. mefik hei vehodatah, otah:
targum: Veat bar adam hatochach hatochach yat karta deishde dam zakkay begavah vechave lah yat kol toavataha:

rashi: Meal hammizbeach. hachitzon:
Millifne Adonai. mitztzad shellifne happetach, vehu tzad maaravi:

Dakka. ma tal dakka? vahalo chol hakketoret dakka hi, shenneemar veshachakta mimmenna hadek (Shemot 36), ella shettehe dakka min haddakka, shebbeerev yohakki haya machazirah lammachteshet (keritut 6):

ohc: Vehayta lachem vegomer. taam amro lachem, letzad shebbitchillat haddibbur amar elav Adonai "dabber el aharon", veachshav ba letzauot et yisrael kemo sheggamar omer haezrach vehagger, laze hutzrach lomar lachem, leval tite lomar ki mitzvat hakkohanim beyom kippur hu dibbur rishon shetztzivva Adonai bitchillat happarasha levad, umitzvat yisrael hi hainnuy, shekken rasham bedat Adonai, gam hassechel yaskim laze shehakkohanim peturim mehainnuy. o hakkohen haggadol miha bimkom innuyo hi avodato, vegam moshe tavo hassevara ladun alav ki eno tzarich innuy, uma gam laasher kadam lanu ki nizdakkech gufo vedame levar elahin malach Adonai en tzorech beinnuy. asher al ken tzivva Adonai veamar vehayta lachem perush, medabber im moshe veaharon sheggam hem bichlal hainnuy. uchede shello tachshov dedavka lemoshe veaharon yetzavve Adonai velo lechol yisrael, talmud lomar haezrach vehagger, uvesamuch yitbaer beofen acher.

Lechukkat olam. taam amro olam, letzad shettavo hassevara shello ba hainnuy ella lechapper avon, umeatta kol sheen rishshumo shel avon bammetziut beyisrael en chiyyuv bainnuy, laze amar chukkat olam. ufenimiyyut haddavar hu chukka shel olam habba, vehu sod nichmas.

Teannu et nafshotechem. perush, innuy hakkolel lannefesh behashevaa, veeze ze? meniat hammazon. veim atta omer sheyyeanne atzmo bimlacha, yishtanne haddavar bishne devarim: haechad – shemmitanne beyoter hachelek mimmennu hattoreach beotah melacha, veim ken en innuy hannefesh behashevaa, vehattora amra "teannu et nafshotechem". hashsheni – ki beseder ze yikkare innuy hagguf, ki habbasar hachay mityaggea, vehattora amra "nafshotechem". umeatta tam larik kocham shel hakkaraim.

Haezrach vehagger. betorat kohanim amru veze leshonam: "haezrach" – ezrach ze ezrach, "haezrach" lerabbot neshe ezrach, "ger" ze hagger, "hagger" lerabbot neshe hagger, "betochchem" lerabbot nashim vaavadim, ad kan. vaadayin tzerichin anu lemodai lamma hutzrach lezichron ezrach, veim bishvil ribbuy hei hammerabba nashim, ze taut, ki yesh leeloah millin ledabber beofen sheyyerabbe hatztzerichin lehitrabbot mibbeli tosefet afillu ot achat lelo tzorech.

Veyitbaer hainyan al pi ma sheamru bemassechet sukka (28:) veze leshonam: amar mar, "haezrach" – lerabbot hannashim leinnuy yom kippur. amar rava: midderabbi yehuda amar rav nafka, deamar rabbi yehuda amar rav: hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashin shebbattora. umetaretz: lo nitzrecha ella letosefet innuy. salka datach amena: hoil umiet rachamana letosefet innuy meonesh veazhara, lo yitchayyevu nashim, ka mashma lan, ad kan. veal pi haddevarim haelle yesh taam baddavar shehutzrach hakkatuv lehazekir ezrach, letzad sheharibbuy hei al hattosefet innuy. laze nitchakkem Adonai vezachar shenehem yachad – hammitrabbe ureshimat davar shebbo mitrabbe, vehu amro haezrach, perush, ezrach ze ezrach shechayyav gam betosefet innuy karashum bemakom acher, vedome lo hu hammitrabbe betevat hei, veen chilluk benehem. veachar shehuchrach lomar haezrach lattaam haamur, chash sheyyite hattoe lomar sheamro haezrach hu lemaet hagger sheeno begeder ze shel mitzvat yom kippur, talmud lomar hagger. veim haya omer ger levad belo hei, haya levaal haddin lechallek chilluk nachon, ki neshe hagger lo, shehare hakkatuv chillek ben yisrael leger – shebbeyisrael ribba hannashim uvaggerim lo ribba. laze hutzrach lomar hagger lerabbot neshe hagger. od nire leyashshev taam hakkatuv shehutzrach lefaret kol happeratim, letzad shehutzrach lefaret hakkohanim kemo shepperashnu betevat "lachem", meatta chal alav lefaret gam haezrachim leval yavo hattaut ki lakkohanim levaddam yetzav Adonai, veachar shekken, chal alav lefaret kol hannirmazim bapparasha.

rashi: Vat avicha. af bat anusa vemashma:
Moledet bayit o moledet chutz. ben sheomrim lo leavicha kayyem et immah, uven sheomrim lo hotze et immah, kegon mamzeret o netina (yevamot 23):

Ushemartem et chukkotay vegomer. lerabbot shear dikduke happarasha, shello peret hakkatuv bahem; davar acher litten shemira vaasiyya lachukkim ushemira vaasiyya lammishpatim, lefi shello natan ella asiyya lammishpatim ushemira lachukkim (sifra):
Vachay bahem. laolam habba, sheim tomar baolam hazze vahalo sofo hu met (sham):
Ani Adonai. neeman leshallem sachar (sham):
ohc: Ushemartem vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar devarim atzmam sheamar besamuch. veyitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (sanhedrin ad.) sheamru "vachay bahem" – velo sheyyamut bahem, sheim anasuhu laavor al achat mimmitzvot Adonai yaavor velo yehareg. veamru od ki al shalosh averot chayyav adam lehareg velo yaavor, vehem: avoda zara, gilluy arayot, shefichut damim. meatta amar pasuk rishon samuch lemitzvat arayot, velo hitna hakkatuv "asher yaase vegomer vachay bahem", veamar pasuk sheni letzauot al shear hammitzvot, veamar vachay bahem ledayyek velomar shebbemitzvot shenneemru bappasuk shellefanenu shello amar "vachay bahem" – yehareg veal yaavor.

Od nire behair od lamma shinna hakkatuv bishne ketuvim, barishon amar "ani Adonai elohechem", uvefasuk sheni amar "ani Adonai". achen keneged shene banim dibbera tora: echad haose miyyira veechad haose meahava, uchevar nitbaaru haddevarim bimkomot acherim (sota lo.) ki haose miyyira secharo leelef dor vehaose meahava secharo kaful laalafim. vehinne min hannimna sheyyassig hammassig bechinat haahava ad shettakdim lo bechinat hayyira, besod (tehillim 118:20) "ze hashshaar laAdonai", vaasher al ken amar hakkatuv keneged bechinat hayyira "et mishpatay vegomer ani Adonai elohechem", dikdek lehazekir bechinat haddin shehu ramuz beshem elohim, lehaircha bemi hakkatuv medabber, veachar kach tzivva legader sheni laasot meahava, velaze amar ani Adonai velo hizkir shem elohut lomar shettihye hashshemira letzad ahavat hattov vehachefetz veharatzon paal bo laasot maamar kono hechaviv meahavato oto, hagam shello haya onesh laover.

Veamar vachay bahem, perush ki adam sheose meahava yeshno gam betuv olam hazze yeter al haggemul hakkavua lo baolam hannitzchi. veulay ki laze ramaz beamro "vachay" betosefet vav, lehaircha shezze nosaf al sachar acher shehu sachar hannelam, ma sheen ken geder harishon sheose miyyira sheen lo ella laolam haelyon, keamro "lalechet bahem" laolam haelyon. aval geder ze "vachay bahem", perush, lo leatid levad, sheim ken haya lo lomar "veyichye", ella meet toomo taam hammitzvot beerech ze "vachay bahem". ulederech ze yitbaer gam ken ma sheamar befarashat (Devarim 11:14) "vehaya im shamoa" sheamar "venatatti metar artzechem" vegomer, perush letzad sheshsham neemar "leahava et Adonai" vegomer, laze hodia ki mitzva zo yesh lah sachar gam baolam hazze, verauy hu lehanot bishne olamot. vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (kiddushin lat:) sechar mitzvot behay alma lekka, ze yeshno bahatava zo, veramaz olam haelyon bema sheamar "venatatti" betosefet vav bitchillat yiud hassachar, lomar en ze ella tosefet al hannelam hammuskol hannitzchi.

Haadam vegomer. bemassechet shabbat veze leshonam (bava kamma lach.; avoda zara 3.): amar rabbi yehuda, minnayin sheafilu goy veosek battora shehu kechohen gadol? dichtiv "asher yaase otam haadam vachay" vegomer, kohanim leviyyim yisreelim lo neemar ella "haadam", ad kan. perush, letzad shehukesha lerabbi yehuda yittur "haadam", od hukesha lo, lamma dibber hakkatuv bilshon nistar, shehaya lo lomar "asher taasu otam" kederech shehitchil ledabber "ushemartem" vegomer lenocheach, umikkoach ze darash shennitkavven lemi shello haya sham beoto matztzav, sheeno lo kohen velo levi velo yisrael, umi ze? heve omer ze goy. vehattosafot zichronam livracha hikshu mibbarayta (bava metzia 114.) sheddarash rabbi shimon pasuk (Yechezkel 34:31) "adam attem", attem keruyim adam vechulei. veamru sheyyesh lechallek ben "adam" lehaadam", ad kan. uchemo chen raiti besefer hazzohar (chelek 1 25.) shechilluk ze amitti mitztzad atzmo, vehu davar shebbeminyan taluy, kayyadua leyode chen, shecheshbon hammeulle hu shel "adam" velo shel "haadam", ki hammosif gorea. veulay ki kesheosek haggoy battora gam alav yihye keter ze likkarot "adam", uchefi ze ot hei shebbehaadam" have ribbuy haggoy, sheggam hu yikkare adam kesheosek battora, veen ot hahe kan meikkar hashshem, vehaven.

rashi: Kadashay bazit. velo kemo sheamarti "lirtzonchem tizbachu" (Vayikra 19:5):
targum: Al kudeshe bisart veyat yome shabbaya dili achelt:

rashi: Veet chelev hachattat. emure par vesair:
Yaktir hammizbecha. al mizbeach hachitzon, deillu bappenimi chetiv lo taalu alav ketoret zara veola umincha (Shemot 30):
Ki gechalim. hem lo sheatta chote veshoev min hammedura latet al rosho:
Chote. kol sheivat gechalim mittoch hahessek kare chote, kedaamar "lachtot esh miyyakud" (Yeshayahu 30:14):
VaAdonai yeshallem lach. yashlimennu immach, shello yitgabber alecha:
targum: Metul degumere denura chate ant al resheh veelaha neshalmeh lach:

rashi: Ketonet bad vegomer. maggid sheeno meshammesh lifnim bishmona vegadim shehu meshammesh bahen bachutz, sheyyesh bahem zahav, lefi sheen kategor naase sanegor, ella bearbaa kechohen hedyot — vechullan shel butz (rosh hashshana 26):
Kodesh yilbash. sheyyihyu mishshel hekdesh (sifra):
Yitznof. ketargumo, yachet beresheh — yanniach berosho, kemo vattannach bigdo (Bereshit 39) — vaachittete:

Verachatz bammayim. oto hayyom taun tevila bechol chalifotav; vechamesh peamim haya machalif meavodat penim laavodat chutz, umichutz lifnim, umeshanne mibbigde zahav levigde lavan umibbigde lavan levigde zahav, uvechol chalifa taun tevila ushene kiddushe yadayim veraglayim min hakkiyyor (yoma 31):
ohc: Ketonet bad kodesh. im amro "kodesh" bakketonet velo hispik bema sheggamar omer "bigde kodesh hem". ulay shechash hakkatuv sheyyadun adam bedato shello tzivva Adonai laasot mishshel kodesh ella sheloshet habbegadim chutz min hakketonet, ki hakketonet hu malbush hammitchayyev lechol adam lilbosh veyihye mishshello, veal hashshelosha hu sheamar "bigde kodesh", shehem begadim sheyyecholim lihyot letzad kevod mesharte elyon. laze amar ketonet bad vegomer sheggam hi kodesh. uchede shello tachshov ki davka ketonet chakak Adonai shettihye shel kodesh, laze chazar veamar bigde kodesh hem kullam yachad.

Od nire lomar ki mitkavven lomar shene devarim: haechad shehabbad sheyyaasu mimmennu hakketonet yihye shel kodesh, vehu haddin lishar begadim, vehodia hakkatuv hammishpat bammizdammen rishon. veinyan sheni hu sheggam maase habbegadim yihye shel kodesh, vehu ma sheggamar omer bigde kodesh hem:

Od nire ki mitkavven beamro bigde kodesh hem, leval yerae haddavar shehu chutz mehammusar, ki eved melech shehu hakkohen asher pearo Adonai vechibbedo bemalbushe chavod, dichtiv (Shemot 28:2) "lechavod uletifaret", uveet asher yitalle lesherut gadol kaze yomar elav hored edyecha mealecha, laze amar bigde kodesh hem perush begadim haruyim lakkodesh hem velo acherim. vehattaam ki habbegadim hamefoarim hahem yesh bahem devarim bego, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 21; rosh hashshana 26.) en kategor naase sanegor.

O yirmoz taam (Mishlei 25:6) "al tithaddar lifne melech" adonenu baruch hu kadosh venora shemo, vehu amro bigde kodesh hem, perush, shebbahem rauy lehishtammesh bekodesh kadashim asher chone sham haelohim. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru "kodesh yilbash" sheyyihyu shel kodesh, perush kol haarbaa nilmadim mikketonet sheyyihyu shel kodesh, vechazar lomar bigde kodesh hem, darshu zichronam livracha (torat kohanim) shebba lelammed al kol bigde kehunna sheyyihyu shel kodesh, veellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim.

rashi: Maade beged beyom kara. "beged iddim" (yeshaya 64:5): beged musar, keli shehu rauy lahasiro mealav lefi shehu baluy; kedimtargeminan "vayyasar" (Bereshit 8:13): "veyade" (targum uneklos). veze pitrono: beged baluy hare hu beyom kara kechometz al nater. nater. min adama rakka, kegon adama shellanu hannikra kerida, vehayu chokkim otah veosin kelim; veim yippol bo chometz, memasmeso venishchat. af shar bashshirim al lev ra. dome lishnehem. uma hu shar bashshirim? ze hammelammed tora letalmid rasha asher en belibbo lekayyemah (chullin 133.):
targum: Deshakel martuta min chavreh beyom dekarta hech hu derame chela al nitra umetzaref lelibba checha hech sasa lemana veech maltita bekita hechna baryuta machada libbeh degavra:

rashi: Veel heharim achlu vach. "uveturayya pelachu bech letaavavta" (targum yonatan):
Zimma asu. etzot shel reshaa:
targum: Gavre achle kuretza hayo vich bedil lemishpach dam zakkay uveturaya felachu vich letaavata are etzat chetin avadu vegavich:

rashi: Venasa avono. im yochal kodesh o yikkanes lammikdash chayyav al tuma zo kechol shear tumot (sifra):
Uvesaro lo yirchatz venasa avono. al rechitzat gufo anush karet veal kibbus begadim bemalkut (sham):
Shen roa. retzutza:
Muadet. kemo "velo maadu karsullay" (tehillim 18:37):
Mivtach boged. mechazzev bo beyom tzarato keshen retzutza umuedet:
targum: Ech shina vishta verigla muada hechna savreh devazoza beyoma deakta:

rashi: Devash matzata vegomer:
targum: Divsha mashkacht echol sufekanach dela tisba utetivineh:

rashi: Ir shofechet dam betochah lavo ittah. hare ze mikra mesoras, vezehu perusho: ir shofechet dam betochah, amar Adonai elohim, lavo ittah:
Veasta gillulim. kemo vaasher asta gillulim vegomer:
targum: Vetemar kidnan amar Adonai elohim karta deashde dam zakkay begavah meta idan tavrah udefalchin letaavata vegavah bedil lesaavuta:

rashi: Im raev sonaacha. kemashmao, verabbotenu pershuhu (socha nov,1-2) al yetzer hara: im raev hu veomer lecha lehasebio baaverot, meshoch et atzmecha levet hammidrash vehaachilehu millachmah shel tora, vechen hashekehu mayim. mimeha shel tora:
targum: In kafen sanach ochleh lachma vein tzache ashkeh maya:

rashi: Ervat achi avicha lo tegalle. uma hi ervato? el ishto lo tikrav:
Av vaem hekallu vach. kol hattoevot shebbefarashat kedoshim tihyu (Vayikra 19-20), shehuzeharu alehem, nimnu chan:
targum: Abba veima akilu vach legiora anisu onsa begavich yatmin vearmelan oniu vich:

rashi: Ad shenotayich. gezerat "venoshantem" (Devarim 4:25) begimatriyya sheamar moshe:
Vekallasa. dibba; shehakkol nidbarim bach; parleritz belaaz:
targum: Bechovat dam zakkay diashadt chavt ubbefulechan taavatech diflacht istaavt vekarev yom tavrich umeta idan bishtich al ken yehavtich chisudin leammaya uleev lechol midinata:

rashi: Uva aharon el ohel moed. amru rabbotenu sheen ze mekomo shel mikra ze venatnu taam ledivrehem bemassechet yoma (daf 32), veamru: kol happarasha kullah neemra al hasseder chutz mibbia zo shehi achar ashiyyat olato veolat haam, vehaketarat emure par veshair, shennaashim bachutz bevigde zahav, vetovel umekaddesh ufoshtan velovesh bigde lavan, uva el ohel moed lehotzi et hakkaf veet hammachta shehiktir bah hakketoret lifnay velifnim:

Ufashat et bigde habbad. achar shehotziah, velovesh bigde zahav letamid shel ben haarbayim; vezehu seder haavodot: tamid shel shachar bevigde zahav, vaavodat par vesair happenimiyyim uketoret shel machta bevigde lavan, veelo veel haam umiktzat hammusafin bevigde zahav, vehotzaat kaf umachta bevigde lavan, usheyare hammusafin vetamid shel ben haarbayim uketoret hahechol sheal mizbeach happenimi bevigde zahav; veseder hammikraot lefi haavodot kach hu: veshillach et hassair bammidbar, verachatz et besaro vammayim vegomer, veyatza veasa et olato vegomer, veet chelev hachattat vegomer, vechol happarasha ad veachare chen yavo el hammachane — veachar kach uva aharon:
Vehinnicham sham. melammed shetteunin geniza velo yishtammesh beotan 4 vegadim leyom hakkippurim acher (yoma 12):
Al nefesh ayefa. asuya lehashiv nefesh ayefa:
Ushemua tova. af hi shava lahem, vechen yaakov: "vattechi ruach yaakov avihem" (Bereshit 45:27):
targum: Maya karire al nafsha meshalhata hechna shemuata tavta min ara rechikta:

rashi: Kol nefesh mikkem. lehazehir gedolim al hakketannim:
Vehizza alav min haddam. achar shennatan mattanot beetzbao al karnotav mazze sheva hazzaot al gaggo:
Vetiharo. mimma sheavar:
Vekiddesho. leatid lavo (sifra):
Vayyomer Adonai el moshe dabber el aharon achicha veal yavo. shello yamut kederech shemmetu vanav:
Velo yamut. sheim ba hu met (sifra):

Ki beanan erae. ki tamid ani nire sham im ammud anani, ulefi sheggilluy shechinati sham, yizzaher shello yargil lavo, zehu feshuto; umidrasho: lo yavo ki im baanan hakketoret beyom hakkippurim (yoma 53):
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai. taam leshon amira, letzad shehaazhara baa betokef, sheim yavo yamut, kemo sheddarash rabbi elazar ben azarya (torat kohanim kan). laze hodio ki en ze ella chibba yetera kederech harofe shemmishtaddel lezarez hachole leval yamut, uchedimyon rabbi elazar ben azarya, vehu ma sheramaz bilshon amira.

O yirtze ki Adonai giddel veromem et moshe, sheggam dibbur hannogea leaharon levaddo lo dibber Adonai im aharon ella im moshe, vehu amro vayyomer Adonai el moshe al derech "vaAdonai heemircha" (Devarim 26:18). vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 14:21; resh torat kohanim) sheafillu bemakom sheamar hakkatuv "vaydabber Adonai el moshe veel aharon" hakkavvana bo lemoshe sheyyomar leaharon, veze lecha haot sheafillu mitzvat aharon lo neemra leaharon, veim haya Adonai medabber im aharon lo haya tzarich letzauoto al yede shaliach.

Veal yavo – amar vav bitchillat dibbur, millevad ma shekkatavnu lemala, nire od lomar ki letzad shekkadam moshe veamar leaharon beyom rishon limshichato (Vayikra 9:7) "kerav el hammizbeach vaase" vegomer, mashmaut haddevarim yaggidu ki lammizbeach yikrav velo lifnim min hammizbeach, veamru meore olam shehem rabbotenu zichronam livracha (fesachim ma:) ki lav habba mikkelal ase ase, umeatta hare kadam lo al hakkenisa ase, laze hosif kan lav al haddavar veamar veal yavo.

Bechol et – aval yesh et sheyyavo bah, vehu ma sheamar achar kach "bezot yavo" vegomer achat bashshana. vetaam shehikdim veal yavo bechol et kodem mitzvat biato achat bashshana, lomar im lo yavo bechol et az yizke lavo baet hahi asher anochi metzavvecha, veim yavo beet acher lo yavo bechol et afillu beet harishyon. vedikdek lomar bechol et, darshu razal (torat kohanim) shebba leesor afillu beyom kippur atzmo lo yikkanes ella laddevarim harshumim bichtav emet lehaketir ulehazzot. ulederech ze hirvachnu dikduk nachon acher betosefet vav shel veal yavo, lomar millevad azharat yemot hashshana od mosif lomar sheafillu beyom kippur atzmo lo yavo. veazharat shear yamim darshu zichrono livracha (torat kohanim) mehappasuk atzmo sheamar "el hakkodesh" velo hispik lomar "mibbet lapparochet" umuvan hammakom asher yetzavve alav. veal yikshe beenecha hakedamat havvav, ki chen derech hakkatuv, uvimkomot acherim heerachti behochachat haddevarim.

Ki beanan erae. perush, letzad shekkadam hakkatuv veamar (Vayikra 9:23) "vayyera chevod Adonai", hodia ki lo bechina zo levad hi hannimtzet bifnim, ella bechina gedola or elyon, ki gavoah meal gavoah shomer, vehu amro erae al hakkapporet.

rashi: Vechipper hakkohen asher yimshach vegomer. kappara zo shel yom hakkippurim enah keshera ella bechohen gadol (yoma 73); lefi shenneemra chol happarasha beaharon, hutzrach lomar bechohen gadol habba acharav sheyyehe chamohu:

Vaasher yemalle et yado. en li ella hammashuach beshemen hammishcha, merubbe vegadim minnayin? tal vaasher yemalle et yado vegomer; vehem kol hakkohanim gedolim sheamdu miyyoshiyyahu vaelach, shebbeyamav nigneza tzelochit shel shemen hammishcha (horayot 12):
Lechahen tachat aviv. lelammed sheim beno memalle et mekomo, hu kodem lechol adam (sifra):
Vehattimmoti. vechilliti:
targum: Veagle yatich levene ammaya veavadrinach bimdinata vaasif seovtich minech:

rashi: Ish lizroo. kol deallim gavar (bava batra lod:):
targum: Ha ravreve yisrael gevar letukefeh havo vich bedil lemishpach dam zakkay:

rashi: Bezot. gimatriyya shello arba meot veeser, remez levayit rishon (Vayikra Rabba 21):
Bezot yavo aharon vegomer. veaf zo lo vechol et, ki im beyom hakkippurim, kemo shemmeforash besof happarasha "bachodesh hashshevii beasor lachodesh" (sham):
ohc: Bezot yavo aharon. taam shehizkir aharon velo samach al zichrono bitchillat hainyan, letzad shemma shekkadam bammitzva lo haya ella leaharon levaddo shello yikkanes velo yamut, veen mitzva zo nogaat lezulato, umikkan vaelach lo leaharon levad baa hammitzva ella gam lechol yisrael, ki hu tzorech yisrael likkanes levet kadshe kadashim lechapper alehem achat bashshana, vitzav hael leammo laasot hachukkim haamurim sheyyachnisu aharon befar vegomer ketonet bad kodesh vegomer, vedarshu zichronam livracha (torat kohanim kan) mishshel kodesh, shehi terumat hallishka, uchefi ze yitchayyev hakkatuv lehazekir shem hammitzva bechinnuy lahem.

rashi: Mekatztze raglayim chamas shote. mi sheshsholeach devarim beyad kesil hu mekatztze ragle sheluchim harebe, lachazor velishloach letakken ma sheivvet harishon, asher shelacho battechilla; veshote chamas. shechavero zoef alav al shelichut hakkesil:
targum: Man derahata verigloy shete chatofa man dimshadar mile veyad sichla:

rashi: Dalyu shokayim mippisseach. gavhu, kemo "dallu enay" (Yeshayahu 38:14); hashshokayim shel kol adam nirin lappisseach gevohim mimmennu. vedavar ze mashal befi chesil, haomer oto al limmud hachachma: ech anu baim lilmod hachachma? niflaa ugevoha hi mimmennu! hammashal omer: dalyu shokayim mippisseach:
targum: In tittal halechta lachagira tekabbel milta min pumeh desichla:

rashi: Tevel hu. leshon kadesh veerva veniuf, vechen veappi al tavlitam (Yeshayahu 10); davar acher tevel hu leshon belila veirbuv zera adam vezera behema:
Lasseirim. lashshedim, kemo ushoirim yerakkedu sham (Yeshayahu 13):
Ervat eshet avicha. lerabbot achar mita (sham):
Asher yatzud. en li ella tzayid, avazin vetarnegolin minnayin? tal "tzed" mikkol makom; im ken lamma neemar "asher yatzud"? shello yochal basar ella bahazemana hazzot (chullin 84):
Asher yeachel. perat litmeim (sham 85):
ohc: Asher yatzud tzed vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan hutzrach hakkatuv lichtov kol ze, shello haya lo lomar ella "ish asher yishchat chayya o" vegomer o "asher yishpoch dam" vegomer. od, im gezerat haddevarim hi mitzvat hakkissuy, haya lo lomar "yechassehu beafar", ki amro "vechissahu" mashma shekkadma mitzva acheret.

Venire ki beamro asher yatzud nitkavven leesor tzedat min tame lechattechilla, hagam shehittiro hakkatuv bahanaa, uchemo sheheeleti besifri peri toar siman 117 kedaat rambam (maachalot asurot perek 8) sheen hetter letzudam ella im mitkavven latzud tehorim venizdammenu immahem temeim, vehu maamar hakkatuv kan asher yatzud vegomer tenay hu haddavar sheen mattir lo latzud ella asher yeachel velo asher lo yeachel. veamar vechissahu letzad shekkadam mitzva acheret shello latzud shello yeachel yutzdak lomar vechissahu betosefet vav. veamar veshafach vegomer, perush, sheasur leachlo kederech sheamar bemakom acher (Devarim 12:16): "lo tochlennu al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim", velaze gamar omer kan veamar ki nefesh kol basar vegomer vaomar vegomer, ha lamadta ki nitkavven bemaamar veshafach leesor achilat dam chayya vaof. nimtzeta omer shalosh mitzvot neemru kan: 1 lo yatzud temeim lehanot mehem, 2 lo yochal dam chayya vaof, 3 mitzvat ase lechassot dam chayya vaof.
Od nire sheramaz beamro veshafach vechissahu, sheen tzarich lechassot kol damo, ella chelek bishficha vechelek bechissuy (chullin pach.).

Velakach et shene hasseirim vegomer. parasha zo tzericha lemodai ki lamma yetzavve Adonai davar kaze, veim hi mehammitzvot asher lo asa Adonai bahem taam, haya lo lomar chukka, uma gam tigdal hakkushya ledivrehem zichronam livracha (raya mehemana achare 63, zohar chelek 3 101) ki azazel hi bechinat tzad hara, hinne kimat chas veshalom sheyyidme haddavar laavoda zara, uma gam shemtzavve Adonai (yoma 86.) lehashevot sair shel shem lesair ze shel davar acher, haddevarim mavhilim!

Venire lomar al pi hakedamot shehodiunu razal, veze yatza rishona: tenan bemishnat chasidim (avot 84): haose mitzva achat kone lo sanegor echad, vehaover avera achat kone lo kategor echad, ad kan. umeforashim haddevarim baer hetev al pi divre hazzohar hakkadosh (zohar 10 76, 11 122 88), uvehaskala muskol elyon al pi haari zichrono livracha levae behechle melech, ki mehaavera atzmah yivvaled davar ra shehu atzmo heavon sheasa, uveyado nimsar osehu, keamro "teyasserech raatech" (yirmeya 2), "vattemugenu beyad avonenu" (yeshaya sad). velaze keshemmachal Adonai ledavid hodio sheavad hakkoach hara shennolad mehammaase habbilti hagun, keamro (Shmuel 2 12): "gam Adonai heevir chattatcha lo tamut". hakkavvana baze, kevan shehachet sheose haadam nivra mimmennu hannifra meosehu, mimmela baavod hammashchit en mashchit. veze sheamar lo Adonai sheachar sheheevir chattato lo yamut ki en memit. meatta, kevan sheal yede hammaasim notzarim devarim haraim hammazzikim vehammetzaarim et haadam, tzivva Adonai hammaadif tuvo alenu veamar ki chol sheose davar bilti hagun belo yedia mechattovt haadam yavi karban, vetzivva sheyyismoch alav baal hakkarban. vehattaam, ki baze yureku hachitzonim hahem shennithauu mimmaasav haraim al hakkarban hahu. ufeulla zo hodia Adonai shettease bisgullat havaat haadam karbano levet elohenu vesomech alav sham, yease haddavar bechoach hashshalem shel elohe haruchot lechol basar. veze hu taam shetztzivva Adonai hassemicha bachattaot. vehinne kol hammaase asher yease bechattat, zevach vehaketara, yafil babbechina hahi hannimshechet mehaadam bakkarban hahu al yede semichato kannizkar, uvaze hi neekeret bechinat hara. uchevar yadata ki en chattat baa ella al hachataot shehu haddavar sheose haadam beshogeg, mishshum dela nafish zohameh, ma sheen ken al avon sheose haadam bemezid, denafish zohameh, en meviin karban. veze amro (Mishlei 21): "zevach reshaim toeva", ki yetaavehu Adonai baruch hu lehakeriv al mizbecho tiuv kaze, sheen lecha meus baolam kemeus vezihum heavon rachamana litzlan.

Ulefi hakedama zo yitbaer hainyan al nachon, behakedim ma shekkatvu razal betorat kohanim veze leshonam: "vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot bene yisrael umippishehem" vegomer – al zedon tumat mikdash vekadashav sair hannaase bifnim veyom kippur mechapper, veal shear averot shebbattora hakkallot vehachamurot, hazzedonot vehashshegagot, hoda velo hoda, ase velo taase, keretot umitot bet din – sair hammishtalleach mechapper, ad kan leshonam. uvashshas veze leshonam: vesair shel azazel nose alav kol hazzedonot kallot vachamurot ushegagot vechulei. vegam hakkohanim kapparatan besair hammishtalleach, keamram zichrono livracha bemassechet zevachim perek 1 (menachot tzav.; shevuot 13:) veze leshonam: rabbi yehuda omer, gam hakkohanim mitkapperin besair hammishtalleach. veachar shehodianu Adonai et kol zot hinne shellecha lefanecha taam maspik ki hashshene seirim nosim kol zuhame tachalue hannefesh. hassair shennose alav zedon tumat mikdash vekadashav kibbelo Adonai velo tiavo, aval sair hannose zuhamot kol haaverot kallot vachamurot tzivva Adonai sheyyeabbedem vichallem chutz mimmekom hakkodesh, vetzivva sheyyismoch aharon alav et yadav shehu shelucham shel yisrael vechol asher osim sham hu haya ose sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto. veamar "venatan otam al rosh hassair hachay" – beer hakkatuv hetev haddavar shebbismichato hu noten kol hattumot hammezohamot hahem al rosho. veamar "venasa hassair", modia ki yimmatze bo bechinat hamekabbel lissa et hara hahu el eretz vegomer.

Ulehavin hainyan, mashal lemelech shebbikker bigde banav veraa bahem begadim nekiyyim vechetem bo, meshafshefo beyado venotno livno. uchesheraa beged meluchlach harebe notno leeved echad meavadav asher lo yimas haddavar hammaus. ken haddavar hazze, hammelech hu malkenu yitromem shemo, keshemmevi lefanav karban im hu bifrat vetaharat ketem kol shehu, shehem kitme hashshegaga o perat echad shel tumat mikdash vekadashav kannizkar, lo yetoav hakkarban elav. aval kol hazzuhama shel kol haaverot sheasu yisrael, kallot vachamurot, hu meus gadol, veamar sheyyolichuhu leeved echad meharchokim mehammelucha letzad heyoto mehappechutim vekalle haerech, vehu yishbor viabbed veyimchak otam. veen ze ella kenoten lo sherut mevuzze laasot, veaf al pi chen lemaala hu lo shechashavo haadon laasot lo davar mimma shehaya lifne el bevet hammikdash, venaasa hassair hahu behashevaa im hassair hammitkarev lifne el. vetaam shetztzivva Adonai asot kacha velo amar sheyyikchu sair mehashshuk vishallechuhu laazazel achar shehitvadda alav, hu letzad ki min hannimna sheyyitkabbetzu kol hattumot sheasu yisrael bemaasehem haraim veyavou al rosh hassair ki im bahavio hassair lifne Adonai, veachar shehuva lifne Adonai, meaz muchach ki hu ze hassair sheyyissa kol hattiuv veyelech lo el eretz gezera. laze tzivva lehageril vehu habbocher yivchar et hassair asher yivchar bitvunato yitbarach bevaale chayyim, uma gam lema sheamru hammekubbalim ki kamma nefashot venitzotzot bevaale chayyim bilti medabber, umi yeda bilti yitbarach shemo. gam yesh sod baggoral (zohar 3, 101), vehaven:

Vehameshalleach vegomer laazazel. tzarich ladaat ma hu azazel, verabbotenu zichronam livracha (yoma 67:) pershu az vekashe. veyesh baze harebe derashot, al kol panim en haddaat mityashshevet. vayyeoru enay bedivre anshe emet shonin besh nehorim shel tora, sheamru (Zohar 10 157.) ki hammidbar hecharuv hu mekom 100 harasha, uchefi ze bechina zo tikkare "midbar", vetikkare "azazel", vetikkare "uza vaazael", sheamru zichronam livracha shellahem yirmoz shem ze. veulay ki hatteva taggid ze al ze hadderech: az azal, perush makom shel otam sheazal veasaf oz peeram. o al ze hadderech: aza zal, perush mekom shel koach hazzal hahu, leshon zilut ufechitut, ki 100 hu lematta bemadrega mikkol mesharte elyon.

rashi: Yoomad chay. kemo yuamad chay — al yede acherim, vetargumo yittakam kad chay; ma tal? lefi shenneemar leshalleach oto laazazel veeni yodea shillucho im lemita im lechayyim, lechach neemar yoomad chay, amidato chay ad sheyyishtalleach, mikkan sheshshillucho lemita (sifra):
Lechapper alav. sheyyitvadde alav, kedichtiv "vehitvadda alav" vegomer:
ohc: Yoomad chay. tzarich ladaat hakkavvana, verabbotenu zichronam livracha (yoma 40.; torat kohanim) darshu harebe derushim. uledarkenu yitparesh al nachon shennitkavven beamro "yoomad chay" shello yitvadde alav techef umiyyad kesheyyaale alav haggoral ella yannichehu chay, perush, letzad ki bechinat hara nikret met, veal shemah yikkare hagguf belo neshama met, leheyot sheshsholetet bo bechinat hattuma hannikret met, vehassair shel azazel keshemmitvadde hakkohen alav venoten alav kol haavonot vehappeshaim vechulei hinne hu met kalul mikkol mine mitot, vetzivva haadon shello yaasehu met ella yoomad chay. velaze timtza sheomer od achar kach vesamach aharon vegomer al rosh hassair hachay vehitvadda vegomer venasa hassair alav, ki mittechilla kodem shehitvadda kerao chay veachar kach amar "hassair" velo hizkir "hachay", lomar sheachar shehitvadda alav eno chay, shekkevar kochot shel mita yardu alav. vetimtza shetztzivva Adonai shehammeshallecho tame vichabbes begadav verachatz besaro bammayim kedin teme met.

rashi: Et par hachattat asher lo. haamur lemala, velimmedcha kan shemmishshello hu va velo mishshel tzibbur (sham 3):
Vechipper baado uvead beto. mitvadde alav avonotav vaavonot beto (sham 36):

Ervat bat bincha vegomer. bevitto meanusato hakkatuv medabber, uvitto uvat bitto meishto anu lemedin meervat ishsha uvittah", shenneemar bahen "lo tegalle", ben shehi mimmennu uven shehi meish acher (sham 22):
Ervat bat bincha. kal vachomer levittecha, ella lefi sheen mazhirin min haddin, lemaduha miggezera shava bemassechet yevamot (daf 3):
Veasahu chattat. keshemmaniach haggoral alav kore lo shem veomer "laAdonai chattat":
Asher yishchat shor o chesev. bammukdashin hakkatuv medabber, shenneemar "lehakeriv karban" (zevachim 107):
Bammachane. chutz laazara:
ohc: Ish ish vegomer asher yishchat. taam kefel "ish ish". bizvachim (108.) darshu alibba derabbi shimon lerabbot hashshochet lehedyot shechayyav, ucheillu amar "ish leish", velo darshu lerabbot shenayim sheshshachatu mishshum sheamar hakkatuv "laish hahu venichrat haish hahu", vedarshu tevat "hahu" achat lemaute mutee veanus veshogeg, veechad lemaet shenayim sheshshachatu al ze hadderech – "hahu" velo hem. vekashe, shebbetorat kohanim darshu lemaet shenayim sheshshachatu middichtiv "dam shafach" velo mittevat "hahu". veyesh lomar ki leheyot sheyyesh shene miutim "hahu" veshafach", vedarshu betorat kohanim miut echad leshogeg veanus umutee, umiut echad lemaet shenayim sheshshachatu, eno makpid hashshas lehametzi miut shenayim sheshshachatu mishafach" o mehahu", veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze.

Asher yishchat. betorat kohanim amru veze leshonam: en li ella vechulei, minnayin leshochet of? talmud lomar "o asher yishchat". vahalo din hu, uma shechita vechulei melika vechulei eno din vechulei, talmud lomar "asher yishchat" – al hashshechita hu chayyav veeno chayyav al hammelika, ad kan. mashma ki mittevat "o" merabbe shechitat of, umeasher yishchat" memaet hammelika shehayta baa bekal vachomer. vekashe, mibberayta shehevi bemassechet zevachim (107.) muchach ki rabbi yishmael doresh measher yishchat" lerabbot shechita laof, umimma sheamar hakkatuv "ze haddavar" miet hammelika shehayta baa bekal vachomer. vegam lerabbi akiva shecholek sham im rabbi yishmael, doresh ribbuy shechitat haof middam yechashev" umiut hammelika measher yishchat" kidmuchach mehashshas sham. veim ken, berayta shel torat kohanim lo rabbi akiva velo rabbi yishmael. vehinne behechreach lomar ki berayta shel torat kohanim enah kerabbi yishmael, mimma sheddarash sham "ze haddavar" ligzera shava, ma "ze haddavar" vechulei "el rashe hammattot" vechulei, im ken behechreach shello kerabbi yishmael. gam mimma shello darash betorat kohanim yittur "dam yechashev" lidrashat rabbi yishmael lerabbot hazzorek, im ken muchach sheddorshah kerabbi akiva. gam mimma sheddarshu beparasha 10 "o zavach" lerabbot haddam, kedivre rabbi akiva babberayta shehevi bashshas dizvachim, hare ze mare baetzba ki derashat tanna detorat kohanim hu kedarko shel rabbi akiva. umeatta tihye derashat shechitat of middam yechashev" umiut melika measher yishchat", velamma doresh tanna detorat kohanim shete hadderashot meo asher yishchat"? veod, letanna detorat kohanim sheddoresh shete hadderashot meo asher yishchat", "dam yechashev" sheamar hakkatuv lamma li?

Veraiti leharambam zichrono livracha shekkatav beferek 18 mehilchot maase hakkarbanot veze leshono: shenayim sheachazu bassakkin veshachatu peturim, shenneemar "asher yishchat" "o asher yishchat" – echad velo shenayim, ad kan. vekashe leharambam zichrono livracha lamma asa limmud chadash velo rasham hallimmud shehuzekar babberayta uvattalmud. veod kashe leharambam zichrono livracha vahare pasuk "asher yishchat" "asher yishchat" derashuha lemishpat haof, ben letanna detorat kohanim ben lerabbi yishmael ben lerabbi akiva shehuva divrehem bizvachim (zevachim 107.) shekkatavnu lemala. "asher yishchat" itzterich lelammed al haof, lemar lerabbot shechayyav al shechitato ulemar lemaet hammelika. vedin ze pesako rambam besof perek 19 mehilchot maase hakkarbanot. veod kashe lema shekkatav harambam chiyyuv leshochet leish mippasuk "dam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach", shekkatav veze leshono: af al pi shello nitkavven lishchot kadashim ellu laAdonai hare ze chayyav, shenneemar "dam yechashev vegomer dam shafach", af al pi shezze haddam bemachashavto kedam hannishpach, lo kekarban, hare ze chayyav, ad kan. vahare hashshas doresh chiyyuv shochet leish meamro "ish ish", veod "dam shafach" darshu betorat kohanim lemaet shenayim sheshshachatu o lemaet anus shogeg mute kemo shekkatavnu lemala, uma makom lidrosh mimmenna shochet leish. vehinne derasha zo amaruha bizvachim (zevachim kach:) alibba derabbi yose shecholek al rabbi shimon bidrashat "ish ish".

Velaze yesh lomar shebbachar harambam lehavi haraya miyyittur "dam shafach" shehi yoter chazaka midderashat "ish ish" sheenah derasha chazaka. veharaya mimma sheamru bemassechet metzia (42 lo.) befasuk "haavet taavitennu" shesover rabbi shimon dibbera tora kilshon bene adam, vechatvu hattosafot sham ki bemakom sheyyesh eze hochacha hefech derasha hannishmaat mikkefel haddevarim anu dorshim kefel hatteva veen anu omrim dibbera tora kilshon bene adam, uchesheyyesh hitnaggedut lidrashat hakkefel anu omrim dibbera tora kilshon bene adam. meatta en derashat kefel "ish ish" chazaka kidrashat "dam shafach" shehevi hashshas alibba derabbi yose, vahagam dehashshas lo kaamar lah ella alibba derabbi yose, af al pi chen mimmenna nikkach lerabbi shimon ki en hechreach laasot machloket benehem baze. vahagam dehashshas kaamar lisvarat rabbi shimon sheddoresh shochet leish meish ish" (zevachim kach.), ze haya kodem sheyyada derashat "dam yechashev vegomer dam shafach", ma sheen ken achar derasha zo hu davar hashshave lechullam, velaze katav harambam midderashat "dam shafach", aval kusheyatenu harishona ledivre rambam bimkomah omedet.

Venire lomar desover rambam, kevan sheanu roim kol kach shinnuyim ben barayta shel torat kohanim uvarayta shehevi hashshas bizvachim uven divre hashshas gam ken kemo shekkatavnu lemala, im ken mochichim haddevarim sheen lehakepid al shinnuy mekom derashot ellu. velaze lema shemmochiach rambam mippasuk "dam shafach" shochet leish dechayyav, im ken en lanu minnayin lidrosh miut shenayim. laze chippes achar derashat yittur "asher yishchat" shehi meyutteret, veen anu dorshim shechitat of ella mittevat "o", uchemo sheddarshu betorat kohanim shemmerabbe shechita laof meamro tevat "o" lerabbot. ulefi ze darshinan miut melika baof meamro "ze haddavar" lemaet melika baof, uchedivre rabbi yishmael shekkatavnu lemala sheddoresh miut melikat of mize haddavar". velo yikshe lecha mimma dekayma lan (eruvin 46:) halacha kerabbi akiva mechavero, ki en baze hefech rabbi akiva beinyan halacha.

rashi: Ki nefesh habbasar. shel kol beriyya baddam hi teluya, ulefichach netattiv (al hammizbeach) lechapper al nefesh haadam — tavo nefesh utechapper al hannefesh:
ohc: Ki nefesh habbasar vegomer. tzarich ladaat netinat taam lamma chozer ze. ulefi ma shepperashti lemala hen hen haddevarim shekkatavnu, shennoten hattaam lamma tikkaret nefesh haochelet, letzad sheyyesh baddam hannefesh vehu noten betocho nefesh habbahamit. ella sheadayin yesh lanu lachkor lamma amar "nefesh habbasar" velo amar ki hannefesh baddam. venire shennitchakkem Adonai lehashiv lashshoel lamma lo asar gam habbasar, ki gam bo haya chayyut habbehema uchesheadam ochlo yigrom happegam benafsho. laze amar vechi nefesh habbahami hayta babbasar, lo chen hiv, lo hayta ella bedamo shel basar vehaddam hiv mechayye habbasar. veen hannefesh babbasar kol ikkar keamro nefesh habbasar baddam hi hannefesh velo babbasar. utechuna zo lo hechinah Adonai bitchunat adam, ki haadam hitpashshetut chiyyunuto hi gam babbasar vegam baatzamot, venikra bedivrehem hevla degarme shennishar achar kamma shanim baatzamot, velaze enam nirkavim hatztzaddikim. veyesh reshaim shennimshelu kabbehemot, vehen henna sheenam omdim bitchiyyat hammetim letzad sheyyavshu atzmotam venirkevu vechalta hannefesh vehalcha lah keruach habbehema.
Vaani netattiv vegomer. perush, veteda shehaddam hiv hannefesh, shehare ani netattiv lachem vegomer lechapper al nafshotechem, nefesh tachat nefesh, hare ki haddam hiv hannefesh.

Od yechavven hakkatuv lehazehir al nefesh habbehema leval hamitah, ki lo natan Adonai dam habbehemot lanu ella lechapper al nafshotenu, vehu amro netattiv lachem al hammizbeach lishlol zulat sibba zo sheeno lanu bemattana laasot kol asher nachpotz asot bo. vetimtza (sanhedrin 2.) sheddin harigat behema tzarich sheyyihye al pi bet din shel esrim ushelosha kemishpat adam, shehishva hakkatuv mishpatam lemishpat adam, velo huttera behema lishchot ella letzarche besarah ki teavve nefesh adam leechol basar, shekken gamar kone olamo vehikna lanu, dichtiv (Devarim 12:20): "ki teavve nafshecha leechol basar bechol avvat" vegomer:

rashi: Et mishpatay taasu. ellu devarim haamurim battora bemishpat, sheillu lo neemru hayu cheday leamran:

Veet chukkotay tishmeru. devarim shehen gezerat hammelech, sheyyetzer hara meshiv alehem lamma lanu leshamran? veummot haolam meshivin alehem, kegon achilat chazir ulevishat shaatnez vetohorat me chattat, lechach neemar ani Adonai, gazarti alechem, e atta rashshay lippater (yoma 67):
Lalechet bahem. al tippater mittocham, shello tomar lamadti chachmat yisrael elech veelmad chachmat haummot (sifra):
ohc: Et mishpatay taasu vegomer. kashe, achar sheen medabber ella bifritzut haarayot, ma hachukkim vehammishpatim asher tzivva Adonai elohenu otanu? gam ma hi kavvanato beamro lalechet bahem? gam tzarich ladaat lamma chazar paam sheniyya lomar "ani Adonai elohechem"?

Venire lefaresh lefi ma shekkatavti besamuch, shehammachshava baarayot tagdil hachefetz utemaet meniat haratzon, chash hakkatuv sheyyomar haadam lehitrachek mikkol vachol mipperat ze vivattel mitzvat periyya verivya umitzvat hayyibbum vechaddome, veyihye parush mimmin ze lachalutin, sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (socha nov:) ever katan yesh baadam, masbio raev, marivo savea. laze tzivva Adonai veamar et mishpatay taasu shehem mimmin atzmo sheasarti lecha ani mechayyevcha laasot, veaf al pi chen et chukkotay tishmeru shehem haarayot sheasar.

O yomar, ki beemtzaut shemirat haarayot yimtzeu hachana benafshotam lekayyem mitzvot ase, keamro mishpatay taasu, ushemirat kol hallavin, keamro chukkotay tishmeru. ma sheen ken im yetaev maasav badderech hahu, techele nafsho betachalue hattuma velo yekayyem achat mehenna, ki tumat chet ze mashra tuma al kol evre haadam vechochotav, vechevan shekken kol hallavin lo yimmana mehen, ki bechol evar tumato bo. vechen mitzvot ase, vahagam sheyyaase lifamim ezo mitzva enah mitzva, ki lo yitratztze bah habbore yitbarach shemo, al derech amro (tehillim 50:16): "velarasha amar elohim ma lecha lesapper chukkay" vegomer, ki en chefetz laAdonai bahem ella bemitzva hannaaset bikdushsha.

Veamro lalechet bahem yechavven lomar ledarkenu kemin chomer, ki kaasher yihye haadam tahor vekadosh mehattiuv yolid betivo lekayyem hammitzvot tamid, al derech amro (tehillim 119:59) "chishshavti derachay vaashiva raglay el edotecha", vedarshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 35:1) sheraglav shel david meatzmam hayu holchot levet hammidrash letzad hahergel vehachefetz hannivchar. laze amar lalechet bahem, perush, shemmeatzmo yelech bahem betivo keose devarim shehatteva ose, letzad sheikkaro vegufo hakkol omed bemakom tahor.

Od yechavven beamro lalechet bahem al derech ma sheamar hannavi (Yechezkel 33:12): "tzidkat hatztzaddik lo tizzacher beyom shuvo" vegomer, sheim yihye tzaddik kol yamav veyarshia levassof, hare ze hifsid zechuto velo yelech immo beyom lechto laolam haelyon. laze tzivva Adonai veamar "lalechet bahem", perush sheyyatmid bammaasim hattovim ushemirot hachukkim kede sheyyelech bahem beyom naso lederech kol haaretz.

Od yirtze, shello yekavve haadam lischar mitzvot baolam hazze, al derech amram: "hayyom laasotam ulemachar lekabbel secharam" (eruvin 22.), shekkol ma sheyyaase lo yivchar leechol olamo bechayyav, ella yelech lefanav tzidko lachazot benoam Adonai.

Od yirtze al derech amro "ki ner mitzva vetora or" (Mishlei 6:23), ki olam haelyon rachok bemahalach, uvaalot nefesh adam meolam ze leolam haelyon, im hu rasha – derech reshaim kaafela. uvelechet adam kasher, mitzvot vetora shebbeyado meirim lo, keamro "ner leragli devarecha veor lintivati" (tehillim 119:105), shehakkavvana hu leheyot ki yesh banner ma sheen baor, veyesh baor ma sheen banner, ki hanner yesh bah bechina gedola mehaor kesheyyihye karov, velaze amru razal (fesachim 2.) shebbedikat hechametz tzericha ballayla leor hanner, shehanner yafe labbedika lehachenisah bechorin uvisdakin, ma sheen ken baor. veyesh baor bechina gedola mehanner sheroe lemerachok, ma sheen ken banner. laze amar david ki mitzvot Adonai yesh beoram shete bechinot hannizkarot: bechinat hanner bekarov, veze amar "ner leragli" shehu bekarov, uvechinat haor lemerachok, vehu amro "veor lintivati". veze amar kan lalechet bahem, perush beoram yelech, sheim lo chen bachashecha yelech velo yeda bamme yikkashel rachamana litzlan.

Od yirtze al derech ma sheamar hattanna haelohi rabbi shimon bar yochay alav hashshalom (Zohar 9 170:) ki 248 evre haadam veshs gidav hem keneged mitzvot ase velo taase, uvaasot haadam mitzva beoto evar shennaaset hammitzva shore bo shem 26 yitbarach, ki hammitzva hi otiyyot shem 26 chetzyah megulle vehu sod alma deitgalya, vechetzyah mechusse sod alma deitkasya, ki otiyyot 130 bet 302 hem 15. vedavar yadua hu ki hakkadosh baruch hu hu shemo ushemo hu, besod amro (Zecharya 14:9) "Adonai echad ushemo echad". hareta ladaat ki baasot hammitzva naase haadam merkava lashshechina umithallech Adonai betocho, veze amro lalechet bahem, vechazar uferesh mi hu haholech bahem, veamar ani Adonai ucheillu amar lalechet ani Adonai bahem, vehu sod (Shemot 25:8) "veshachanti betocham". uchefi ze yirtze amro "bahem" kifshatah, ki baasiyyat hammitzva naaset hahachana lalechet bah, vezehu sod amro (Vayikra 26:12) "vehithallachti betochchem", (Devarim 4:4) "veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem":

rashi: Choach ala veyad shikkor. kechoach shehu nidbak beyad shikkor, ken hammashal haamur lematta (Mishlei 26:10) nidbak befi hakkesil lihyot lahem lechoach ulekotz machiv. umahu hammashal?
targum: Kuva salek bida deravya veshatyuta befumeh desichla:

rashi: Ushemartem et mishmarti. lehazehir bet din al kach (sham):
Velo tittammeu bahem ani Adonai elohechem. ha im tittammeu eni elohechem, veattem nifsalim meacharay, uma hanaa yesh li bachem veattem mitchayyevim kelaya? lechach neemar ani Adonai elohechem (sham):
ohc: Ushemartem et mishmarti. yetzav Adonai al haggedarim hashshomrim levilti yavo lehikkashel battiuv, vehu amro ushemartem et mishmarti, perush, mishmeret haggader, vehattaam "levilti asot" vegomer, afilu beshogeg, vahagam shello titchayyev al hattiuv beshogeg, veaf al pi chen attem mittammeim bemaase hattiuv, vehu amro velo tittammeu bahem, velachashash ze tishmeru mishmarti.

Veamro ani Adonai elohechem, nitkavven lomar ki behittammeam afillu beshogeg hem nigraim meerech ze sheyyityached shemo yitbarach alehem, ki hattiuv bechol metziut sheyyihye, yafil perud ben yisrael uven hashshechina, sheen shechina shora ella al hammushelal mehakkiur hahu, vekadosh yeamer lo kol hakkatuv lachayyim.
Chassalat parashat achare

rashi: Vechipper baado vegomer. vidduy sheni, alav veal echav hakkohanim, shehem kullam keruyim beto, shenneemar "bet aharon barachu et Adonai" vegomer (Tehillim 135), mikkan shehakkohanim mitkapperin bo, vechol kapparatan enah ella al tumat mikdash vekadashav, kemo shenneemar (pasuk 16), "vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot" vegomer (sifra; shavuot 7):
Venichalt bach. titchalchali beatzmech al ma sheasit:
targum: Veetkadesh bich leene ammaya vetedun are ana Adonai:

rashi: Mefitz vecherev. shem kele milchama:
targum: Ech peria vesayfa negida shenina gavra demashad al chavreh sahaduta deshikra:

rashi: Lo tikrevu. lehazehir hannekeva kazzachar, lechach neemar leshon rabbim:
Ani Adonai. neeman leshallem sachar:
Al taan kesil. bedivre riv umatztza, pen tishve lo:
targum: La tetal pitgama lesichla hech shatyuta dela tidme leh af ant:

rashi: Ervat bat eshet avicha. limmed sheeno chayyav al achoto mishshifcha venachrit, lechach neemar "bat eshet avicha" — biruya lekiddushin (sham 23):
Hikketi chappi. tzaakti vavy vekina:
El bitzech. kan lamadnu shehaggazel kashe min hakkol, shealav nitchattem gezar din (Kohelet Rabba 3:12):
targum: Veha ayteti pureanuti alach bechove mamon onsich daanast veal dam zakkay deishtefich begavich:

rashi: Katztzippor lanud. shehu nad, vchadderor shehu chozer lekinno:
Ken killat chinnam lo tavo. lemi shehotziah befiv:
Deror. hu of hannikra 360 belaaz, venikra deror – sheddara babbayit kevassade:
targum: Hech tzippera detaes vehech parchata defarcha hechna levatta demagan la teol:

ohc: Vattitma haaretz vegomer. hakkavvana hu al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha (Zohar 11 53:) ki bemaase yisrael yithavve haruchaniyyut im letov im lera, vehu amram (avot 84 51) haose mitzva achat vechulei vehaover avera achat. vezehu sheramaz kan beamro vaefkod avonah aleha, al derech amro (Yirmeyahu 2:19) "teyasserech raatech", ki mippeullat hara yithavve hakkategor asher yeshallem leish kemaasehu. veamru zichronam livracha (tavemar devora 81) ki tashlum haddin hu kol malach mechabbel shennivra mikkol avera ba umishtallem meosehu ad shekkale beemtzaut peullat hayyissurin, ki hu mitmaet veholech ucheshekkale koach poel hara hu neevad, veshafat Adonai davar ze betzedek kede sheyyishtallem kol echad kefi maasav bechiuun mufla, ki kefi koach hannaase bammaashe hara yihye bannivra. vehu maamar hakkatuv kan beamro vaefkod avonah, perush, leshon minnuy, shemmemanne heavon atzmo al osehu. veamro leshon yachid kevar perashti lemala. od nire lomar kefi darkenu sheefshar sheen hakkategorim mishtallemim yachad ella baze achar ze, laze amar leshon yachid, veze derech derash.

rashi: Ane chesil. habba lahasitcha laavoda zara, hoda lo ivvalto:
Pen yihye chacham beenav. vetaam shene fesukim ellu meforash betocham: al taan bedavar shettishve lo im taanehu, ane chesil bedavar sheim lo taanehu yihye chacham beenav:
targum: Ela malel im shatya bechakkimutach dela nisbar benafsheh dechakkima hu:

rashi: Hokar raglecha. keshem sheim matzata devash vehu matok lechikkecha, atta tzarich shello tochal mimmennu pen tisbaennu vahakeoto, kach hokar raglecha mibbet reecha app shehu mekarevcha, mena millavo sham yom yom pen yisbaacha veyisna otcha. uleinyan midrasho (chagiga 7.): al tehi ragil lachato shogeg ulehavi tamid chattaot vaashamot levet Adonai shennikra rea leyisrael, dichtiv "ze dodi veze rei" (Shir HaShirim 5:16):
targum: Kele riglach min bayteh derachamach dela nisbeach umesanyach:

rashi: Ervat ishsha uvittah. lo asar hakkatuv ella al yede nissue harishona, lechach neemar lo "tikkach" — leshon kicha, vechen leinyan haonesh, asher "yikkach" et ishsha veet imma — leshon kicha, aval anas ishsha muttar lissa bittah (yevamot 97):
Shaara henna. kerovot zo lazo:
Zimma. etza, ketargumo atzat chetin, sheyyitzrecha yoetzcha lachato:
Lesig. taarovet pesolet hammeorav bechesef vezahav, vetzarich lehatticho baesh letzarfo:
Kur. shetztzorfin bo zahav:
targum: Bar adam havo kodamay bet yisrael lifsula kulehon kema dimarav nechash uveitz uvarzel vaavar bego chura lippesolat kaspa havo:
In chazayta gavra dechakkim beene nafsheh sachla tav mineh:
Eryat abba galiu bich itta tumea eniu vich:
Vahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:
Veachnesh yatchon veatkef alechon beeshta pureanuti vetitmesun vegavah:
Ugevar yat ittat chavreh avad toeva ugevar yat kalateh saev beetzat chetin ugevar yat achateh vat avuhi ane vich:
Vahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:
Keitmesaa chesaf bego chura ken titmesun begavah vetidun are ana Adonai shefichet chemti alechon:
Bechen kidnan amar Adonai elohim chalaf dahavetun kulechon lifsula bechen ha ana chanesh yatchon lego yerushelem:
Vahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:
Hech kalba dehafech al teyuveh hechna sachla detane besichluteh:
Amar atla shachala bearcha arya benat shevake:

bart: Tzevi shennichnas. meelav labbayit venaal echad befanav, zo hi tzidato:
Naalu shenayim peturim. dahavu lehu shenayim sheasauha:
Lo yachol echad linol. orcheh hu lenoalo bishnayim, vahare lechol echad melacha, divlav ihu lo mitabbeda:
Verabbi shimon poter. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Ezov yon. min ezov sheggadel ben hakkotzim umemit hattolaim shebbammeayim:
Sheeno maachal beriim. umuchecha milleta delirfua achel leh, veasur leachlo beshabbat, gezera shemma yishchok sammanim, dahave tolada detochen:
Aval ochel hu et yoezer. deharbe ochlin oto keshehen beriim. yoezer, 132 belaaz, vehu mechalle hattolaim shebbakkaved:
Abbuv roe. etz sheggadel yechidi veen lo anafim, vekorin oto baaravi 191 280, vehu tov lemi shennizzok al sheshshata mayim megullim:
Kol hoochalim ochel adam lirfua. kol davar shehu ochel vehabberiim ochlim oto, yachol adam leachlo beshabbat af al pi shehu mitkavven lirfua:

Chutz mimme dekalim. hem shene ilanot mimmine haddekalim shehayu beeretz yisrael uvenehem mayan mayim, vehashshote mehem kos rishon merappe hazzevel shebbemeav, vechos sheni meshalshel, vechos shelishi menakke et bene meayim ad sheadam motziam tzelulim kederech shehichnisam:

Vechos shel ikkarin. lokchin seraf ilan shekkorin lo baaravi 11 376, veesev shekkorin lo 373 301, perush esev shel simcha, vecharkom, vechotshin otan venotnin et afaran beyayin. vehaishsha zava shettishte mehen shelosha kosot terafe:
Mippene shehen layroka. baal choli hannikra yerakon, im yishte mehen yerafe mecholi hayyerakon, aval yishshaer akar velo yolid, ulechach nikra kos ikkarin:
Litzmao. im eno chole:

Ad shello nitmallea hammidda lammocher. bemidda sheenah shel shenehem mayre, vehammashil hishilah lishnehem, vahare hi sheula lammocher ad sheyyemalleenna, umishsham vaelach hi sheula lallokeach. lefichach ad shello nitmallea hammidda, shehakkeli shaul lammocher, lo kana lokeach, umishshennitmallea hammidda, shehakkeli shaul lallokeach, kana lokeach, shekkanu lo kelav. uvesimta mayre o birshut hallokeach:
Haya sarsur benehem venishbera hechavit. vehayta hechavit shello:
Nishbera lassarsur. velo amrinan shelucho shel lokeach hu venishbera lallokeach:
Vechayyav lehattif lo shalosh tippin. hammocher lallokeach, min hannidbak bedafne hammidda leachar sheera hayyayin vehashshemen:
Hirkinah umitztza. hitta et hammidda al tziddah leachar sheera hashshemen vehayyayin vehittif shalosh tippin, venitassef mitztzat hammidda leshule hakkeli el makom echad:
Hare hu shel mocher. shehare nityaesh hallokeach mimmennu:
Vehachenvani eno chayyav lehattif shalosh tippin. lefi shehu tarud, shemmocher kol shaa:
Rabbi yehuda omer. lo amru shechenvani patur millehattif shalosh tippin, ella erev shabbat im chashecha. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Velo tevua shebbachallon. shehishrisha bachallon mammash. mishshum dedato lefannotah shehi mekalkelet et hakkotel, vechol davar sheddato lefannoto eno memaet bachallon. uleel ayre shehishrisha rachok min hakkotel, dehashta en dato lefannotah:
Hashsheti vehaerev hamenuggaim. dishti vaerev mittamme vingaim, vedavar tame eno memaet:

Velo levena mibbet happeras. hallevena haasuya meafar bet happeras. rabbi meir savar shehi temea kemo sheafar bet happeras tame, hilkach enah memaetet bachallon. verabbanan savre lo timmeu ella gush kivriyyato habba mibbet happeras, velo heafar afillu leachar sheggibbelo. vahalacha kachachamim. veshiur haggush, kefika gedola shel sakkaim, shehu kechotam hammartzufin:
Hatztzad tzippor. ad shehichniso lemigdal shel etz, 459 belaaz, chayyav, shezzo hu tzidato, aval im hichniso labbayit eno nitztzod bechach:
Utzevi. nitztzod mishshehichniso labbayit venaal befanav, aval im hichniso lagginna o lechatzer en zo tzida:
Velabbevarin. karpifot hammukkafim choma shemmachnisin sham chayyot venishmarim sham:
Kol hamechussar tzida. shekkashe letafso sham, kegon sheeno maggia lo bishchiyya achat sheshshoche letafso. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel [dimfaresh] lemiltayhu derabbanan:
Hassiton. socher shekkone harebe beyachad vechozer umocher lachenvanim meat meat:
Mekanneach middotav. bishvil hayyayin vehashshemen shennikrash betocham vehammidda mitmaetet:
Uvaal habbayit. sheeno mocher tadir kassiton, mekanneach paam achat beshana:
Paamayim bashshabbat. shehachenvani eno chayyav lehattif shalosh tippin kemo shechayyav hassiton uvaal habbayit, umishtayyer bakkeli venidbak bo:
Umemache. mekanneach avne mishkelotav sheshshokel bahen davar lach:
Al kol mishkal umishkal. kol paam sheshshokel mekanneach:

Matztzilin mezon shalosh seuddot. veaf al gav divhettera ka tarach deha lo sharu leh leatztzole ella lechatzer hameorevet bilvad, afillu hachi lo sharu leh leatztzole tefe, mippene sheadam bahul al mamono vei sharet leh ate lechibbuye:
Nafla deleka velele shabbat. kodem achila:
Shacharit. kodem seuda:
Rabbi yose omer leolam hu matztzil. hoil veyoma bar hachi hu uvehettera tarach. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Mashach. mershut harabbim besimta o bechatzer shel shenehem, kana. aval meshicha birshut harabbim lo mahanya:

Af al pi shello madad. uchegon sheppasak lo mittechilla haddamim bechach vechach yitten lo hammidda. aval lo pasak lo haddamim, afillu madad umashach lo kana, delo samcha datayhu, shehammocher yachol lehaalot haddamim kemo sherotze, vehakkone omer eni kone ella bezol:

Madad. hammocher lallokeach birshut harabbim, afillu bechelav shel lokeach, lo kana, sheen kelav shel adam konim lo birshut harabbim. veim lokeach atzmo madad, afillu birshut harabbim kana behagebaha:
Im haya fikkeach. hallokeach:
Socher et mekomo. im hu birshut bealim. umekomo kone lo. uvemassaot gedolot ayre, deen darkan lehagebiah, lechach kani vimshicha:
Ad sheyyetaltelennu. hayenu hagebaha. veorcha demilleta nakat, dederech magbiah letaltel mimmakom lemakom:

Veim haya mechubbar lakkarka. baggemara moke la kegon sheamar lo mocher lallokeach lech veyappe li karka kol shehu ukene kol ma shealeha, dechevan shessecharo laasot melacha bakkarka shello veasa bo melacha kol shehu, kana sechiruto, vekana nammi oto davar sherotze lehakenot lo im hassechirut, lefichach im talash kol shehu kana:
Maaziva. tit utzerorot shergilim lasum al gabbe korot:
Umechuvvanot. kora haelyona cheneged hattachtona vechol achat yesh bah rochav tefach:

Tachteha tame. vesheal gabbah tahor, shehakkora chotzetzet. vehane mille kesheyyesh bakkorot poteach tefach shehen rechavot tefach, aval en rechavot tefach lo meviot tuma velo chotztzot ucheman deletanhu dame, venimtza tuma cheillu omedet baavir:
Benehen tame. veshettachat hattachtona vesheal haelyona tehorim, dishtehen chotztzot:
Kenegdo ad harakia tame. veshettachat kullan tahor:
Keven hattachtonot. keneged avir hattachtonot. verachban keshiur avir shebbenehen, sheim taale et hattachtonot o torid et haelyonot nimtza hakkol satum:
Tachat kullan tame. keillu hayta tikra shava. veal gabban tahor:
Tuma sham. betoch haddut, af al pi shehakkefisha al gabbav:
Habbayit tame. deen tzamid patil lattuma:
Tuma vabbayit. hasheta mayre vedut patuach sheen alav kefisha:
Tehorim. hakkelim. kevan sheyyesh bimkoman tefach al tefach berum tefach, denitztzolin sham keviv shehu kamur tachat habbayit ditnan leel beferek 3‏ [mishna 7] tuma babbayit ma shebbetocho tahor:
Rechavim mishshel bayit. kegon shechalal haddut marchiv veholech tachat kotel habbayit vechotel haddut banuy michutz lechotel habbayit vehakkelim sham:
Ben kach uven kach. daafillu deen bimkoman tefach al tefach berum tefach tehorin:
Shidda. asuya kemin aron:
Teva. ketanna shel shulchanim:
Umigdal. 459 belaaz, uvaaravi 591, ushelashtan shel etz:
Mippene shehu mecharech. veen haur neechezet bo, umatztzil al keli etz shello yissaref:
Ben meleim. mayim:
Sheen yecholin lekabbel et haur. mippene shechadashim hem, vesavar rabbi yose geram kibbuy asur afillu bimkom hefsed mamon. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Shene zizin ze al gabbe ze. umechuvvanim ze cheneged ze:
Yesh bahen poteach tefach. shekkol echad min hazzizim rachbo tefach al tefach:
Uvenehen poteach tefach. hattachton gavoah min haaretz tefach vehaelyon gavoah min hattachton tefach:
Vetuma tachtehen. tachat hattachton. kol ma shettachtav tame uma sheal gabbav tahor, dechotzetz bifne hattuma:
Benehen. im tuma ben tachton laelyon kol ma shebbenehen tame, aval ma shettachat hattachton vesheal haelyon, tahor, dechotztzim:
Al gabbehen. al gabbe haelyon. keneged hattuma ad harakia, tame, vechol hashshear tahor:

Haya haelyon odef al hattachton vechulei‏ tachtehen uvenehen tame. deven shehattuma tachat hattachton ben shehattuma venehen, oto haodef shehaelyon yater al hattachton tefach mearev et hattuma bechol makom. aval ma sheal haelyon tahor, dechotzetz:
Al gabbehen. al gabbe haelyon:
Haya haelyon odef al hattachton vechulei‏ tuma tachtehen. tachat hattachton:
