Tachtehen uvenehen tame. deoto odef mearev et hattuma benehen umevi et hattuma lema shettachtav:
Benehen. im hattuma benehen o lematta baaretz tachat hammotar, dehaynu cheneged haodef velo tachat hattachton:
Rabbi eliezer omer tachtehen uvenehen tame. deaf al gav delekka tefach baodef mevi et hattuma letachat hattachton, hoil veodef alav:
Benehen vetachat hammotar tame. ma shebben shene hazzizin uma shettachtehen baaretz keneged hammotar, tame:
Vetachtehen tahor. ma shettachat hattachton. dechevan deen bammotar tefach en hattuma vaa tachat hattachton. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Bishte helemot. leachar shekkatav ot achat beshogeg noda lo sheavar, vechazar veneelam mimmennu veshagag vechatav ot sheniyya betziddah:
Achat beshacharit veachat ben haarbayim. kevan dahave leh shehut bentayim kede leda hava leh kishte haalamot:
Rabban gamliel mechayyev. desavar en yedia lachatzi shiur lechallek shello yitztaref immo hachetzi haacher:
Vachachamim potrin. desavre hayedia shebben shene chatzae shiur mechalleket benehem, velo naasa keillu hayu shene chatzae shiur behelem echad. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ellu memaatim et hattefach. challon sheshshiuro befoteach tefach vehaya echad mikkol hane dachashiv hacha munnach bo umemaet et haavir mittefach, chotzetz, sheen hattuma overet letzad acher:

Al yede rova atzamot. im yesh babbayit rova atzamot dimtamme veohel, ufachot mikkazzayit mibbesar hammet munnach bachallon, memaet. vedavka pachot mikkazzayit, deillu kazzayit, hu atzmo metamme veohel. vedavka al yede rova atzamot, aval i ikka babbayit kazzayit basar min hammet, en pachot mikkazzayit ze memaet, deadderabba basar mitztaref im basar. vehayenu taama nammi dedavka vasar memaet al yede atzamot velo atzamot al yede atzamot, daatzamot aatzamot mitztarfe:
Pachot meetzem kasseora. aval etzem kasseora lo memaet, mishshum dimtamme vemagga uvemassa:

Pachot mikkazzayit min hammet. hasheta hadar tanye af al gav detana leh resha, leashmoinan dimmaet al yede kol hametammein beohel, kegon reviit dam umelo tarvad rakav vechol otan hashshenuyin beferek 2‏:
Pachot mikkazzayit min hannevela vechulei. kol hane dachashiv mikkan vaelach, memaate ben al yede atzamot ben al yede basar:
Ufachot mikkabbetza ochalim. sheen ochel pachot mikkabbetza metamme acherim velo mekabbel tuma min hattora, hilkach memaet vechotzetz bifne hattuma:
Vehattevua. shehishrisha rachok min hakkotel venitpashshetu anafeha vesagru et hachallon, dimchubbar lakkarka hi:

Kachay sheyyesh bahen mammash. kure akkavish nikraim kachay. vaani shamati chemin kure akkavish nimtza vetoch hakkane. ufeamim shehu dak meod vehu kachay sheen bo mammash, ufeamim shehu keen arigat beged vehu kachay sheyyesh bo mammash:
Venivlat of tahor shello chishshav aleha. shennivlat of tahor enah metammea ad sheyyachashov aleha laachila, veaz metammea tumat ochalim bechabbetza veenah tzericha hechsher:

Nivlat of tame shechishshav aleha velo hichshirah. denivlat of tame tzericha machashava utzericha hechsher, kelomar sheyyavo aleha mayim o echad mishshiva mashkin, veim chaser machashava o hechsher, tehora, umemaetet vechotzetzet bifne hattuma:

Hammocher et habbayit. hayyatzia. kemin cheder sheosin sevivot katle habbayit mibbachutz, kemo shehaya bammikdash, dichtiv (Melachim 1 6) vehayyatzia hattachtona. veyesh sheosin otah boovi hakkotel. veaf al pi sheppatuach labbayit vetashmisho betocho, afillu hachi eno machur. vehu dahave arba ammot. aval i lo have arba ammot, lo chashiv, venimkar im habbayit:
Velo et hacheder shellifnim. min habbayit. veaf al pi shehu patuach labbayit uderisato alav:
Bizman sheyyesh lo maake gavoah asara. chashuv bifne atzmo velo batel legabbe bayit:
Rabbi yehuda omer vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Ziz sheal gabbe happetach vechulei. hacha mayre shennistam happetach, umishshum hachi bainan sheyyehe vazziz poteach tefach. vehachi mashma battosefta:

Vesheal gabbe hachallon rum etzbaayim. kelomar ben challon sheshshiuro rum etzbaayim kegon sheyare hammaor, ben challon sheshshiuro melo makdeach kegon haose maor bitchilla, ziz sheal gabbe shenehem bechol shehu:
Verabbi yose omer meloo. challon sheshshiuro rum etzbaayim, ziz shello shiuro veetzbaayim. vechallon sheshshiuro melo makdeach ziz shello nammi meshaarinan bimlo makdeach. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Hammocher et habbayit. setam:
Machar et haddelet. shekkol tashmishe habbayit hakkevuim bo bichlal habbayit hem:
Aval lo et hammafteach. demidi demittaltel hu:
Hammachteshet. hakkevua bakkarka:
Haitzterubbal. iggul shel etz shealav maamidim harechayim. vekavua hu:
Hakkelet. afarkeset sheosim saviv larechayim lekabbel hakkemach hannitchan shello yippol laaretz. umittaltel hu:
Velo et hattannur velo et hakkirayim. demittaltelim hem. veit sefarim degarse, machar tannur machar kirayim. umayre bikvuim umechubbarim bakkarka:

Hare chullam mechurim. kol hane tashmishe deveta. aval shear mane tashmishteh enam mechurim, afillu amar vechol ma shebbetochah, lo ribba ella tashmishim hameyuchadim labbayit kegon mafteach vakelet vechayyotze vahen:

Hamelabben. et hatztzemer, vehamenappetzo vehatztzovo vehattove mimmennu, shehen kullan avot melachot, shiuran kede sheyyitve meoto hatztzemer chut aroch kimlo rochav hassit kaful. vehassit hu kede hefsek sheyyesh ben amma laetzba kol ma sheyyuchal adam leharechivo, ucheshiur harevach hazze shete peamim hu hassit kaful. verevach shebben guddal laetzba paam achat hu gam ken kimlo rochav hassit kaful, mippene sheyyesh bo kiflayim keoto sheyyesh ben amma laetzba:
Haoreg shene chutin. shiuran berochav habbeged kimlo hassit, sheaf al pi shello aragan al pene kol rochav habbeged, chayyav:
Shemona. hacholed vehaachbar kulei‏ hammenuyin befarashat vayhi bayyom hashshemini:
Hatztzadan chayyav. sheyyesh beminan nitztzod:

Vehachovel bahen chayyav. deyesh lahen or vehaveya la chabbura sheenah chozeret, vechayyav mishshum mefarek shehi tolada dedash. i nammi kevan deyesh lahen or nitzba haor baddam hannitzrar bo vechayyav mishshum tzovea:
Ushear shekatzim uremasim. kegon tolaim vechelzonot veakrabbim, hachovel bahem patur, deen lahem or:
Shello letzorech patur. deen beminan nitztzod:
Chayya veof shebbirshuto hatztzadan patur. shehare nitztzodim veomdim hen:
Vehachovel bahen chayyav. deyesh lahen or. veen hachovel chayyav bechol hane ditninan bematnitin ella betzarich laddam, aval im lo chaval ella lehazzik, ha kayma lan kol hamekalkelim peturim:
Neser shehu natun al pi tannur chadash. shello hussak, delo mekabbel tuma. uvetannur haomed bechatzer o vagginna ayre:
Befoteach tefach. shehanneser rachav veyotze chutz lattannur tefach saviv mikkol tzedadav:
Sheal gabbav. sheal gabbe hanneser:
Tehorim. dechevan shehattannur tahor, nitztzolim hakkelim. vechen im tuma al gabbe hanneser vechelim tachat hanneser:
Uveyashan. kegon shehussak hattannur dimkabbel tuma:

Tame. hattannur. sheen hanneser matztzilo. vechol shekken kelim shettachat hanneser vesheal hanneser. vetaama dematnitin, dechelim naasim ohalim letamme aval lo letaher, hilkach chadash delav keli hu matztzil, yashan dichli hu eno matztzil:
Verabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher. davka vetannur. aval bechelim mode ditmein. vehachi ita battosefta:

Natun al shene tannurim. rosh hanneser al tannur ze verosho hashsheni al tannur acher vetuma ben shene hattannurim. uvetannurim yeshanim ayre. veazdu rabbanan letaamayhu verabbi yochanan ben nuri letaameh. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:
Hammocher perot. setam, velo peresh laachila o lizria:
Afillu zera pishtan. derubba konim oto lizria, matze lememar ani laachila mechartiv. deen holchin bemamon achar harov:

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechulei. baggemara moke kullah matnitin allibba derabban shimon ben gamliel. vachasure michassera vehachi katane, afillu zera pishtan eno chayyav beacharayutan, ha zerone ginna sheenan neechalin chayyav beacharayutan, divre rabban shimon ben gamliel. sherabban shimon ben gamliel omer, zerone ginna sheenan neechalin chayyav beacharayutan, dahave mikkach taut, devadday lizria zabbeninhu:
Veheehil al kovre hammet. hayenu sheheehil al hammet:

Bet shammay omrim eno mevi et hattuma. bet shammay letaamayhu, dachalal gufo la chashiv chalal, hilkach en mevi et hattuma labbayit. uvet hillel letaamayhu dechashve leh chalal, hilkach af al pi sheggufo davuk bachallon, tzad elyon shebbo mevi et hattuma labbayit, deha ikka chalal gufo dahave tefach:
Umodim. bet shammay beadam lavush:

Mudbak laaskuppa. shehaaskuppa rechava vetuma mudbeket baaskuppa min hashshekof velachutz, rabbi eliezer chashiv kol haaskuppa kabbayit, hilkach metamme et habbayit. verabbi yehoshua savar min hashshekof velachutz en haaskuppa chashuva kabbayit. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Yiddon mechetza lemechetza. mechetzyah shel askuppa velifnim kelifnim vehabbayit tame, mechetzyah velachutz kelachutz vehabbayit tahor, mechetza al mechetza habbayit tame:
Mudbak lammashkof. tachat hammashkof min hashshekof velachutz:
Habbayit tame. daafillu min hashshekof velachutz chashuv bayit:
Verabbi yose metaher. dela chashiv leh kabbayit. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Rabbi eliezer metamme. dachashiv kol haaskuppa kabbayit:
Mittefach ulemattan tahor. dichkarka dame:

Mittefach ulemalan tame. veaf al gav dichshemmudbak laaskuppa metaher rabbi yehoshua et habbayit, hacha cheshehattuma babbayit metamme rabbi yehoshua baaskuppa mittefach ulemala, mishshum dederech tuma latzet velo likkanes. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:

Mekappelin et hakkelim. begadim shepposhtan mekappelan afillu arbaa vachamishsha peamim kede lachzor ulelavsham bo bayyom, velo shanu ella beadam echad, aval bishne bene adam lo, shennirim kimtakkenin. uveadam echad nammi lo amaran ella bivgadim chadashim shehem kashim veenan memaharim likmot, aval yeshanim kippulan metakkenan tefe umechaze kimtakken, uvachadashim nammi lo amaran ella bilvanim, aval tzevuim lo, shehatztzevuim kippulan metakkenan beyoter. uvilvanim nammi lo amaran ella sheen lo begadim acherim lehachelif, aval yesh lo begadim acherim lehachelif lichvod shabbat asur lekappel:
Miyyom hakkippurim leshabbat. keshechal yom hakkippurim lihyot beerev shabbat, lefi sheshshabbat chamur miyyom kippur:
Veshel yom hakkippurim enan kerevin beshabbat. dahave keolat chol beshabbat:
Rabbi akiva omer. shavin hen veen karbano shel echad mehen karev bachavero. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Hashsholeach beno. katan etzel hachenvani uveyado pundeyon shehem shene issarin, lehavi lo beissar shemen veissar echad yitten lo, vechen asa, veshavar hattinok et hatztzelochit venishpach hashshemen veibbed et haissar shennatan lo hachenvani: chenvani chayyav. bashshemen uvatztzelochit uvaissar. delo shalach haav et beno hakkatan el hachenvani ella leodue leh shehu tzarich lashshemen, lo sheyyishlach hashshemen al yado. uvaggemara parech, ammay chayyav hachenvani al hatztzelochit, aveda middaat hi. shehare hu atzmo shelachah beyad beno. umeshane, kegon shennetalah chenvani lamod bah shemen laacherim, hilkach naase gazlan aleh vekama leh birshuteh ad dimhadder lah lemarah, veaf al gav deahadrah lattinok lo miftar minna:
Rabbi yehuda poter sheal menat ken shelacho. ki hechi delishdar leh chenvani beyad beno:
Shehu fatur. middeme tzelochit. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Ellu kesharim. kesher haggammalim. shennokvim laggamal bechatmo venotnin bo retzua vekoshrim otah kesher olam. uchemo chen nokvim berosh hassefina nekev venotnin bo chevel vekoshrin oto kesher shel keyama sheeno mattiro leolam. vahave dumeya dekoshre chute yeriot hannifsakim bammishkan. vekesher shel keyama veeno maase umman, o maase umman veeno shel keyama, patur aval asur, veeno chayyav ad sheyyehe shel keyama umaase umman. vesheeno shel keyama velo maase umman muttar lechattechilla:
Ucheshem shechayyav al kishshuran kach chayyav al hetteran. shekken tzayyade chillazon hayu nitzrachin lifrakim lehattir kishre reshatot hakkayyamim kede lekatzran o leharechivan:
Sheyyachol lehattiro. delo haddekeh:
En chayyavin alav. vaafillu asao likyama. veen halacha kerabbi meir:

Hazzorek. beshabbat beshogeg, venizkar shehu shabbat leachar sheyyatzat haeven mittachat yado kodem shettanuach, afillu lo kelatah acher ella shennacha kedarkah patur, dehachi tenan lekamman ad shettehe techillatan vesofan bishgaga, vehay techillato bishgaga vesofo mezid, hoil venizkar shehu shabbat kodem shettanuach. umatnitin hachi mifarsha, hazzorek venizkar leachar sheyyatza mittachat yado, i nammi lo nizkar ella shekkelatah acher vechulei‏ patur, dahava leh shenayim sheasauha peturim, ha nacha chayyav chattat, bamme devarim amurim keshechazar veshachach, aval lo chazar veshachach patur, shekkol chayyave vechulei:
Ze hakkelal. laatoye nammi maavir chefetz mimmakom lemakom, sheim akar bishgaga venizkar shehu shabbat kodem sheyyaniach, patur:

Kol kitve hakkodesh. afillu neviim uchetuvim, matztzilin otan mechatzer shennafla bo haddeleka lechatzer acheret shebbeoto mavoy, af al pi shello ervu. vehu sheyyihyu ketuvim bichtav ashshuri uvilshon hakkodesh:
Ben shekkorin bahen. kegon neviim, shemmaftirin bahen beshabbat bevet hakkeneset:

Ben sheen korin bahen. kegon ketuvim, deaf yechidim en korin bahen beshabbat mippene bittul bet hammidrash kedilkamman, shehayu dorshim laam beshabbat umorin lahen hilchot issur vehetter, lefi shekkol yemot hachol hem asukim bimlachtan, veasru likrot bichtuvim beshabbat bishat bet hammidrash mishshum demashche libba veatu leimmenoe millishmoa hadderasha:
Veaf al pi shekketuvim bechol lashon. veikka leman deamar delo nittenu likrot bahen veen matztzilin otan, afillu hachi teunim geniza veasur lehanichan bimkom hefker:

Lemavoy sheeno mefullash. sheyyesh lo shalosh mechitztzot velechi echad beruach reviit, ze mavoy sheeno mefullash haamur kan. shalosh mechitztzot belo lechi, zehu mavoy mefullash. vehachi mefaresh la baggemara. veen halacha keven betera:
Shete vatte nirin. shennatan shene chutin shel sheti bannir shekkorin 430:
Bannirin. mefaresh baggemara shemmarkiv shene peamim [kol] chut shel sheti bannir uvappaam hashshelishit markivo al chut hammurkav al hakkane:
Bakkeros. yeria aruga missiv shel dekel:
Haya muttal al haaskuppa. miktzato vetoch habbayit umiktzato chutz labbayit:
Eno mevi et hattuma. deen kan chalal:
Hannesarim. luchot shemmesimin alehem habbegadim:
Hassafsalim. sheyyoshvim alehem. veyesh gorsim sefalim, shennotnim bahem mayim lirchotz:
Vilaot. masach keneged happetach. perush acher, alunetit shemmistappegin bah. veyesh omrim sinnar shemmechassin bo haerva kesheyyoshvin bammerchatz:
Megurot shel mayim. berechot hashshofchot mayim lammerchatz:
Otzarot shel etzim. shemmechammemin bo hammerchatz:

Lo machar et kelav. bechelim haasuyim lirchiva kegon ukkaf umirdaat, kulle alma lo pelige dekana afillu enam alav bishat mechira. ki pelige bechelim shel masseoy, kegon sak vediskeya, tanna kamma savar lo machar hakkelim shel masseoy shealav, venachum hammadi savar machar hakkelim shel masseoy shealav. vahalacha kattanna kamma, velo kana hakkelim shel masseoy vaafillu hayu alav bishat mechira:
Chamorcha ze. mashma kemot shehu im kelav:
Chamorcha hu. have keshoel lo chamorcha hu, mechor oto li. vehave kemocher chamor setam, veen kelav mechurim vaafillu hen alav bishat mechira. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hamenakkesh. tolesh asavim raim mittoch tovim. perush acher chofer seviv ikkere hatztzemachim, vehi melacha meen charisha:
Mekarsem. kotzetz anafim yeveshim min hailan letakkeno:
Mezared. zeradim lachim chadashim shel shana zo, ufeamim shehen merubbim umitgaddelim umachchishim koach hailan, vekotztzin otan mimmennu:
Im letakken. et hailan o et hakkarka, uketzatzo min hammechubbar:
Betza kalla. kigrogeret mibbetzat tarnegolet, shehi kalla lehitbashshel yoter mishshear betzim:
Tachat kullah. kol kelim shettachteha temeim, dimvia tuma lechullah. vesheal gabbah tehorim, dechotzetzet bifne hattuma:
Veim lav. sheenah rechava tefach:
Bokaat veola. deim tuma tachteha kelim sheal gabbah keneged hattuma temeim:
Bokaat veyoradet. deim tuma al gabbah, kelim shettachteha keneged hattuma temeim:

Hekkefah shelosha tefachim. dechol sheyyesh berachbo tefach yesh behekkefo shelosha tefachim, shekken matzinu bedivre hayyamim (2 4) bayyam sheasa shelomo eser baamma missefato el sefato agol saviv vekav sheloshim baamma yasov oto saviv:

Eno chayyav. hammocher beacharayuto. devishat mechira yayin hava. vedavka shennaase chometz bechelav delokeach, dei bechelav shel mocher, matze amar leh ha chamarach veha kankannach, velo matze mocher amar leh lamma hishheta oto bakkankannim kol kach, at hu deafsadt, dematze hiach amar leh ha meikkara hodaticha shello haya bedati lehistappek min hayyayin ella meat meat:
Veim yadua sheyyeno machmitz. sheeno mitkayyem. veidach amar leh delo bae layyayin ella lammikpa velashhoto likkach mimmennu meat meat:
Hare ze mikkach taut. dahava leh leodue sheen yeno mitkayyem:
Mevussam. darko lehitkayyem ad atzeret. umishsham vaelach hachom mekalkelo:
Veyashan. im machar lo yayin al menat shehu yashan, noten lo mishshel eshtakad, min hashshana sheavra hakkodemet lazo:
Neser. shehu aroch vatzar, ucheshehu natun al pi hattannur yotze tefach min hammizrach vetefach min hammaarav, vedarom vetzafon eno yotze:
Tuma vetzad ze. tachat hanneser bammizrach o vammaarav:
Kelim shebbatztzad hashsheni tehorim. deen makom lattuma laavor, sheen hanneser odef min hatztzafon umin haddarom:
Verabbi yose metamme. kasavar en tannur mafsik. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Habbetach. yesh sefarim sheggorsim abbetach. vehu binyan asuy keen ambati shebbammerchatzaot shennotnim bahen mayim lerachatza, veneser natun alav letikra, vehanneser odef mishshene tzedadim. veim hattuma mitztzad ze en yotza letzad acher, lefi shehabbetach chotzetz:
Haya vo ziz. hayta kora yotza lemala min habbetach min hammizrach lemaarav:
Roin et habbetach keillu eno. sheaf al pi shehabbetach chotzetz banneser, gabbe ziz eno chotzetz. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
En osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim. afillu kavil aleh kol hezzeka deate mechamateh. sheen bene adam rotzim [lizzok velered laddin] ladun al esek mamonam:
Rabbi eliezer mattir. uvilvad sheyyechassennu bechozek kede shettehe agala mehallechet alav teuna avanim. velo chayshinan shemma leyamim yitkalkel hakkissuy. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Zizin. rahitim ketannim:
Gezuzteraot. korot gedolot. shemma yikkashlu bahen bene reshut harabbim:
Kones letoch shello. shemmachnis bakkarka shello keshiur hotzaat hazzizin umotzi:
Hare zo vechezkatah. detoanin lallokeach veamrinan shemma ze shemmecharah lo kanas betoch shello:
Sereda. kemin sevacha shel cheres. targum maase reshet, ovad seradta. vehi chalaka veodefet chutz lattannur tefach mikkol tzad:

Hakkol tame. kelim shettachteha vesheal gabbah chutz mikkelim sheal gabbah keneged aviro shel tannur, lefi shehaohel mevi tuma tachteha kol seviv hattannur vechozeret uvokaat lemala. veaf keshehattuma lemala, bokaat lematta venimshechet saviv vechozeret uvokaat lemala:
Keneged aviro shel tannur tahor. shehare hu mukkaf tzamid patil umafsik:
Kenegdo ad harakia tame. aval ma shettachtav tahor:

Afillu gavoah mea amma. af al gav deziz shiur gavho min happetach shenem asar tefachim, bekane hechmiru mishshum demittaltel. verabbi yochanan ben nuri savar deen lehachamir bekane yoter min hazziz, ulemala mishshenem asar tefachim shiuro befoteach tefach. vahalacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:
Haavanim shehem letzarkah. laasot gader:
Veet hakkanim. shekkoshrim bahem haggefanim:
Veet mechitztzat hakkanim. kanim harebe gedelim bekelach echad, keshehi pechuta mibbet rova az hi betela legabbe hassade:
Shomera. sukkat shomrim hamechubberet lakkarka betit:
Veet hecharuv. bevacharuto sheadayin lo hurkav. dichshemmazkin mitgabber umarkivin oto veyesh lo shem bifne atzmo velo batel legabbe sade:
Veet betulat hashshikma. bevacharutah kodem shechatchu anafeha. dichshemmazkin kotztzim haanafim ugedelin harebe bimkoman vekaruy saddan shikma:
Bor. chafira bakkarka:
Dut. binyan shel avanim al gabbe karka asuy keen bor:
Af al pi shekkatav lo umka veruma. lo kana bor vadut, hoil vetashmishan chaluk min habbayit, sheen asuyin ella lishov mayim. ad sheyyichtov lo mearit tehoma ad rum rekia:
Vetzarich. hammocher:
Likkach lo derech. min hallokeach, lelech levor vadut. democher beayin yafa hu mocher velo shiyyer leatzmo kelum:
Vachachamim omrim eno tzarich. desavre mocher beayin raa hu mocher, ucheshemmachar habbayit shiyyer leatzmo derech sheyyelech labbor veladdut:
Bizman sheamar chutz meellu. chutz mibbor vadut, ditnay shello letzorech hu uleatfuye derech kaate:
Mecharan leacher. machar habbor vadut leacher, veshiyyer habbayit leatzmo:
Rabbi akiva omer en hallokeach tzarich likkach mimmennu darech. democher beayin yafa mocher, ucheshemmachar lo habbor vehaddut, derech nammi machar lo. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Beshaa shebbene adam nichnasim. bayyom. velo sheyyatrichehu laamod ballayla:

Ze ose lo fotachat. shello yignov baal habbayit mimme boro. uvaal habbayit ose lo potachat acheret beoto petach happatuach labbor, shello yuchal lavo lishov belo daat baal habbayit, velo yavo leolam beveto shel baal habbayit ella im ken yeshno levaal habbayit beveto. umishshum chashad ishto tikkenu ken:
Machar battim. vechol shekken chatzerot shehen ikkar hair:
Bet hashshelachin. ginnot ufardesin hashshayyachin lair:
Aval lo hammittaltelin. mane tashmishta, kegon mafteach vakelet vechayyotze bahen. vechol shekken shello machar chitte useare:
Hare chullan mechurim. afillu avadim uvehemot demittaltele denayde ninhu. vechol shekken chitte useare dahavu mittaltele delo nayde:
Hassanter. haeved hamemunne lishmor hair. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Sagos. beged tzemer av meod:
Vechofet. kora ava. af al pi sheggova avyan yoter mittefach:
Enan meviin et hattuma. im netanan baaretz keneged hassedek shebbetikrat haachsadra, ella im ken yesh tachtehen chalal tefach:
Kefulin. kemo tallit mekuppelet. begadim harebe mekuppalim zo al zo:
Ad shettihye haelyona gevoha min haaretz tefach. veaf al pi shehabbegadim netunim tachteha haelyona mevia et hattuma, hoil ugevoha min haaretz tefach:
Haya adam natun sham. baaretz keneged hassedek:
Chalul. chalal hagguf necheshav chalal af al pi shebbene meav letocho:

Ziz. shehu rachav tefach vesovev et kol katle habbayit mibbachutz, ucheneged happetach ochel shalosh etzbaot veal shear happetach en ziz. sheim haya ochel keneged happetach tefach haya habbayit tame ledivre hakkol:
Kelim shettachtav temeim. beha lo faleg rabbi yehoshua kidfaleg besefa, lefi shedderech tuma latzet:
Rabbi eliezer metamme et habbayit. kevan deziz chamur shemmetamme bechol shehu, mevi et hattuma labbayit beshalosh etzbaot:

Vechen bechatzer shehi mukkefet achsadra. vehaachsadra ochelet bappetach shalosh etzbaot, tuma babbayit, kelim shebbaachsadra temeim. tuma vaachsadra, rabbi eliezer metamme habbayit, verabbi yehoshua metaher. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Vechayyav lehacheria tefach. mimmishkal litra vaelach. aval pachot millitra en tzarich hechrea tefach:
Haya shokel ayin beayin. kegon bemakom shello nahagu lehacheria umaamid kene hammoznayim beshave:
Noten lo et gerumav. hacheraotav. lechol asara litra mosif lo asirit litra, shehu echad lemea kesheyyimkor ballach. uvayyavesh mosif [chatzi] asirit litra lechol esrim litra:
Lamod baddakka. bemidda ketanna:
Lo yamod baggassa. bemidda gedola. dahave peseda delokeach, sheen noten lo ella hechrea echad vehaya tzarich litten lo hacheraot rabbot:
Limchok. lehasir ma sheole al sefat hammidda:
Lo yigdosh. veaf al pi shemmosif lo baddamim:
Lo yimchok. veaf al pi sheppochet lo min haddamim:
Besam. 396 belaaz:
Besikra. min even shetztzovea adom:
Bekomos. min afar vetzivo shachor. perush acher seraf ilan, 50 belaaz:
Bekankantom. 11 baaravi, uvelaaz vaderayavelay:
Uvechol davar shehu roshem. laatoye mayim sheshsharu bahem afatzim, 344 belaaz, shehu roshem sherishshumo mitkayyem:
Al shene chatle zaviyyot. achat bammizrach veachat batztzafon, semuchot zo lezo bammiktzoa:

Al shene luche finkas. sefer shehachenvani kotev bo cheshbonotav. veaf al gav delav al luach echad hem, im nehegin venikrain ze im ze, kegon shekkotvin al shene sifte halluchin hassemuchin ze laze, chayyav:
Hakkotev al besaro. bidyo:
Vehamesaret al besaro. bevarzel ose tzurat otiyyot bivsaro:
Rabbi yehoshua poter. vaafillu hotzi dam, lefi sheen derech ketiva bechach. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Challon heasuy laavir. lehachenis bo avir haolam, vehayenu challon heasuy lemaor. umishshum devae lemitne bana bayit chutza lah, hadar tanye:
Bana vayit chutza lah. keneged hachallon, venitbattel avir shel challon:
Shiurah befoteach tefach. kechalon heasuy letashmish:
Natan et hattikra veemtza hachallon. shennimtza hachallon chetzyo lemala min hattikra vechetzyo lematta:
Hachallon hattachton befoteach tefach. kedin challon heasuy letashmish, deha en kan avir:
Vehaelyon melo makdeach. dilmala min hattikra hu laavir:
Sandal shel arisa. arisa shel tinok regilim lehanniach tachat ragleha kemin sandal shel mattechet lenoy o bishvil shello yerakvu:
Sheppechato vetoch habbayit. shennifchat haggag shel aliyya shehaarisa netuna alav venire sandal haarisa betoch habbayit min happechat shebbaggag, vetuma betoch habbayit:
Im yesh. bimkom happechat.
Poteach tefach. mevi et hattuma min habbayit laaliyya:
Veim lav. sheen sham poteach tefach:

Monin bo chederech shemmonin bemet. shehassandal vehaarisa temeim tumat shiva chedin kelim bechelim, vehattinok tame tumat erev, keditnan beferek kamma, hashshelishi ben adam ben kelim temeim tumat erev:
Hashsheni chayyav. shehu tzad oto:
Ha lema ze dome. meachar shennitztzod al yede rishon:
Lenoel et beto leshamro. velo latzud:
Venimtza tzevi. shehu nitztzod kevar shamur betocho, kach ze af al pi sheamad rishon en ze ella keshomro latztzevi shehaya lo meetmol. vehashsheni patur haamur bematnitin, patur umuttar:
Lo machar et mechitztzat hakkanim vechulei. shekkol elle chashuvim kesade bifne atzman:
Lo machar et habbor. af al pi shemmachar lo hassade en ellu mechurin:
Vetzarich hammocher likkach lo derech min hallokeach. lavo labbor velaggat. democher beayin yafa mocher kidfarishna leel:

Natan et kullan. vaafillu leman deamar mocher beayin raa mocher vetzarich hallokeach likkach lo derech hecha demachar lo echad mikkol ellu veshiyyer hassade leatzmo, davka bemocher amrinan hachi, mishshum dahava leh lallokeach leatnuye uleferushe, vechevan delo atne ihu hu deafsid, aval gabbe noten shemmekabbel hammattana mitbayyesh lomar lannoten paresh li ma sheatta noten li, lo amrinan middelo peresh ihu hu deafsid, ella amrinan beayin yafa natan veen tzarich mekabbel hammattana likkach lo derech. vechen nammi kol hane deamrinan leel lo machar lefi sheenan bichlal sade, vaafillu hane deenan bichlal kol ma shebbetochah kegon charuv vesaddan hashshikma uvor vagat, im natan hassade mattana, natan et kullan, mishshum divayin yafa yoter midday hu noten:
Zachu vassade zachu vechullan. afillu bor vagat veshovach shebbassade. mippene shekkol echad zoche beshello umistallek mechavero mikkol vachol:
Hechezik bechullam. veaf al gav decharuv veshikma lo betile legabbe sade, havu kishte sadot veen metzar benehen, deim hechezik beachat mehen kana chavertah:
Hikdish et kullam. demakdish beayin yafa makdish:

Lo hikdish ella et hecharuv. mikkol hanach deamrinan bematnitin gabbe mecher lo machar, gabbe hekdesh nammi lo hikdish, dedaat makdish kedaat mocher, levad mecharuv hammurkav vesaddan hashshikma, deaf al gav divmecher lo machar, behekdesh kaddeshe. vetama, hoil umissede hekdesh ka yanke:
En osin hilmi. me melach merubbim shennotnim letoch yerakot shekkovshin otan lehitkayyem:
Aval osin. me melach muatim kede litbol bahen pitto o letoch hattavshil:

Vahalo hu hilmi ben merubbe ben muat. kelomar im hamerubbim asurim af hammuatim asurim, deyomru melacha merubba asura umelacha muetet mutteret, ella ellu vaellu asurim mippene shehu kimabbed umetakken et haochel hannittan betocho kede sheyyitkayyem:

Veellu hen hammuttarim. noten shemen betoch hammayim battechilla kodem sheyyitten hammelach, o noten shemen battechilla letoch hammelach kodem sheyyitten et hammayim, dehashshemen meakkevo sheen hammelach mitarev yafe im hammayim umattish et kocho. aval lo yitten mayim umelach battechilla veachar kach et hashshemen, demishshaa shennoten mayim umelach yachad hu nire kimabbed. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Bemashkin. shemmashchirin, kemo me tutim vechayyotze bahen:
Beme ferot. shel kol shear perot:
Baavak derachim. kegon shessarat beetzbao tzurat otiyyot al hachol vehaavak shebbadderachim:
Baavak sofrim. afrurit shel keset hassofer:
Leachar yado. al gav yado, sheachaz hakkulmos beetzbeotav vehafach yado vechatav:
Uvemarpeko. happerek haemtzai shebbazzeroa:
Ot achat samuch lichtav. etzel ot ketuva zivveg lah achat vehishlimah lishtayim:
Ketav al gabbe ketav. heevir kulmos al otiyyot hakketuvim kevar vechiddesham:
Vechatav shene zaynin. shello nire haggag shel 418 ella shene haraglayim nire keillu hem sheni zayynin:
Al shene chatle habbayit. sheenan bammiktzoa:

Al shene dappe finkas. sheasuyin ammudim ammudim, katav ot achat beammud ze veot achat beammud ze, veeno yachol lekarvan ella im ken yachtoch ma shemmafsik benehen. vetana baresha katle habbayit hammeruchakim ze mizze vahadar tane dappe pinkas, velo zo af zo katane:
Ot achat al shem notarikon. sheose siman nekudda aleha umevinim meotah haot teva shelema, kegon kof karban, mem maaser, tav teruma:
Rabbi yehoshua ben betera omer chayyav. kevan shehakkol mevinim meotah haot teva shelema, keillu katav otiyyot shel kol hatteva:
Vachachamim potrin. shehare lo katav shete otiyyot. vahalacha kachachamim:

Ammud shehu muttal laavir. ammud agol shemmushlach baaretz veshochev al iggulo. baavir, kegon bechatzer o vagginna. uveemtza haiggul hu matchil lehaahil al haaretz veholech umitkatztzer mikkan umikkan ad tachtito shessamuch laaretz, uleinyan havaat tuma bainan tefach al tefach berum tefach merubba, veim yesh kan letzad hachutz mittachtav rum tefach af al pi shellematta besamuch bimkom shechivato laaretz en rum tefach kullo mittamme beohel, deniddon keshippue ohalim. veammud agol kesheyyesh behekkefo esrim vearbaa tefachim nimtza rachbo shemona tefachim, dechol sheyyesh berachbo tefach yesh behekkefo shelosha tefachim, venimtza deyachol adam lerabbea tachat dafno shemmikkan umikkan tefach al tefach berum tefach, shehare kesheyyesh kan ribbua shel shemona al shemona im taase betocho iggul shel shemona, nimtza hazzaviyyot odfim shemona chomashim lechol keren vekeren, dechol ammeta veribbua ammeta utere chumshe vaalachsonah, nimtza haalachson odef al harochav shishsha asar chomashin, ten mehem mechetza lekeren ze umechetza lekeren ze, hare lechol echad shemona chomashin, veim bata laasot bekeren zavit shechutz laiggul ribbua shel tefach al tefach, nimtza alachsono odef al rachbo shene chomashim, venimtza middat alachsono shiva chomashim, lo nishtayyer lanu yoter al hatztzorech ella chomesh echad, umishshum chomesh echad lo dak. veod, dechol ammeta veribbua ammeta utere chumshe vaalachsonah eno mechuvvan legamre, shechaser mimmennu meat:
Umet hakkelev. deillu chay afillu chullo vabbayit, habbayit tahor, detuma belua bevaale chayyim enah metammea:
Umuttal al haaskuppa. vetzavvaro lifnim:
Im yesh betzavvaro poteach tefach. rochav hatztzavvar tefach. umeshaarin oto al yede chut hammakkif et hatztzavvar. dechol sheyyesh berachbo tefach yesh behekkefo shelosha tefachim:
Mevi et hattuma. detzad haelyon shebbo maahil al hattuma umamshich et hattuma labbayit:
Veim lav. deeno poteach tefach:
Eno mevi et hattuma. dilinyan havaat tuma bainan poteach tefach:

Rabbi yose omer roim et hattuma. bodkim begufo shel kelev et mekom hattuma. im hi min hammashkof velifnim, habbayit tame af al pi sheen betzavvaro rochav tefach, detuma temuna bokaat veola, venimtza shehabbayit heehil al hattuma. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Piv lifnim. venekev zenavo mibbachutz:
Habbayit tahor. im tuma mibbachutz. demishshum hameshacha lo metammeinan leh, sheen derech maachol latzet derech piv ella derech nekev bet hari:
Piv lachutz. veshulav lifnim:
Habbayit tame. shehare derech petach katan ze haya sofah latzet:

Ben kach uven kach. ben piv lifnim ben piv lachutz, ben tuma mikkeneged hammashkof velifnim ben tuma lachutz, ben yesh betzavvaro tefach ben en betzavvaro tefach, bechol inyan habbayit tame, detuma yotza ben derech kenisatah ben derech yetziatah:
Kamma tishhe. besar hammet:
Bemeav. shel kelev kodem sheyyamut hakkelev veshuv lo yetamme mippene sheyyihye chashuv kimukkol:

Shelosha yamim meet leet. mishshaa sheachalah. kidamrinan [shabbat daf kana] galuy veyadua lifne hakkadosh baruch hu shemmezonotav shel kelev muatin, lefichach mashhe achilato vetoch meav shelosha yamim:
Beofot uvedagim. im achlu vesar hammet, kede shettippol laur vetissaref:
Rabbi yehuda ven betera omer vechulei. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda ben betera:

Yesh lecha kesharim sheen chayyavim alehem. chattat, kemo shechayyavim al kesher gammalim vekesher shel sappanim, ella patur aval asur. velo nizkeru kesharim hallalu bammishna. uvaggemara mefaresh kegon retzua arukka shekkoshrim battabbaat shebbechotem hannaka, uchemo chen chevel aroch shekkoshrim bechevel heasuy kemin tabbaat hattaluy benekev shebberosh hassefina, ufeamim menichah sham shavua ushevuayim umattirah. vechen kol kesher shekkoshrim oto laamod kach zeman yadua, lo sheyyihye kayyam leolam, en chayyavin alav:

Kosheret ishsha mifteche chalukah. keen leshonot lechan ulechan, vekoshrim shel yamin bechetef semol veshel semol bechetef yamin, dechevan dechol yoma share leh lo dami lekesher shel keyama umuttar lechattechilla:
Sevacha. migbaat sheal harosh asuya keen reshet:
Pesikya. ezor rachav vechutin teluyin berosho lekashro bahen:
Venodot yayin. shel or shekkoffin pihem vekoshrin otan. veaf al gav deit la tarte issare, velo amrinan chad minnayhu battole mevattel la vahave kesher shel keyama:
Ukedera shel basar. peamim shekkosher bah beged saviv lefiha. veaf al pi sheyyesh lah daddin sheyyecholin lehotzi hammarak mehen belo hetter hakkesher, afillu hachi lo have kesher:
Koshrin lifne behema. chevel berochav happetach linol befaneha shello tetze. vechen halacha:
Koshrin deli bifsikya. al pi habbor, sheyyihye kashur vetaluy sham, difsikya lo mevattel leh hatam:
Aval lo vechevel. dimvattel leh hatam vahave kesher shel keyama:

Rabbi yehuda mattir. lo hittir rabbi yehuda ella bechevel shel gardi shetztzarich lo limlachto velo mevattel leh hatam, verabbanan savre i sharet leh chevel shel gardi yikshor nammi bishar chavalim, dechevel bechevel michlaf. vahalacha kachachamim:
Matztzilin sal male chikkarot. hoil uvevat achat hu matztzil ma li pureta ma li tuva:
Veiggul shel devela. af al pi shehu gadol veyesh bo seudot harebe:

Veim hayu fikkechim. veyodim sheim yishalu sachar kefoalim lav sechar shabbat shakle, kevan demeikkara lav addata dischar peulla bau, osin immo cheshbon leachar shabbat. uvire shamayim askinan, deaf al gav demehefkera ka zachi uma shehitztzil dideh have, mikkol makom lo nicha leh delithane meacherim, deyada deal karcheh afkereh, uvechinnam nammi lo nicha leh delitrach, hilkach shakel agreh:
Hechadut. kemo haddut. vehayenu bor vehayenu dut, ella shebbor bachafira vedut bevinyan:
Umenora vetocho. betoch haddut:

Vehapperach shel menora yotze uchefisha netuna alav garsinan. kelomar al happerach. uferach hu harachav shebberosh hammenora shehanner yoshev alav. uchefisha, sal gadol shekkovshim bo hazzetim lechamran:
Al pi hechadut. sheenah nofelet letocho:
Tahor. denitztzol im dafne haohel, kidamrinan leel beferek Adonai‏ [mishna 6]:

Vehammenora temea. mippene happerach hayyotze min haddut veen hakkefisha matztzelet alav. veim tomar, kevan dimnora temea heach haddut tahor, vahalo hi metammea chammet atzmo decherev hare hu kechalal. yesh lomar, demayre chegon delekka met babbayit ella cherev shennaga bammet, veal yado mittamme habbayit vehammenora, vekayma lan deen keli ose cheli acher kayyotze vo, kidfareshna beferek kamma:
Af hammenora tehora. devatar dida azlinan velo vatar pirchah, vehi betoch haddut kayma venitztzolet im haddut:
Hakkol tame. ben haddut ben hammenora. kevan deim tinnatel menora kefisha nofelet letoch haddut:

Rabbi eliezer omer haoreg shelosha chutin battechilla. im zo techillat arigato shel beged eno chayyav ad sheyyeerog shelosha chutin, veim mosif hu al haarig shiuro beechad, demitztaref im hashshear. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Hakkorea al meto vechulei. bemet sheeno chayyav likroa alav hu dahave mekalkel ufatur, aval al met shechayyav likroa alav, metakken hu vechayyav:

Uvachamato. vechol hamekalkelim peturin. ha matnitin iddachya la, vahalacha shehakkorea bachamato chayyav, sheaf al pi shemmekalkel hu etzel habbeged, metakken hu etzel yitzro vedato mityashshevet alav bechach:
Ben bimino ben bismolo. beadam shehu sholet bishte yadav, deillu bishar kol adam ketivat semol enah ketiva:
Ben mishshem echad. shetehen alfin:
Mishshene shemot. alef bet:
Mishshene sammaniyyot. echad bidyo veechad besikra. veit sefarim degarse mishshene sammaniyyot, kelomar mishshene simanim, kegon shekkotvim 1‏ lesiman echad uv‏ lesiman shenayim:
Bechol lashon. uchetav shel kol umma veumma:

Mishshum roshem. siman shehayu osin bekarshe hammishkan, mippene shemmefarkim otan, velichsheyyekimuhu lo yachlifu seder hakkerashim. veata rabbi yose lememar daafillu lo katav ella sherasham shene reshimot bealma lesiman, chayyav. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Matzinu shem katan. kelomar af al pi shello nigmar melachto, shennitkavven lichtov teva gedola vechatav miktzatah, hoil veoto miktzat haveya teva umitkayyemet bemakom acher chayyav, vechen halacha:
Machar et hayyam. haeven shennotnim betochah hazzetim bishat techinatan:
Hammammal. harechev haelyona shebbah mefarchim hazzetim:
Habbetulot. kelunesot shel erez shemmaamidin bahem korot bet habbad:
Achirin. nesarim kevedim shennotnim al haamtachot shessamim bahem hazzetim hakketushim kede lechavshan:
Haggalgal. shemmegalgel haeven umachbid al hazzetim hakketushim lehotzi shamnan:
Haose maor. challon heasuy leora:
Battechilla. mishshum devae lemitna sefa sheyare hammaor tana resha vitchilla:
Makdeach gadol shel lishka. hu chefunedyon haittalki uchesela neronit veyeshno chimlo nekev shel ol. im yesh bachallon kashshiur hazze, mevi et hattuma letzad acher:
Sheyare hammaor. im nishar min hachallon shello nistam:
Chararuhu mayim. shello naasa hachor al yede adam ella al yede merutzat hammayim:
O sheratzim. kegon hacholed vehaachbar:
O sheachalattu mallachat. shehaaretz melecha umitbakkaat meeleha:
Melo egrof. egrofo shel ben avattiach. adam gadol shehaya haegrof shello cherosh gadol shel kol adam:
Chashav alav letashmish. challon shechararuhu mayim o sheratzim, shechishshev lehishtammesh bo ulehanniach sham chafatzav:
Lemaor. lehachenis ora:
Hasserigot. mechitztza chemin sevacha mesoreget sheosim bachallonot shel otzarot:
Veharfafot. mechitztza mesoreget sheosim bachallonot shel batte hakkayitz sheyyoshvim sham lehitkarer:
Mitztarfot kimlo makdeach. avir shebben hasserigot, af al pi sheen bemakom echad kimlo makdeach mitztarfin ben kullam lechimlo makdeach:

Lehavi et hattuma ulehotzi et hattuma. lav appelugeta devet shammay uvet hillel kae, ella ashshiurim deresha kae. vehachi kaamar, melo makdeach umelo egrof ufoteach tefach daamaran, kol hashshiurin hallalu ben lehavi et hattuma labbayit ben lehotzi et hattuma min habbayit. verabbi shimon paleg, vesavar ben lehavi ben lehotzi kullan shiuran befoteach tefach, velet leh lerabbi shimon shiur shel melo makdeach umelo egrof kelal. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Hammocher et hassefina. setam:
Machar et hattoren. etz gavoah shettolin alav et hannes. vehannes hu kemin vilon shettolin battoren leneged haruach:
Ogin. barzel shekkoshrin oto bachevel vezorkin oto beomek hammayim leakkev uleaggen hassefina:
Manhigim. ellu hammeshotot shebbahem molichin hassefina lammakom sherotzim:
Martzufin. amtachot shennotnim bahem hassechora:

Antiki. happerakmatya shebbetoch hassefina. vechol hane dechashev hacha divmecher lo machar, im natan vehikdish et hassefina lo havu hanach bichlal hammattana vehahekdesh. velo dame levor vedut vegat defirkin dilel dechullehu mekarkee ninhu uvatle legabbe sade leinyan hekdesh umattana, aval hanach lo batle kelal:

Peradot. behemot hammoshchot et hakkaron. vehu sheen adukim bo bishat hammechira. veit dimfarshe peradot, etzim hannifradim min haagala shemmoshchim et haagala bahem. vehu shello yihyu keshurim bah bishat hammechira:
Tzemed. hu haol shetztzomed umechabber et hashshevarim yachad:

En haddamim reaya. veha deamar dishtut kana umachazir onaa yoter mishshetut batel mikkach, hane mille bichde shehaddaat toa, desavur hallokeach sheshshave kach, vehave mikkach taut, aval bichde sheen haddaat toa, kegon dekana tzemed sheshshave zuz bematayim, amrinan bemattana netanam lo veen kan bittul mikkach. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hachor shebbaddelet. beemtza haddelet, deeno asuy laavir:
Shiyyer bo hecharash. haumman shettikken et haddelet:
Millemattan. kegon sheshshiyyer samuch laaskuppa:
O milmalan. samuch lammashkof:
Hegifah. segarah:
Velo merkah. lo gemarah:
O sheppetachattu haruach. kelomar, o shemmerak et hassegira ella shebbata haruach ufetachattu:

Shiuro melo egrof. dechevan deniftach mimmela have kachararuhu mayim o sheratzim. uvehach sefa lo faleg rabbi tarfon, mishshum dechor shebbaemtza asa hecharash bemitkavven, velo mippene shetztzarich lachor ella ketzarim hayu haddappin shennaasa mehen haddelet vealta vedato lehanniach hannekev baemtza yoter millehanniach lematta o lemala, vedame leasa vemitkavven, aval keshehinnicho millematta o millemala en ze cheose vayyadayim, ella mechamat shehannesarim ketzarim velo nitmalle hannekev:
Ulesham hu motzi. letanna kamma lechatzer hameorevet, uleven betera afillu lechatzer sheenah meorevet:
Kele tashmisho. shetztzerichim lo leoto hayyom lisuda:

Shemona asar kelim. shehu ragil lilbosh bechol bevat achat vetu lo. veellu hen, hassarbal haelyon, umalbush shemmemallein oto moch vetzemer gefen ben tefira litfira shekkorin baaravi 359, vachagor rachav shechoger mimmaal lemaddav, uveged tzar vekatzar shekkorin belaaz 60, vechaluk shellovesh al besaro shekkorin 158, vachagor shechogrim aleha, vechova shebberosho, umitznefet ushene minalim shebberaglav, ushene batte shokayim, ushene batte yadayim shemmalbishim otam al hayyadayim umechassin bahen hazzeroot ad haatzilim, ushene redidim shemmitnaggev bahen, vetallit katan shemmechasse bo rosho uchetefav, vesudar shebbetzavvaro uteluyin shene rashav lefanav vekorin lo baaravi 314:

Bou vehatztzilu immi. shekkeshem shehu matztzil kach hem matztzilim. aval leel amar bou vehatztzilu lachem, sheppeamim shehu matztzil yoter mimma shehem yecholim lehatztzil, kegon shehu lo saad vehen saadu, o ippecha:
Lo yigma et hachometz. veyiflot, demuchecha milleta delirfua hu. veim megammea uvolea shappir dami:
Lo yasuch bahem yayin vechometz. deen adam sach mehen ella lirfua:
Aval lo shemen vered. lefi sheddamav yekarim umuchecha milleta delirfua kaaved:
Shekken darkan lasuch. belo makka:
Rabbi shimon omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Machar et habbattim. happetuchim lechatzer:
Uvorot shichim umearot. shebbetoch habbattim. veaf al gav dehammocher bayit lo machar bor shiach umeara, legabbe chatzer miha betelim hen:
Ben kach uven kach. afillu amar kol ma shebbetochah, lo machar et hammerchatz vechulei. deenan bichlal chatzer:
Rabbi eliezer omer vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Hakkone shene ilanot. setama, lo kana karka kelal sevivotav:
Higdilu. hirchivu haanafim:

Lo yeshappe. lo yichrot otam baal hakkarka af al pi shehatztzel shellahem mazzik lakkarka shello, dechevan deen lo karka levaal hailanot hare baal hakkarka shibed lo karkao lechol tzarkan kol zeman shehem kayyamim:
Geza. kol shehu lemala min haaretz sheroe pene chamma:
Sharashin. kol shehen lematta min haaretz:

Shello. shel baal hailan. velo sheyyannichennu sham veyigdal, dechayshinan shemma tagbiah hakkarka ad sheyyitkasse hailan hayyotze min haggeza miktzato bakkarka veyerau kishlosha ilanot, veyomar lo hallokeach shelosha ilanot macharta li veyesh li karka, ella yakotz oto veyisrefennu:
Veim metu. sheyyavash hailan:
En lo karka. sheyyuchal litta acher bimkomo:

Kana karka. dachashive sede hailan, vekana bakkarka sheyyesh ben ilan leilan, vetachtehen vechutza lahen kimlo ore vesallo, kede sheyyachol laamod melakket happerot im hassal shello. vehane mille, kesheyyesh ben ilan leilan lo pachot mearba ammot velo yoter al shesh esre amma, az kana bakkarka shebben ilan leilan vetachtehen vechutza lahen kidamran. aval im yesh ben ilan leilan pachot mearba ammot o yoter mishshesh esre amma, lo kana karka:
Haose makom. shennikkev nekev mefullash bakkotel lehanniach sham kane shel orgim:
Uleispati. cherev bilshon yavan korin ispeti. veyesh laorgim keli ketavnit cherev:
Shiuro vechol shehu. lehavi et hattuma latztzad haacher:
Lazun et enav. lehistakkel mishsham lirshut harabbim o lechatzer:
Uletashmish. lehatzenia sham chafatzav:
Arba middot. dinim chalukim ze mizze:

Machar lo chittim yafot. hitna immo sheyyitten lo chittin yafot venimtzeu raot, have keonaa, ulechach yachol lachazor bo, mi shennitanna bilvad, dehu lokeach, aval mocher eno yachol lachazor bo vaafillu hukeru hachittin harebe:

En echad mehen yachol lachazor bo. vaafillu hukeru o huzelu. velo matze lokeach lememar ani leyafot nitkavvanti vehay daamena raot mishshum dera ra yomar hakkone. vechen ippecha lo matze mocher lememar ani leraot nitkavvanti vehay daamena yafot dederech hammocher lomar lara tov:
Shechamtit. adumma. vechol chum (Bereshit 30) metargeminan shachum:

Venimtzet levana. veikka denicha leh behay veikka denicha leh behay. vechol kehay gavna have mikkach taut lishnehem ushenehem yecholim lachazor. deillu beyafot venimtzeu raot kulle alma nicha lehu beyafot:
Yayin venimtza chometz. ikka denicha leh bechamra veikka denicha leh bechalla:

Hazziz. sheppanav lematta. kemin luach yotze min hakkotel lachutz verosho chafuf lematta laaretz letzad happetach, hilkach mitztaref oholo im happetach umevi et hattuma bechol shehu vachashiv keillu yesh bo poteach tefach, veim tuma tachtav habbayit tame, sheroin rosho hakkafuf lematta keillu higgia laaretz, umevi tuma shettachtav letzad habbayit:
Vegizra. sheppaneha lemala. roshah kafuf lemala veen ohel shellah mitztaref im happetach, hilkach baya poteach tefach:
Vegavlit. mefaresh battosefta keli shemmenika mikkan umikkan umeshayyer min haemtza:
Shenem asar tefachim. deshiur kol nidbach arbaa tefachim. venidbach hu shura shel binyan avanim:
Vehaatarot. avanim sedurot beiggul boltot min hakkir lemala min happetach keen kippa lenoy, vehayenu atara:
Vehappittuchim. sheosim meeven al happetach o al hachallon lenoy, ufeamim shebboltim min hachallon umin happetach tefach o yoter:
Lo machar et haraglayim. battosefta tanya, bamme devarim amurim, bimkom shello nahagu, aval bimkom shennahagu hakkol keminhag hammedina:
Machar et hakkane. et harea. venikret al shem hakkane shellah:
Veheehilu alav tehorim. al miktzat gufo shebbachutz:
Bet shammay metaharin. deen baa tachtav tuma shebbabbayit, deen kan chalal:
Uvet hillel metammein. desavre adam chalul hu uvaa tachtav tuma, veotan sheheehilu alav bachutz nitmeu:
Hamekabbel perot. shekkana tevua mechavero. hallokeach mekabbel alav rova tinnofet lechol sea, dederech tevua bechach. velo yoter:
Eser metullaot. achulot mittolaim. lechol mea, dehaynu echad meeser:

Kossot. yayin ra. im hammartef shel chaviyyot gedolot mekabbel alav eser chaviyyot gedolot. veim hammartef shel kaddot, mekabbel alav eser kaddot. vedavka kesheamar martef ze ani mocher lecha, ulemikpa, kelomar lasim betoch hattavshil. aval im amar martef shel yayin ani mocher lecha lemikpa, tzarich litten lo yayin shekkullo yafe. sheyyayin shel mikpa tzarich sheyyihye yafe umitkayyem, sheen mistappekim mimmennu ella meat meat. veim amar setam yayin ani mocher lecha velo zachar lemikpa, noten lo yayin benoni hannimkar bachanut. veim amar martef ze ani mocher lecha velo hizkir yayin, afillu kullo chometz, higgio:
Kankannim bashsharon. beeretz hammishor:
Mekabbel alav eser pitasyaot. sheenan mevushshalot kol tzarkan. vehen shoavot hayyayin umazziot oto:
Bet chatnut livno. shedderech adam laasot livno bayit keshennose ishsha:
Bet almenut levitto. keshemmet balah veshava el bet aviha. aval bechayye balah hi etzel balah, sheen derech chatan ladur im chamiv:
Refet bakar hu ze. vetzarich laasoto gadol yoter:
Bayit katan. happachut shebbabbattim hu shesh al shemone. vehammocher makom lachavero setam laasot lo bayit tzarich sheyyihye shesh al shemone:
Gadol. veim peresh laasot lo bayit gadol:
Teraklin. asuy lemoshav sarim:
Rumo kachatzi arko vechachatzi rachbo. akkullehu kae, dehaynu bevayit katan rumo shiva, uvevayit gadol tisha, uteraklin eser:
Reaya laddavar hechol. shehaya arko arbaim verachbo esrim verumo sheloshim, shehem chatzi arko verachbo:

Hakkol kevinyan hechol. ikka deamre ha ditnan leel rumo kachatzi arko vechachatzi rachbo, reaya laddavar hechol, rabban shimon ben gamliel katane la, sherabban shimon ben gamliel omer hakkol kevinyan hechol. veikka deamre rabban shimon ben gamliel paleg attanna kamma veattemohi ka mittamme, vechi hakkol bonim kevinyan hechol, en haddavar taluy ella beminhag hammedina:

Hammocher et hachamor machar et hasseyach. beno shel chamor. uvaggemara moke lah kegon sheamar lo chamor menika ani mocher lecha. dachalev haaton lemay mahane, ella vadday hi uvenah kaamar leh. vesefa deamar para menika ani mocher lecha lo kana et benah, defara lachalavah omedet, ufara vachalavah kaamar leh:
Machar ashpa. makom gavoah shelosha tefachim o yoter, o amok shelosha tefachim o yoter, sheragil lehaniach sham zevel behemotav:
Machar bor machar memav. matnitin yechidaa hi, ufelige rabbanan alah veamre machar bor lo machar memav. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hallokeach perot shovach. ma sheyyaldu hayyonim kol hashshana:
Mafriach. hallokeach:
Berecha rishona. veyannichenna lammocher. vechol shene veladot keruyin berecha. umannichan im immam kede lihyot letzavta leimmam shello yivrechu:

Perot kavveret. devorim hannoladim min hakkavveret zot hashshana. notel hallokeach shelosha nechilim, shelosha chavurot mivveladot haddevorim harishonim hayyotzim min hakkavveret, umachnisan letoch hakkavveret shello. sheharishonim hem chashuvim, veacharon acharon garua. umishsham vaelach mesares, kelomar notel achat umanniach achat lammocher, kede sheyyigdelu veyitchabberu im haavot kede shettityashshev hakkavveret. vechen leolam:
Challot devash. haddevash im hashshaava yachad meoravim asuy challot challot:
Manniach shete challot. shemmitparnesim haddevorim mehem kol yemot haggeshamim:
Gerofiyyot. anafim. vechozer vetzomeach:
Habbone. sheamru baavot melachot:
Kamma yivne veyihye chayyav. kol shehu:
Mesattet. merabbea et haeven o machlikah umetakkenah, hakkol lefi minhag hammakom. vehi tolada demakke bappattish:

Vehammakke vappattish. hi gemar melacha shel chotzve even, leachar shechatzav haeven min hahar saviv vehivdilah makke aleha bappattish makka gedola vehi mitpareket venofelet. vechol haggomer melacha beshabbat tolada demakke bappattish hi:
Maatzad. kofitz katan:
Vehakkodeach. hannokev:
Kol shehu. akkullehu kae, amsattet veammakke bappattish uvammaatzad, vehakkodeach:
Umelachto mitkayyemet. sheen tzarich lehosif aleha:
Kurnas. 289:
Saddan. 222 belaaz:

Mippene shehu chimtakken melacha. af al pi sheeno makke al hammelacha ella al hassaddan, metakken hu, shekken meraddede tasse mishkan hayu osin, makkin al hattas shalosh hakkaot veal hassaddan hakkaa achat, lehachelik hakkurnas shello yevakkea hattas shehu dak. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
